Clinical Independent Rater -PolishSpeaking

Location: Remote/Virtual
Hours: Estimated 10–16 hours per month
Role: Clinical Specialist

About IQVIA

IQVIA is a global leader in advanced analytics, technology solutions, and clinical research services, dedicated to driving healthcare forward. We partner with the world’s leading pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device companies to improve patient outcomes and accelerate innovation. Our team combines deep scientific expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver high-quality data and insights that shape the future of clinical trials.

Position Overview

The Clinical Specialist plays a key role in ensuring the integrity and reliability of clinical trial data. This position involves reviewing scales administered by raters to confirm standardized assessment practices. Responsibilities include evaluating assessment quality, engaging in live discussions with raters to provide guidance on methodology and scoring techniques, and supporting rater performance through functional assessments (e.g., mock interviews). Additional tasks may include assisting with communication materials and documentation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in all required orientation, training, and calibration activities.

  • Review case data and prepare for rater discussions, ensuring all relevant documents and scale items are available.

  • Conduct live interactions with raters to provide feedback and guidance on assessment methodology and scoring.

  • Complete assigned tasks and rater interactions according to schedule.

  • Submit all required documentation accurately and on time.

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Master’s degree (MA/MS) in Psychology, Counseling, Psychiatric Nursing, or Social Work (or equivalent). MD, DO, or PhD preferred.

  • Experience:

    • Minimum 3 years administering psychiatric assessments, rating scales, and/or structured clinical interviews (specificallyMINI and MADRS).

    • Minimum 3 years of clinical experience with psychiatric populations.

    • Minimum 3 years administering scales in clinical research trials (excluding graduate/doctoral research).

    • Experience in CNS trials preferred.

  • Skills:

    • Strong interpersonal and communication skills for professional interaction at all levels.

    • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, time management, and problem-solving ability.

    • Proficiency with Windows and Microsoft Office applications.

Language Requirement

Current openings require fluency in English and native-level proficiency in Polish.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

The actual base pay offered may vary based on a number of factors including job-related qualifications such as knowledge, skills, education, and experience; location; and/or schedule (full or part-time). Dependent on the position offered, incentive plans, bonuses, and/or other forms of compensation may be offered, in addition to a range of health and welfare and/or other benefits.

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer - SRE

Job Location: Berlin, Germany

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Join our dynamic team as a Senior Site Reliability Engineer on the Vault Platform team, where you'll ensure the scalability and reliability of our enterprise applications. You'll tackle complex challenges at a global scale, drawing on your deep expertise in Java and modern open-source technologies to make a tangible impact on production systems.
You should have extensive experience with Java applications and the latest open-source technologies, ideally from enterprise software development or a high-growth tech company. As a Senior SRE, you'll need to be naturally curious and skilled at problem-solving. You'll also bring a unique engineering perspective, understanding how systems integrate in production to operate at a global scale for hundreds of customers across North America, Europe, and Asia.

What You'll Do

    • Build Cloud Infrastructure: Rapidly build new cloud infrastructure from scratch, adhering to software development best practices
    • Drive Reliability & Scalability: Ensure our platform meets the scalability and reliability needs of our hundreds of global customers (across North America, Europe, and Asia)
    • Lead Incident Management: During an incident, effectively lead triage and mitigation efforts, potentially performing periodic on-call duty for escalations
    • Automate & Optimize: Develop tools and automation to eliminate manual work and reduce issue resolution times
    • Full-Stack Diagnostics: Proactively learn all necessary systems to provide full-stack diagnostics and determine root causes of production problems
    • Strategic Engineering Partnership: Strategize with engineering teams on complex problems, offering insights on what will work at scale (supporting 2M+ users) and guiding development decisions before features ship
    • Influence Design: Participate in engineering design reviews of new features and drive initiatives to improve operational efficiency and platform scalability
    • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with Product Management, Design, and QA to deliver cutting-edge solutions and direct customer value
    • Backend Focus: Work across multiple layers of our technology stack, with a primary focus on backend development, and opportunities in frontend and infrastructure
    • Effective Communication: Communicate clearly with engineering teams, succinctly describing problems for seamless hand-offs during outages with both technical and non-technical audiences
    • Mentorship: Actively mentor team members, contributing to a positive and high-performing team environment

Requirements

    • Deep Java Expertise: 5+ years of experience in Java development, with a strong preference for experience within enterprise cloud software companies
    • Operational Experience: Hands-on operational experience in a high-volume or critical production service environment, including incident management and root cause analysis
    • Code Quality: Proven ability to write clean, testable, readable, and maintainable code within a collaborative team setting
    • Open Source Proficiency: Hands-on experience with a range of open-source technologies, such as Spring, MySQL, Hibernate, Solr, Maven, Git, Tomcat, Linux, AWS, Vagrant, Docker, and Kubernetes
    • Database Mastery: 3+ years of experience in relational databases with expert-level SQL skills
    • Scripting Skills: Solid scripting proficiency with languages such as Shell, Bash, Ansible, Python, Go, Ruby, etc.
    • Leadership & Communication: Demonstrated history of incident management and leadership ability, with effective communication skills across all levels (individual contributors to executives)
    • Mentorship: Proven record of making your team better through mentorship

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Compensation

    • Total compensation: 85,000 - 140,000 EUR

Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

OUR CLIENT

Our client provides data-driven, action-oriented solutions to business problems through statistical data mining, cutting-edge analytics techniques, and a consultative approach. Leveraging proprietary methodology and best-of-breed technology, our client's analytics team takes an industry-specific approach to transform decision-making and embed analytics more deeply into their business processes. They have a global footprint of 2,000+ data scientists and analysts who assist client organizations with complex risk minimization methods, advanced marketing, pricing and CRM strategies, internal cost analysis, and cost and resource optimization within the organization. They serve the insurance, healthcare, banking, capital markets, utilities, retail and e-commerce, travel, transportation and logistics industries.

ROLE

We are seeking an Insurance Analytics SMEwho will play a key customer-facing role for an Insurance customer. Candidate should have extensive consulting experience in the Insurance industry. This is a remote role with the potential to become hybrid.

Role & Responsibilities Overview:

  • Insurance data and analytics domain expert who can provide strategic and tactical advisory services on data solutions.
  • Experience leading analytics solution delivery for various insurance carriers.
  • Experience in designing data/analytics (including BI, predictive model and data solutions) across insurance business functions like Claims, Distribution, Product, Marketing, Finance, etc.
  • Understand the insurance regulatory environment and market across insurance products.
  • Strong knowledge of prominent tools like SQL/SAS/Python /PBI/Tableau or cloud technologies like AWS/Azure/GCP etc.
  • Conduct sessions to understand the client's needs utilizing standard and innovative consulting skills to deliver an optimal recommendation.
  • Brainstorming on pain areas/Identifying reasons for issues/Issue Resolution, diagnosis of inefficiencies in the current process, and figuring out ways to resolve it.
  • Expected to work in close collaboration with the Client team and internal team on establishing relationships with stakeholders, and identifying new opportunities, and areas of growth.
  • Provide Project, Client & Team Management and Monitor the progress of deliverables on a daily basis and ensure timely resolution of any issues.
  • Provide technical direction/support to project team members across data modeling, data manipulation, visualization, predictive modeling, Reporting, and Automation projects across the Insurance Value Chain
  • Proactively manage diverse teams and their expectations including career progression, skill development, or other people management aspects
  • Ensure Industry best practices are followed, Communicate and follow up with the delivery team.
  • Develop business proposals, facilitate client working sessions, and team up with technology professionals and/or third-party strategic alliances to conduct solution exercises based on clients' needs.
  • Participate and own various new RFPs, work with various SMEs to research and develop technical/business case studies,

Key Skillsets:

  • Experienced in the execution of delivery of a range of data management, analytics, artificial intelligence consulting, and delivery engagements.
  • Demonstrated experience in building relationships with executive-level clients in the Insurance industry
  • Support the engagement with expertise in deploying data solutions on Cloud/On-premise, advanced analytics, and business intelligence solutions.
  • Establish an environment of learning and development to continuously strengthen delivery propositions for various analytics setups.
  • Establish an industry-standard framework for absorbing the latest developments in the industry.
  • Perform research and provide solutions for various business needs from clients across the insurance value chain.
  • Demonstrated experience with Azure platform or relevant cloud technologies to design/integrate ETL pipelines, and data models for efficient BI solutions

Candidate Profile:

  • Bachelors/Master's degree in economics, mathematics, computer science/engineering, operations research or related analytics areas; candidates with BA/BS degrees in the same fields from the top tier academic institutions are also welcome to apply.
  • 7+ years with significant experience across Insurance business functions and processes (among Claims, Distribution, Marketing, Products & UW, Finance, etc.)
  • Experience in delivering analytics solutions including data engineering/models, reporting/dashboarding, predictive modeling, operationalization of models, monitoring, and business strategy support across insurance functions
  • Good grasp of conducting business workshops, architecting solutions, benchmarking industry solutions, and recommending best-in-class approaches for solution delivery
  • Proven expertise in delivering solutions leveraging data tools like SQL/SAS/Snowflake, AWS/Azure/GCP, Python/R, PowerBI/Tableau etc.
  • Strong interfacing experience with different types of stakeholders including business, technology, analysts/engineers, and leading multi-stakeholder-based engagements.
  • Provide insurance industry best practices, and thought leadership and enable an environment of continuous development, innovation
  • Experience in working in dual shore engagement and must have experience in managing large programs Insurance Analytics CoE and multiple clients directly.
  • Competitor analysis, Ad-hoc data analysis, and application of First principles thinking approach to solve business problems.
  • Strong grasp of the latest tools within the market.
  • Strong record of achievement, solid analytical ability, and an entrepreneurial hands-on approach to work
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills
  • Able to work in fast pace continuously evolving environment and ready to take up uphill challenges.

As a Product Marketing Manager focusing on the SevenRooms venue management system and Front-of-House tooling, you will work cross-functionally as well as with external partners and customers to drive go-to-market activity – inserting the voice of the customer into every point of the product life cycle and communicating the rollout of new products both internally and externally. SevenRooms Marketing & Guest Experience products are on a remarkable trajectory and we’re looking for a driven Product Marketing Manager to help us create, evaluate, and increase adoption across the platform.

At SevenRooms, our Product Marketing team is the driving force behind our brand's growth and visibility in the hospitality industry. Comprised of creative thinkers, data-driven strategists, and innovative storytellers, our marketing professionals are passionate about connecting with our audience and showcasing the transformative power of our platform. From crafting compelling campaigns and engaging content to nurturing leads and fostering customer relationships, our team works collaboratively to deliver impactful results and drive measurable business outcomes. With a focus on innovation, creativity, and customer-centricity, the Product Marketing at SevenRooms is dedicated to empowering hospitality professionals to thrive in an ever-evolving digital landscape.

This role reports to the Manager of Product Marketing.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Build business cases for new product/feature development in the Venue Management area of the product.Review and refine product requirements to fit customer & business needs. Leverage data and client product metrics to develop business cases around core products and features.Gather and distill market feedback and key industry learnings to help shape and prioritize the product roadmap.
  • Develop and execute growth plans to drive wider client adoption of our Venue Management products.
  • Manage beta testing to ensure successful launches and to accelerate product-market fit.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Enablement, Marketing, Sales and Customer Success to design and execute go-to-market strategies for our products.
  • Partner with Brand, Growth and Customer Marketing on thoughtful, integrated marketing campaigns that drive usage and adoption across the platform.
  • Work closely with the broader Product Marketing team to design & lead the GTM process – implementing standards from inception to launch.Drive internal communication cross-functionally ensuring the right stakeholders are involved and informed at the right time.Produce new and engaging product content and narratives as they relate to the SevenRooms products.
  • Monitor competitive intel and market trends, developing strategies for knowledge sharing while incorporating these learnings into ongoing campaigns
  • Collaborate closely with stakeholders throughout SevenRooms to obtain buy-in for product initiatives while setting clear expectations and goals.

We’re excited about you because you have…

  • 3-6+ years of B2B product marketing experience
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience working cross-functionally or with clients, including expectation setting, discovery and collaboration, and successful delivery of offerings
  • Ability to quickly understand a specific client domain and identify the trends and opportunities in that space
  • Curiosity to dig several layers deep into solutions with an eye toward continuous improvement and creative thinking
  • Experience working in Hospitality and knowledge of restaurant and hotel operators preferred but not required
  • Experience working with email and retention marketing products is a plus
  • An open mind and flexibility around testing new approaches and the ability to harness failures and turn them into wins

Uncapped earning potential.


The Strategic Account Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth and customer retention across a defined territory of academic, medical, research, and healthcare institutions. This role manages a portfolio of large accounts while developing new business opportunities through a consultative sales approach.


The successful candidate will build trusted relationships with library leaders, faculty, researchers, clinicians, administrators, and executive stakeholders to understand organizational priorities and align Ovid's portfolio of evidence-based information solutions, workflow tools, and research resources to their needs. This role requires strategic account planning, executive-level communication, and the ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop deep expertise in Ovid's portfolio of clinical, research, educational, and workflow solutions.
  • Create and execute strategic territory and account plans that support revenue growth, retention, and customer expansion objectives.
  • Manage a portfolio of large academic, healthcare, and research accounts, serving as a trusted advisor to key stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with library directors, deans, academic leadership, researchers, clinicians, procurement teams, and other institutional stakeholders.
  • Identify customer business challenges, institutional priorities, accreditation requirements, and research objectives, and align Ovid solutions to address those needs.
  • Lead complex sales opportunities using a consultative and value-based selling methodology.
  • Develop account growth strategies that increase product adoption, customer engagement, and long-term partnership value.
  • Prospect for new business opportunities within existing accounts and across assigned territory.
  • Conduct business reviews, strategic planning sessions, product demonstrations, and executive presentations.
  • Prepare proposals, pricing recommendations, renewal strategies, and contract negotiations that align with customer objectives.
  • Collaborate with product specialists, customer success, marketing, and leadership teams to develop and execute account strategies.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline, opportunity, contact, and account information within Salesforce CRM.
  • Deliver accurate sales forecasts and territory updates to leadership.
  • Meet or exceed assigned revenue, retention, and growth targets.
  • Travel throughout assigned territory to support customer engagement, strategic meetings, conferences, and sales activities.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
  • 5+ years of successful experience in strategic account management, consultative sales, business development, or enterprise sales.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage large, complex accounts with multiple stakeholders and lengthy sales cycles.
  • Experience developing and executing strategic account plans that drive revenue growth and customer retention.
  • Strong consultative selling, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including executive-level presentations.
  • Proven ability to identify customer needs and translate them into solution-based recommendations.
  • Experience managing a sales pipeline and forecasting through Salesforce or similar CRM platforms.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize multiple opportunities, and manage a geographic territory effectively.

Preferred

  • Experience selling information, technology, SaaS, healthcare, educational, library, research, publishing, or clinical workflow solutions.
  • Knowledge of academic medical centers, hospitals, healthcare systems, medical schools, universities, libraries, or research institutions.
  • Familiarity with evidence-based medicine, clinical decision support tools, medical education resources, or scholarly research workflows.
  • Experience selling into C-suite, dean-level, library leadership, faculty, and healthcare executive audiences.

Success Profile

The ideal candidate is a strategic, consultative seller who excels at developing long-term partnerships, uncovering institutional priorities, navigating complex stakeholder environments, and demonstrating the measurable value of Ovid solutions. They are equally effective at growing established enterprise relationships and identifying new opportunities within academic and healthcare markets.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

$71,300.00 - $124,500.00 USDThis role is eligible for Commission.

Compensation range listed is based on primary location of the position. Actual base salary offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience and actual hiring location. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific offer for the job location during the hiring process.

Additional Information:

Wolters Kluwer offers a wide variety of competitive benefits and programs to help meet your needs and balance your work and personal life, including but not limited to: Medical, Dental, & Vision Plans, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Commuter Benefits, Tuition Assistance Plan, Vacation and Sick Time, and Paid Parental Leave. ABOUT THE ROLE

AI is rewriting how every company works, and everyone is racing to figure out how to secure it. We have, and we need someone to take it to market.

The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated entirely to Abnormal's AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. You will own AI Security in your territory, from the first conversation through close, hunting the largest new logos while working alongside the Account Executives who already know our customers best. This is a sales role for someone who can carry a number and go as deep technically as our best engineers when a conversation demands it.

The timing matters. Abnormal is growing about 50% year over year, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. AI security now comes up in close to 80% of customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust our behavioral AI to solve it. Demand is outrunning capacity. You will step into a deep pipeline on day one, and you will have real say in how this category gets sold.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own AI Security in your territory. Carry the AI Security quota and run the full sales cycle end to end, from first conversation through close, including significant upsell campaigns across our existing customer base.
  • Hunt the largest new logos. Take Abnormal's AI Security story into the biggest enterprises in the world, and open doors beyond the customers who already trust us.
  • Prioritize ruthlessly. Inbound interest will outpace your calendar. Decide where your time moves the needle, and where it does not.
  • Partner with Account Executives. Work alongside the core team in your territory, equip them to carry AI Security conversations, and step in on the deals that matter most.
  • Go deep on the technology. Hold your own with security and platform teams on behavioral AI, cloud security, and agent security when a customer needs more than a standard pitch.
  • Run point on design partner conversations for products still in early availability, working closely with product leadership to shape these deals and bring the right resources to the table.
  • Shape the product and the playbook. Feed what you hear in the field back to product leadership in a fast loop, and help build how AI Security gets sold as the suite matures from early availability to GA.
  • Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly, and you will keep pace.

WHAT YOU’LL SELL

Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability:

  • AI Governance: Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost.
  • AI Cloud Security: Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots.
  • AI Employee Guardrails: Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions.
  • AI Agent Security: Inventories an organization's AI agents and ensures they behave as intended.
  • AI Security Workbench: Lets security teams use AI to run investigations with Abnormal's models, without guardrails.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS RIGHT NOW

Every security vendor is staking a claim in AI security. Abnormal has earned real credibility here through eight years of behavioral AI investment and a track record protecting email for thousands of customers. That trust is an advantage today, not a permanent one, and this role exists to make sure we capitalize on it while the window is open.

For the right person, that means owning a brand-new motion at the center of a fast-growing company, working directly with executive and product leadership, and building a track record as one of the people who defined how this category gets sold.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience, primarily selling into Enterprise accounts, with a proven record of winning new logos and expanding accounts.
  • Technical depth and curiosity: comfort discussing AI architecture, cloud security concepts, and how behavioral models work, in enough detail to earn trust with technical buyers.
  • A hunter's drive paired with the judgment to prioritize when demand exceeds capacity.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity. The suite and the motion for selling it are still evolving, and much of the playbook will be written by whoever takes this role on.
  • Strong cross-functional instincts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and product leadership, and you will work autonomously between those touchpoints.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Direct experience selling AI security, cloud security, or other emerging security categories.
  • Experience in an overlay, specialist, or advisory role in cybersecurity or AI, or a record of selling into CISOs and security leaders.
  • Experience selling early-availability products and shaping design partner deals.

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

raw.description:
About this role:

Our Business Development teams play a critical role in expanding Gartner’s presence across the global market. Gartner Business Development Executives strategically acquire new clients by cultivating trust-based relationships with C-level executives to understand their mission critical priorities, then uncovering opportunities to deliver client-value through the lens of the industry in which they operate. Gartner Business Developers own and drive the full sales cycle, from identifying prospects to closure. They then transition new clients to the account management team for ongoing value delivery.

Our Business Development teams are relentless about building trust-based, value add relationships with clients, delivering long-term client value, and building their book of business over time. Business developers are results driven, client committed, and highly collaborative.

Business Developers will be given a territory of Large Enterprise prospects, which may be completely new prospects with no existing spend or could be clients within other Gartner areas. In our GBS Large Enterprise segment, Business Developers work with prospects with +$1bil in annual revenue.

What you will do:

  • Seek out and drive new business opportunities with new-to-Gartner organizations across your territory, from initial client outreach to close, targeting Large Enterprise organizations.

  • Convert viable prospects into active Gartner clients, owning the full sales conversation and negotiation, through to the transition of new clients to the account management team.

  • Continually build a pipeline of high-quality opportunities to deliver against your sales metrics ensuring KPI’s are met.

  • Align the right combination of insight, guidance, and practical tools to bring value to the partnership.

  • Quota responsibility for your assigned territory.

  • Manage complex high-revenue sales across matrix and diverse business environments.

  • Own forecasting and account planning on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis.

What you will need:

  • 5+ years’ B2B sales experience, preferably within complex, intangible sales environments.

  • Business development or new-client acquisition experience in a selling role highly desired.

  • Experience selling to and/or influencing C-Level Executives.

  • Proven track record meeting and exceeding sales targets.

  • Proven ability to precisely manage and forecast a complex sale process.

  • Willingness to conduct travel as needed.

  • Bachelor's degree desired

Progression within Business Development Executive Roles:

Gartner offers a lifetime of opportunities driven by our growth. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

Gartner has a promote from within culture and limitless opportunities for progression. Gartner leaders embrace this culture and are focused on helping associates achieve success in current role, as well as coaching associates to the next role or path, whether it be more senior BD levels, account management paths, or sales leadership.

Typical internal promotions include:

  • Business Development Director

  • Team Lead

  • Sales Manager

Most of our Sales Managers and Team Leads are hired internally as part of our progression path.

What you will get:

  • Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, and more!

  • Uncapped commission structure

  • World-class sales training programs and skill development programs

  • Annual "Winners Circle" event attendance at exclusive destinations for top performers

  • Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces inclusion

  • Professional development and career growth opportunities

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 102,000 USD - 147,000 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. Our talent acquisition team will provide the specific opportunity on our bonus or incentive programs to eligible candidates. We also offer market leading benefit programs including generous PTO, a 401k match up to $7,200 per year, the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount, and more.

The Executive III, Sales will be responsible for driving revenue growth through the acquisition of new clients and the expansion of existing client relationships. This role manages a portfolio of Transportation sales opportunities leveraging consultative selling techniques to assess business needs, develop tailored solutions, negotiate agreements, and close business. The Executive III, Sales builds trusted client relationships, creates long-term value by aligning solutions to client objectives, and consistently achieves revenue and performance objectives.

Essential functions, responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with prospective and existing clients to identify, develop, and close new business opportunities while expanding client partnerships through cross-sell and upsell initiatives.

  • Strong verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to effectively tailor messaging, presentation, and proposed solutions to align with client needs, business objectives, and federal regulatory requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple client relationships, sales opportunities, and competing priorities.
  • Strong consultative selling, negotiation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to influence decisionmakers and advance opportunities through the sales process.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to navigate complex DOT client needs and sales challenges.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and appropriately handle sensitive client information.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM systems (Salesforce), sales productivity tools, and pipeline management practices.

  • 401k with a highly competitive match.

Walk (occasionally), sit- up to 8hrs. a day, stand (occasionally), use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms, able to lift up to 15lbs.(occasionally).

Job Title: Partnership Development Executive – DeVoe School of Business (B2B & B2G)

Reporting Relationship:Executive Director, Strategic Partnership Expansion

Unit: National & Global

Department: Strategic Partnerships - IWU National & Global

Campus Location: Online/Remote within the United States

Summary of Position:The Partnership Development Executive – DeVoe School of Business represents IWU–National & Global and the DeVoe School of Business in developing B2B and B2G organizational partnerships that create sustainable enrollment pipelines for working professionals and adult learners.

This role focuses on employer-driven talent development by connecting organizations with IWU’s business degree portfolio, including traditional business programs, leadership and management pathways, graduate business programs, MBA-related offerings, and emerging AI-focused business programs and certificates. The position helps employers address workforce needs by developing talent pipelines, career ladders, upskilling pathways, and retention solutions.

The Partnership Development Executive serves as a consultative relationship builder with Human Resources leaders, Chief People Officers, Talent Development Directors, Learning and Development leaders, workforce development organizations, chambers of commerce, municipal and government HR divisions, and other employer decision makers.

This position is designed for a high-potential, relationship-driven professional with non-negotiable excellence in written and verbal communication, professional polish, business acumen, strategic curiosity, and disciplined follow-through. A background in human resources, talent development, workforce development, organizational development, or employer relations is strongly preferred. The successful candidate will identify prospective partners, initiate outreach, conduct professional discovery meetings, present tailored business and AI education solutions, manage pipeline milestones in Salesforce, collaborate with DeVoe faculty and academic leaders, and advance opportunities toward signed partnership agreements.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • B2B and B2G Partnership Development, Discovery, and Advancement
    • Identifies and initiates outreach to prospective employer partners across private-sector, nonprofit, workforce, municipal, and government/public-sector organizations
    • Prepares for and leads professional, agenda-driven discovery meetings with HR executives, Chief People Officers, Talent Development Directors, Learning and Development leaders, City/County HR Directors, state agency HR leaders, workforce leaders, and other organizational decision-makers
    • Positions IWU DeVoe School of Business programs, including traditional business degrees and AI-focused business programs and certificates, as strategic solutions for employer talent pipelines, career ladders, employee upskilling, succession planning, leadership development, and retention
    • Writes clear, polished prospecting emails, executive summaries, meeting recaps, and tailored proposals linking organizational workforce goals to IWU degree and certificate pathways
    • Presents IWU educational solutions, tuition discount benefits, cohort opportunities, and Prior Learning Assessment options clearly and persuasively
    • Works collaboratively with leadership to navigate decision-making pathways, address objections, establish clear next steps, and secure formal partnership agreements using institutional legal templates
    • Develops consultative relationships that move beyond general awareness or event attendance and toward measurable partnership, enrollment, and workforce outcomes
  • Targeted Market Outreach, Strategic Events, & Lead Generation
    • Develops and executes targeted regional outreach plans for priority employers, workforce development boards, chambers of commerce, professional associations, HR networks, and business organizations
    • Builds strategic presence within key professional organizations and employer networks, including SHRM, workforce development organizations, chambers of commerce, talent development groups, industry associations, municipal HR networks, and business leadership forums
    • Partners with DeVoe School of Business faculty by coordinating and exhibiting at events where DeVoe faculty are speaking, presenting, facilitating workshops, or representing the university as thought leaders
    • Leverages faculty expertise and public speaking engagements to generate qualified employer conversations, strengthen DeVoe’s market visibility, and connect organizational needs to IWU programs
    • Uses selective event attendance strategically by conducting pre-event outreach, securing scheduled one-on-one meetings, engaging decision makers during the event, and completing disciplined post-event follow-up
    • Employs market research and AI-enabled prospecting tools to identify workforce trends, talent shortages, skill gaps, AI adoption needs, leadership development opportunities, and high-yield employer targets
    • Represents IWU and the DeVoe School of Business with professionalism at employer meetings, association events, conferences, workforce forums, and community-based business events
  • CRM Pipeline Discipline, Follow-Through, & AI Workflow Utilization
    • Maintains uncompromising daily discipline in Salesforce as the system of record for all accounts, contacts, meeting notes, pipeline stages, and follow-up tasks
    • Demonstrates meticulous follow-through by executing committed action items promptly and maintaining momentum across all active partner relationships
    • Utilizes CRM performance metrics and pipeline management tools to prioritize outreach, track conversion rates, and meet weekly/monthly activity benchmarks
    • Leverages artificial intelligence (AI) tools and technologies to support market research, prospect identification, workflow optimization, strategic planning, communication drafting, and data analysis
    • Ensures that all partner activity is documented accurately, timely, and completely to support team visibility, leadership reporting, and effective handoff
  • Internal Collaboration & Academic Pathway Alignment
    • Collaborates closely with the DeVoe School of Business Dean, faculty, program directors, and academic leaders to understand program offerings, emerging AI curriculum, business programs, custom cohort opportunities, and employer education capabilities
    • Coordinates with DeVoe faculty to support speaking engagements, professional organization involvement, employer-facing workshops, and thought leadership opportunities that can generate partnership conversations

raw.description:
About N-Power Medicine

N-Power Medicine aims to establish a new paradigm in drug development by reinventing the ‘how’ and transforming clinical trials through better integration with clinical practice, ensuring broader participation by physicians and patients. We are building an exceptional multi-disciplinary team with diverse expertise spanning healthcare, engineering, technology and regulatory, and with people who share our core value of Empowering Community through generosity, curiosity and humility. We are working with urgency to bring better therapies to patients faster.

Position Overview

The Strategic Partner Executive is a senior account and implementation leader responsible for the end-to-end operations and success of the partnership with each assigned oncology network partner. This leader is the single point of accountability for ensuring network partners are fully activated and engaged in N-Power’s clinical programs and physicians are actively enrolling, advocating, and referring within and beyond their practice. This is a commercially minded role but is not a business development function, as it begins only after the deal is signed.

This role partners closely with on-site implementation staff to ensure staff roll-out, EHR integration, and day-to-day program execution run smoothly, while also building the physician relationships, advisory boards, and education materials that keep the partnership growing.

This position is remote within the United States, with regular travel to partner sites.

Role Objectives and Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of accountability for each assigned oncology network partner from contract execution onward, owning overall account health, engagement, and partner satisfaction.

  • Ensure network partners are fully engaged and successfully running the company’s clinical programs, currently focused on Prospective ECAs (ProECAs).

  • Drive active, sustained physician engagement through enrollment, advocacy, and partner-sourced referrals to new network expansion opportunities.

  • Own end-to-end implementation and ongoing operations for each partner, partnering closely with on-site staff on staff roll-out, EHR integration, and day-to-day execution, and surfacing and resolving issues before they impact the relationship.

  • Establish a consistent partner engagement cadence including quarterly business reviews, partner check-ins, onsite visits, and physician advisory boards, blending tactical, day-to-day conversations with strategic discussions on growth, expansion, and advocacy to keep the relationship active between formal touchpoints.

  • Position N-Power as a true partner by ensuring the value we bring is delivered and clearly understood by physicians and practice staff.

  • Actively promote the clinical program within partner organizations, translating our value proposition into terms that resonate with physicians and research teams.

  • Build and continuously refine repeatable playbooks for partner management, physician engagement, and implementation that can scale across the network.

  • Monitor program performance and engagement metrics across the network, proactively addressing gaps.

  • Support the BD team during contract signing by providing operational and implementation insight — helping shape deal terms and expectations that set the partnership up for a smooth launch.

Education, Experience, Behavioral Competencies, & Skills

  • 8+ years of experience in account management, client services, or partnership roles within oncology, healthcare, or life sciences, ideally with direct exposure to clinical research and research site operations.

  • Working knowledge of how oncology research and physicians operate, including academic/community research workflows, practice business administration.

  • Experience with large health systems, including navigating multi-stakeholder relationships and organizational complexity.

  • Demonstrated strong commercial and strategic acumen.

  • Program or implementation management experience, including cross-functional coordination.

  • Exceptional relationship-building, communication, negotiation, and executive presence.

  • Bachelor’s degree required, advanced degree a plus.

  • Generous, Curious & Humble.

Travel Requirements

  • As necessary for partner and physician relationships.

Pay Information

The expected salary range for this position is $xxx and $xxx. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. N-Power Medicine (NPM) offers equity at hire as well as a discretionary annual bonus which may be available based on Company performance. This position is eligible for company benefits.

About Us:

We are a mission-driven, well-funded, rapidly growing company, eager to attract passionate professionals offering a highly attractive compensation package with a balanced and flexible work environment, competitive industry benefits as well as a 401K plan and other great company “perks.”

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S. on a full-time basis.

Who We Are

Cprime's Organizational Change & Performance (OCP) Practice helps organizations navigate business transformation by aligning people, processes, and technology. As part of Goldman Sachs Asset Management and Everstone Capital, Cprime partners with more than 2,500 organizations worldwide—including over 300 Fortune 500 companies—to help clients solve complex business challenges and accelerate transformation.

Cprime is seeking an experienced Sales Executive to drive growth within our Organizational Change & Performance (OCP) Practice across North America.

This is a consultative sales role focused on developing new client relationships, expanding strategic accounts, and partnering with executive leaders to deliver transformational consulting services.   • Represent Cprime at conferences, industry events, executive briefings, and networking opportunities.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, organizational transformation strategies, AI adoption, workforce transformation, and emerging business challenges affecting enterprise clients.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree (graduate degree preferred)
  • 10+ years of enterprise sales experience selling consulting or professional services
  • Demonstrated success delivering annual consulting services bookings of at least $4 million
  • Proven experience acquiring new enterprise accounts while expanding existing customer relationships
  • Experience selling Organizational Change Management, Workforce Transformation, Enterprise Learning, Agile Transformation, Digital Transformation, or related consulting services
  • Strong understanding of enterprise business transformation initiatives and executive decision-making processes
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex consultative sales cycles from prospecting through contract negotiation and close
  • Track record of building executive-level relationships and influencing multiple stakeholders across business and technology organizations
  • Excellent presentation, communication, and executive facilitation skills
  • Highly collaborative with experience working across Sales, Solution Advisory, Consulting, and Delivery organizations
  • Ability to travel as needed

Preferred skills (good to have):

  • Existing executive network within enterprise organizations across North America
  • Experience selling organizational transformation, change management, learning, or workforce consulting services
  • Familiarity with Agile, SAFe®, Product Operating Models, AI transformation initiatives, or organizational effectiveness programs

What Success Looks Like:

  • Achieves annual consulting services bookings targets
  • Consistently generates qualified pipeline through new logo acquisition and strategic account growth
  • Develops trusted executive relationships that lead to long-term partnerships
  • Successfully partners with Practice Leadership and Delivery teams to win and deliver complex consulting engagements
  • Expands Cprime's Organizational Change & Performance footprint through cross-selling and integrated client solutions

What We Believe In

At Cprime we believe in facilitating social justice action internally, in industry, and within our communities. ENTERPRISE SERVICES

Job Description:

The Enterprise Agency Sales Executive is responsible for sales business development efforts for the Enterprise Services Division for ORNTIC. Responsible for contributing to the growth of Enterprise Agency Services (EAS) Division, specifically working to improve our market position with key new strategic and existing national Accounts.

Coordinates the sales and marketing of services necessary to grow and support large multi-state agency relationships. Prepares annual sales forecasts for accounts under management and assists in the identification of product and service opportunities and creation of new products and services designed to serve this segment. Assists with competitive state challenges and assists in formulating responses to competitor driven challenges. Negotiates contract pricing and facilitates the drafting of contracts and agreements with national agents. Promotes and supports enterprise agency solutions for state and key account title agents as requested by ORT agency representatives. Coordinates research on market conduct, customs and practices and legal and regulatory issues affecting national agents. Communicates with other ESD/ ORNTIC business units as appropriate to create support, measure and monitor agency activities and business opportunities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Business Development

  • Research and build relationships with prospective and existing Accounts with the intent to grow volume, market share, and profit for the Business Unit
  • Using a consultative sales approach, analyze existing and anticipated customer requirements as well as create customized solutions via the company's products and services to meet expected revenue goals as established by Senior Management
  • Identify and convert qualified prospects to new customers to augment client base
  • Using knowledge of the market and competitors, identify and develop the Business Unit’s unique selling propositions and differentiators
  • Plan approaches and sales pitches. Develop proposals that speak to the customer's needs, concerns, and objectives
  • Set-up meetings with prospective and existing Accounts to gather information, determine needs and present solutions

  • Provide training for agents on new Old Republic resources as they become available

Business Planning & Operations

Administration and Management

  • Determine and report competitor activities and market conditions.

  • Monitor the follow up and resolution of audit findings in conjunction with Enterprise Agency Services Operations Manager

  • Dependable, reliable and punctual attendance is required, which may include in-office attendance or attendance at company, industry or other events that occur outside regular business hours.

About CirrusMD:

CirrusMD is redefining virtual care by delivering a Physician-first Care & Guidance solution that meets patients at their moment of need. Our text-based (or web) app connects patients with licensed physicians in under a minute, allowing them to engage in care at their own pace and convenience. Available 24/7/365, CirrusMD’s integrated care spans multiple specialties—from acute and chronic care to behavioral health. Our platform serves 10 million users across all 50 states and is offered exclusively through employers and health plans. Learn more at cirrusmd.com.

JOB SUMMARY

The Client Success Executive (CSE) is responsible for developing and maintaining exceptional relationships with internal and client partners, ensuring clients achieve maximum value from the CirrusMD platform. The CSE owns retention and growth across an assigned book of business — identifying upsell opportunities, growing membership/covered lives, and meeting utilization goals. This role involves day-to-day client management, proactive engagement to understand and address client needs, and cross-functional collaboration to drive measurable success outcomes. The ideal candidate will have a background in mid- to large-scale client relationship management within healthcare services, with demonstrated success exceeding expectations while maintaining and growing their book.

ESSENTIAL ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Percent of time spent is approximate and totals 100%.

25% — Client Value, Relationships & Implementation

  • Client Value Realization: Work closely with clients to understand their business objectives and vision, and ensure the CirrusMD platform delivers measurable value aligned with those goals; share client objectives across the CirrusMD team.
  • Client Relationship Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned large, strategic accounts, managing day-to-day communications and building strong relationships with client stakeholders at all levels, up to and including the executive suite.
  • Onboarding, Implementation & Adoption: Manage intake and implementation of new projects from Client Success leadership and the Sales team; act as the key partner contact to facilitate implementation and hit go-live timelines, and drive adoption through training, best practices, and ongoing support.
  • Expectation Setting: Set proper client expectations based on knowledge of the CirrusMD platform, scope of relationship, and contractual requirements.

50% — Growth, Retention & Account Strategy

  • Client Growth & Upselling: Identify opportunities for account growth — including product upsell, cross-sell of complementary solutions, and growing membership/covered lives — and partner with Marketing to increase utilization across the book of business.
  • Retention & Renewal Management: Proactively manage client renewals, minimizing churn through ongoing engagement and demonstrated, continuous value.
  • Strategic Account Planning: Develop and maintain strategic account plans for growth and retention; strategize with clients on all opportunities to ensure solutions are being effectively utilized and expanded, and conceptualize new programs that deepen partner relationships.
  • Business Reviews & ROI Reporting: Develop and deliver business review presentations that demonstrate return on investment and program outcomes, and use ongoing review of those outcomes to recommend changes that optimize the CirrusMD platform to its full potential.
  • Client Health Monitoring: Regularly track and assess client health, using data and insights to identify risk and surface opportunities for deeper engagement and growth.
  • Performance Metrics & Reporting: Monitor key success metrics such as utilization and adoption rates, client satisfaction (NPS/CSAT), membership growth, and revenue; report progress and outcomes regularly to both clients and internal stakeholders.

25% — Collaboration, Advocacy & Market Insight

  • Issue Resolution: Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for the client, ensuring issues and concerns are addressed swiftly and effectively, coordinating with internal teams as necessary.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, Sales Support, Product Management, Business Development, Marketing, and Support to ensure a seamless client experience and to complete requests for proposals/information in a timely, accurate, and professional manner.
  • Client Feedback & Product Improvement: Collect and relay client and market feedback to Product and Marketing to help inform go-to-market strategy and the roadmap for future product development.
  • Client Presentations & Site Visits: Lead client presentations and facilitate site visits; routinely present product updates and roadmap to external client stakeholders; participate in Sales finalist presentations as needed.
  • Platform & Industry Expertise: Maintain a deep understanding of CirrusMD's technical and operational set-up and how it is implemented to ensure platform optimization; stay current on company initiatives and industry trends.

SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in business or equivalent experience.
  • 5 – 7+ years of healthcare industry experience in client success, account management, consulting, sales, or other applicable area; successful selling and/or account management experience in healthcare services required.
  • Proven experience driving client outcomes and revenue growth, with executive-level relationship management experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet and exceed goals, and to work and manage clients independently.
  • Strong relationship-building, listening, and communication skills, capable of working with a variety of client stakeholders, including executives.
  • Experience managing large, complex client accounts and coordinating across multiple departments.
  • Ability to conduct executive-level presentations, facilitate group discussions, and deliver engaging product demonstrations.
  • Technically astute, with the ability to lead IT and other product-related discussions.
  • Analytical thinking, data-driven decision making, and strong problem-solving skills to proactively address client challenges.
  • A professional, resourceful, and results-driven style; well organized, detail oriented, and able to take initiative and manage multiple projects at a time.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems and client success platforms such as Salesforce.
  • Hands-on, strong team player, and fully accountable for delivering agreed-upon performance metrics.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% — cyclical depending on client needs.
  • Protect and take care of our company and member's data every day by committing to work within our company ethics and policies.
  • Experience with self-insured employers
  • Experience working with national broker and consulting houses

COMPENSATION

Compensation will be earned as a combination of the following:

  • Salary
  • Variable compensation
    • *Up to 100% of base salary can be earned
  • Health and other benefits
  • 401(k), including company match

What's in it for you:

CirrusMD is paving the way to a better healthcare future and our work truly matters! Our solution is exceptionally accessible, instantly available, and simply scalable. If you are looking to make a lasting impact where your voice matters, consider joining our team and help us deliver care without barriers. We take the health and happiness of our employees seriously and offer great benefits including:
  • Competitive compensation
  • Deeply subsidized medical, dental & vision insurance for you and your family
  • Unlimited PTO / Vacation
  • 401(K) + match
  • Paid maternity & paternity leave
  • Remote friendly
  • Growth opportunity
  • A positive, collaborative and diverse culture
  • Social events onsite & remote
  • Free, unlimited access to our text-first platform

Reasonable Accommodation:

Should you require reasonable accommodation(s) to participate in the application/interview/selection process, or in order to complete the essential duties of the position upon acceptance of a job offer, click here to submit a recruitment accommodation request.

Recruiting Scams:

Unfortunately, scams targeting job seekers are common. To protect our candidates, we want to remind you that authorized representatives of Quantum Health will only contact you from an email address ending in @quantum-health.com. Quantum Health will never ask for personally identifiable information such as Date of Birth (DOB), Social Security Number (SSN), banking/direct/tax details, etc. via email or any other non-secure system, nor will we instruct you to make any purchases related to your employment. If you believe you’ve encountered a recruiting scam, report it to the Federal Trade Commission and your state’s Attorney General.

California Employee and Job Applicant Notice of Collection of Personal Information:

If you are a California resident, Quantum Health may collect personal information in connection with your application for employment and, if hired, during the course of your employment. The categories of personal information collected and the purposes for which that information is used are described in our California Employee and Job Applicant Notice of Collection of Personal Information.

Please review the notice here:

California Employee and Job Applicant Notice

Use of Technology Notice:

Quantum Health and its authorized service providers may contact applicants by email, phone, and text message about their application and related employment opportunities. Text messages may cover application status, interview invitations, and reminders, and applicants will have the option to opt out at any time. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply.

Quantum Health uses AI-assisted recruiting technology to support communication, scheduling, and candidate evaluation, including tools that may review application materials and analyze recorded interviews. These tools assist our recruiting team; final employment decisions are made by human reviewers. Applicants who will be interviewed using these tools receive advance notice describing the technology and what it evaluates, are asked for permission before the interview is recorded or analyzed, and may request deletion of their recording.

You will bring deep RCM sales experience, an established network of healthcare executive relationships, and the ability to position subscription-based advisory and technology-enabled services that solve complex revenue cycle and margin improvement challenges.
If you are energized by building pipeline, opening doors through your network, and helping healthcare organizations improve financial sustainability, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact with a respected advisory partner backed by the scale and innovation of Netsmart.
Why McBee, a Netsmart Company
McBee, a Netsmart company, is a trusted advisory partner to healthcare organizations navigating some of the industry’s most complex financial and operational challenges. Backed by Netsmart’s scale, market presence, and commitment to innovation, McBee offers the credibility of an established healthcare leader with the agility of a growing consulting and advisory business. Bold • Passionate • Relentless • Collaborative

Centric Software is the global leader in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) solutions for the retail, fashion, footwear, luxury, and consumer goods industries. Our enterprise software enables brands to efficiently manage product development from concept to production, improving speed, quality, and profitability.

Job Summary:

We are looking for a highly experienced Enterprise Sales Executive to join our growing team and lead the sales of our innovative PLM solutions across the EuroCentral region.

As the Enterprise Sales Executive, you will be responsible for driving revenue and building strategic relationships with large enterprise organizations across the EuroCentralregion.You will promote Centric Software’s next-generation PLM solutions, helping leading brands optimize complex product development processes and accelerate time-to-market.

This role is suited for a senior sales professional with a strong background in enterprise software sales and a proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles. You will play a critical role in shaping long-term partnerships, navigating large-scale opportunities, and delivering high-value solutions to global organizations.

Responsibilities:

  • Ownership of revenue generation within the assigned territory, as well as the quality and strength of executive relationships.
  • Lead in-depth, enterprise-level sales presentations of the full Centric PLM Solution suite.
  • Drive complex, multi-stakeholder solution sales cycles from prospecting through to deal closure.
  • Identify, qualify, and develop enterprise opportunities where Centric PLM Solutions deliver measurable business value.
  • Analyze customer business requirements and develop tailored sales strategies and solution proposals.
  • Produce high-quality written proposals, business cases, and commercial quotations.
  • Lead and contribute to RFI/RFP/RFQ responses for large-scale opportunities.
  • Collaborate closely with technical and delivery teams to align solutions with customer technology landscapes.
  • Consistently meet and exceed assigned revenue targets.
  • Represent Centric Software at regional and international trade shows, industry events, and conferences.

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of proven success in enterprise software sales, ideally within PLM or related enterprise applications (ERP, MRP, SCM, CRM).
  • Fluency in both German and English required; additional languages are a strong advantage
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, long sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting and exceeding high-value annual quotas.
  • Experience closing large-scale software deals (typically €1,000,000 + contract values).
  • Strong presence with the ability to deliver impactful presentations to senior leadership audiences.
  • Proven expertise in new account development and enterprise prospecting.
  • Strong commercial and business acumen with experience in value-based or solution selling methodologies.
  • Experience preparing and leading RFI/RFP responses for enterprise opportunities.
  • Ability to build trusted, multi-level relationships internally and with customers.
  • Adaptability to a fast-paced, evolving technology and commercial environment.
  • Industry knowledge in apparel, retail, or FMCG is highly desirable.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • A multifaceted role with a high degree of responsibility and a broad spectrum of opportunities.
  • Opportunity to work remotely with a dedicated and motivated international team.
  • A collaborative, flexible, and respectful work environment.
  • Varied and challenging work to support your continued professional and technical development.

raw.excerpt: In the early 1900s, Sergei Diaghilev transformed ballet by bringing together extraordinary artists across disciplines.
raw.description:
In the early 1900s, Sergei Diaghilev transformed ballet by bringing together extraordinary artists across disciplines. He paired Stravinsky with Picasso, Coco Chanel with choreographers, composers with painters. He wasn’t the person on stage, but he created the conditions that made extraordinary work possible. Every production demanded creative ambition, difficult tradeoffs, relentless coordination, and uncompromising standards.

Great creative production feels a lot like that.

Mercury is building a financial company that people genuinely love to use. We’re combining thoughtful design, technology, and AI to make financial workflows simpler, more powerful, and more human. Our Brand Creative team exists to bring that ambition to life through everything we make.

We’re looking for our first Executive Producer to establish Creative Production as a core capability within Brand Creative. You’ll lead production across our most ambitious campaigns and projects while building the systems and external network that allow exceptional creative work to happen again and again.

You see production as a creative discipline. You know how to protect bold ideas, challenge underdeveloped briefs, make difficult tradeoffs, and bring clarity to complexity. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who wants to build the function while still personally producing our biggest creative bets.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Own production across Brand Creative campaigns and projects, balancing priorities, capacity, staffing, budgets, timelines, and risk across multiple concurrent initiatives.
