Job Description:

Toppan Merrill is a global technology leader committed to simplifying the complexity of regulatory disclosure and communications. Our industry leading technology is backed by what we are best known for: unmatched market expertise and unparalleled customer service. Toppan Merrill is a leading partner for the financial, legal, health and capital markets.

At Toppan Merrill, you will find a culture that will encourage, empower and challenge your unique qualities to enable you to reach your full potential. Toppan Merrill leadership is committed to inspire and help you reach that potential. You'll work with dynamic colleagues, experts in their fields, who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients, who are at the heart of everything we do.

Learn more at . About Toppan Merrill

The Opportunity

We are seeking a strategic, consultative Enterprise Sales Executive to drive new business and expand existing client relationships within financial services. This is not a transactional sales role.

Success in this position requires the ability to:

  • Sell complex, multi-year solution engagements
  • Navigate enterprise buying groups (Legal, Compliance, Marketing, Operations, IT)
  • Position Toppan Merrill as a transformation partner, not a vendor
  • Connect upstream content workflows to downstream delivery and analytics outcomes

You will lead clients through the modernization of their regulatory communications ecosystem—delivering measurable business value, risk reduction, and operational efficiency.

What You’ll Do

Strategic Selling & Revenue Growth

  • Develop and execute territory and account strategies focused on landing and expanding enterprise clients
  • Originate, structure, and close multi-year, multi-solution agreements across the regulatory content lifecycle
  • Build and manage a qualified pipeline aligned to long-term revenue targets
  • Lead complex deal cycles, including commercial structuring, negotiation, and executive alignment

Solution & Value-Based Selling

  • Diagnose client challenges across:
    • Content creation and data management
    • Regulatory filing (including ICC requirements)
    • Composition and document automation
    • Omnichannel delivery (eDelivery, print, mail)
    • Reporting, analytics, and compliance oversight
  • Position integrated solutions that connect:
    • Upstream systems (content, data, conversion)
    • Midstream processes (composition, compliance, governance)
    • Downstream delivery & insights
  • Articulate a clear business case and ROI, including cost savings, risk mitigation, and scalability

Executive Engagement

  • Build trusted relationships with C-level and senior stakeholders
  • Facilitate executive workshops and discovery sessions to uncover transformation opportunities
  • Align internal and client-side stakeholders around shared outcomes and success metrics

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Solution Consulting, Product, Delivery, and Marketing to design and deliver compelling solutions
  • Lead internal deal teams to ensure alignment, differentiation, and competitive positioning
  • Provide voice-of-customer feedback to influence product roadmap and go-to-market strategy

Market & Industry Leadership

  • Maintain deep understanding of:
    • Regulatory environments in financial services
    • Industry trends in content management, automation, and digital communications
  • Represent Toppan Merrill in industry events, client forums, and thought leadership engagements

Who You Are

  • A hunter with a strategist’s mindset—you pursue net-new opportunities but win through insight, not volume
  • A solution seller, comfortable navigating ambiguity and building tailored approaches
  • Skilled in orchestrating complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and buying centers
  • Able to connect technology capabilities to business outcomes
  • A strong communicator who can translate technical concepts into executive-level value
  • Collaborative, team-oriented, and driven by customer success and long-term partnerships

Qualifications & Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise sales, preferably in SaaS, RegTech, FinTech, or document/content solutions.
  • Proven track record of:
    • Closing large, complex, multi-year deals
    • Selling into financial services organizations
  • Experience engaging with Legal, Compliance, Operations, Technology, and Marketing stakeholders
  • Demonstrated success in consultative / value-based selling methodologies
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred

What Sets This Role Apart

  • The ability to work in an environment that encourages creativity and fresh ideas
  • Opportunity to sell end-to-end solutions, not point products
  • Direct impact on helping clients modernize their regulatory communications ecosystem
  • Alignment to a long-term platform vision (Quinn) while delivering immediate client value
  • Backed by deep domain expertise and a trusted brand in regulated markets
  • The opportunity to join a growing company that has just finished a record year of the highest results
  • The environment and culture to showcase your talent, sharpen your skills, and develop new capabilities, and be a part of a global team that develops revotionary technologies.

Compensation & Benefits

We understand that your skills deserve recognition. That's why we offer a competitive base pay scale ranging from $115,000 – $135,000 annually, based on experience and expertise. Additional pay, including commissions and bonuses are available based on performance. We believe in compensating our dedicated team members fairly for their hard work and commitment. Please note that actual salaries may vary within, above, or below this range based on factors such as education, training, experience, professional achievement, business needs, and location.

Toppan Merrill strives to provide our employees and loved ones with competitive benefits including:

A central purpose of the role is to serve as the GM’s “external memory”—maintaining one reliable view of emails, requests, delegated work, unanswered questions, deadlines, and commitments so important matters do not disappear between meetings or communication channels.

What You Will Own

  • Own and continuously optimize the GM’s calendar based on business priorities.
  • Review upcoming days and weeks for conflicts, deadlines, preparation needs, missing meetings, and unresolved commitments.
  • Prepare concise agendas, background information, open decisions, and recommended next steps.

  • Maintain one trusted system for requests, delegated items, promised responses, open questions, and leadership commitments across email, Teams, meetings, and conversations.
  • Review sent emails and open conversations for missing responses or conclusions, then resurface them before they are forgotten.
  • Follow up until each important item is completed, deferred, canceled, or otherwise closed.
  • Coordinate priorities and follow-through across sales, marketing, operations, finance, and leadership.
  • Draft clear executive communications, summaries, briefings, and action lists.
  • Identify recurring scheduling, accountability, and workflow problems and recommend practical solutions.
  • Handle personnel, financial, operational, and strategic information with exceptional discretion.
  • Use Microsoft 365 and AI tools responsibly to improve executive productivity and automate repetitive workflows.

Required Qualifications

Role Summary:

As Executive Assistant to the CTO, you are the glue, guru, and playmaker for a ~350-person R&D organization spanning Engineering and Product. In this high-impact role, you will act as a trusted right hand, decision-maker, and primary administrative operator for the CTO, while also providing targeted operational and calendar support for other senior R&D leaders across the organization.

You will be the key operational cross-functional connector across Technology. Individual contributors, managers, directors, and executives will look to you for direction. Success in this role requires mastering calendar architecture, proactive problem-solving, project coordination, budget tracking, and building strong relationships across the company.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Executive Calendar Architecture: Master complex, high-context calendar management for the CTO, balancing shifting priorities, strategic working blocks, and urgent requests.
  • R&D Leadership Support: Provide high-leverage calendar and operational assistance to key senior R&D leaders (VPs, EVPs, and Chief Architect) on an as-needed basis.

  • End-to-End Travel Management: Oversee all travel bookings, itineraries, and preferences for the CTO via Navan from start to finish.
  • Expense & Policy Compliance: Process receipts and expense reports in Ramp, ensuring strict adherence to company policy (e.g., calculating fare differences between premium cabins and standard economy).
  • Budget Tracking & Visibility: Track the annual training allocations and per-person travel budgets across tribe leaders, while maintaining real-time visibility into offsites via Budget vs. Actual (BvA) trackers.
  • Demo Day Coordination: Co-host/coordinate the weekly Friday Demo Day program, maintaining multi-tribe rotation calendars and publishing weekly presenter announcements.

    • Experience: 3+ years as an EA supporting VP/C-level executives, ideally in a fast-paced technology, SaaS, or AI environment.

    • Tool Proficiency:

      • Core Suite: Google Workspace (Sheets, Forms, Docs, Drive), MS Outlook/Exchange, Slack, Zoom.

      • Travel & Expense Systems: Navan, Ramp.

      • Ops & Collaboration: Guru, Claude/AI tooling, Lattice, Gong.

      • Operational Mindset: Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail, strong calendar prioritization skills, and ability to navigate matrixed org structures.

raw.excerpt: Job Profile SummaryThe GPUaaS Acquisition / New Pursuits Sales Executive is a senior individual contributor responsible for creating and closing net-new GPU as a Service business.
raw.description:
Job Profile Summary

The GPUaaS Acquisition / New Pursuits Sales Executive is a senior individual contributor responsible for creating and closing net-new GPU as a Service business. The role owns the full pursuit lifecycle - target-account identification, outbound prospecting, opportunity qualification, discovery, solution orchestration, commercial strategy, proposal, negotiation, contracting, and booking - with a primary focus on new logos and material new GPU workloads. The executive acts as the single-threaded sales owner for assigned pursuits and mobilizes Rackspace GPUaaS specialists, solution architecture, Product, Capacity/Operations, Finance, Legal, Delivery, and strategic ecosystem partners to win complex accelerated-compute opportunities.

Role Mission

Create net-new demand and convert qualified enterprise AI, training, inference, HPC, and accelerated-compute opportunities into profitable GPUaaS bookings. Build a focused pursuit engine that prioritizes high-value accounts and workloads, maintains sufficient qualified pipeline coverage, advances opportunities with urgency and discipline, and wins based on customer outcomes, technical fit, capacity availability, commercial competitiveness, and execution credibility.

Career Level Summary

  • Operates as a senior P5 individual contributor and expert seller for complex GPUaaS pursuits; no people-management responsibility is required.
  • Owns the customer relationship and sales outcome for assigned new-logo and new-pursuit opportunities from first engagement through contract execution and handoff.
  • Leads cross-functional pursuit teams through influence and establishes clear owners, actions, dates, decision criteria, and close plans.
  • Uses customer, workload, competitive, capacity, financial, and pipeline data to determine where to invest pursuit resources and when to qualify out.
  • Contributes field intelligence to GPUaaS GTM strategy, including ideal customer profile, use cases, competitive positioning, pricing signals, buying patterns, and product/capacity requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own an assigned GPUaaS bookings quota and deliver profitable net-new bookings consistent with approved pricing, capacity, contractual, and gross-margin guardrails.
  • Build and maintain a prioritized target-account and workload list focused on organizations with credible accelerated-compute demand, funding, timing, technical fit, and buying authority.
  • Generate new opportunities through direct outbound pursuit, executive networks, marketing-generated demand, strategic technology partners such as AMD and NVIDIA, channel/referral partners, ecosystem relationships, and customer introductions.
  • Qualify opportunities rigorously across workload/use case, GPU platform requirements, cluster size, geography, capacity timing, term, commercial value, decision process, competition, funding, and customer urgency before committing material pursuit resources.
  • Lead customer discovery and translate business and technical requirements into a clear pursuit strategy and differentiated GPUaaS value proposition.
  • Orchestrate Solution Architecture, Product, Engineering, Capacity/Operations, Delivery, Finance, Legal, Security, and executive sponsors to develop executable customer solutions and proposals.
  • Develop and maintain a written close plan for material pursuits, including customer decision criteria, buying process, technical validation, commercial milestones, competition, risks, executive relationships, next actions, owners, and dates.
  • Own proposal, bid/RFP, pricing, negotiation, and contracting strategy in partnership with Finance, Legal, Deal Desk, and GPUaaS leadership; protect approved economics while maximizing probability of close.
  • Create multithreaded customer relationships across economic buyer, technical buyer, procurement, finance, legal, infrastructure/AI leadership, and executive sponsors.
  • Use AMD, NVIDIA, OEM, ISV, channel, and other ecosystem relationships strategically when they improve access, technical credibility, solution differentiation, or probability of winning the pursuit.
  • Maintain accurate CRM data and forecast discipline, including source, stage, amount, term, probability, close date, capacity requirement, next step, blockers, and forecast category.
  • Inspect pipeline weekly for stage movement, aging, qualification quality, capacity alignment, competitive risk, and gap-to-goal; proactively create new pipeline when coverage or conversion is insufficient.
  • Ensure clean transition of booked business to implementation/delivery and the designated post-sale owner while remaining engaged through critical launch milestones when necessary to protect customer confidence and expansion potential.
  • Capture win/loss insights and feed recurring customer, competitive, pricing, product, capacity, and contracting themes back into the GPUaaS operating model.

Knowledge

  • Expert-level enterprise acquisition selling and complex pursuit management, including prospecting, qualification, discovery, executive selling, negotiation, contracting, and closing.
  • Strong working knowledge of GPUaaS, accelerated computing, AI/ML training and inference, HPC, cloud/data-center infrastructure, and the commercial drivers of enterprise AI infrastructure purchases.
  • Working knowledge of GPU platforms and ecosystem participants such as AMD, NVIDIA, OEM/server vendors, ISVs, integrators, channel partners, cloud providers, and GPU/neocloud providers; sufficient depth to position value and orchestrate technical experts without acting as the primary solution architect.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including bookings, ACV/TCV, contract term, consumption/commit constructs, pricing, sold gross margin, capacity economics, deal risk, and approval guardrails.
  • Expert knowledge of opportunity qualification, pipeline management, CRM discipline, forecasting, account/pursuit planning, and competitive strategy.
  • Understanding of data-center capacity, deployment timing, power/cooling constraints, networking, storage, software stack, and service-readiness considerations that can materially affect GPUaaS pursuits.

Skills

  • New-logo acquisition and outbound prospecting
  • Complex enterprise / strategic pursuit selling
  • Consultative and value-based selling
  • GPUaaS / AI infrastructure market fluency
  • Executive selling and multithreading
  • Opportunity qualification and qualification-out discipline
  • Pipeline creation, management, and forecasting
  • Commercial strategy, pricing, and negotiation
  • RFP/proposal and competitive pursuit leadership
  • Cross-functional pursuit orchestration
  • CRM/Salesforce discipline and analytics
  • Executive presentations and customer workshops
  • Close planning, action ownership, and deal velocity

Experience

  • 12-14 years of relevant enterprise technology sales experience, consistent with the P5 Professional Master level.
  • Demonstrated record of personally originating and closing complex, material new-logo enterprise technology transactions as an individual contributor.
  • Experience selling cloud infrastructure, data-center services, AI infrastructure, GPU/accelerated compute, HPC, managed infrastructure, or similarly complex consumption/capacity-based technology strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to build pipeline rather than relying solely on inherited accounts or inbound opportunities.
  • Experience leading complex cross-functional pursuits involving technical validation, capacity/operations, finance, legal, procurement, security, and executive stakeholders.
  • Experience competing against hyperscalers, GPU/neocloud providers, infrastructure providers, or other enterprise technology alternatives is preferred.
  • No people-management responsibility is required; success is measured through individual bookings, pipeline creation, pursuit execution, and commercial outcomes.

Education / Certifications

Bachelor's degree preferred in business, technology, engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may substitute. Relevant cloud, AI, infrastructure, or sales certifications are a plus but not required.

Travel

Domestic and international travel as required for customer pursuits, executive meetings, workshops, partner engagements, industry events, and negotiations; travel intensity will vary by territory and active pursuit portfolio and may exceed 50% during major pursuits.

Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as our next Strategic Account Executive for High Tech Accounts!

Twilio powers real-time business communications and data solutions that help companies and developers worldwide build better applications and customer experiences.

Although we're headquartered in San Francisco, we have presence throughout South America, Europe, Asia and Australia. We're on a journey to becoming a globally anti-racist, anti-oppressive, anti-bias company that actively opposes racism and all forms of oppression and bias. At Twilio, we support diversity, equity & inclusion wherever we do business. We employ thousands of Twilions worldwide, and we're looking for more builders, creators, and visionaries to help fuel our growth momentum.

About the job

We are expanding our team and growth within the High Tech Vertical by adding an experienced Strategic Account Executive. Our team is committed to helping our High Tech clients create frictionless engagement experiences for the customers they serve.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Manage and strategically expand relationships with our High Tech customer accounts.
  • Develop, drive, and execute account strategy to consistently deliver strong revenue, gross margin, and gross profit results across your High Tech account portfolio.
  • Drive the entire sales process from prospecting to deal closure, including launch.
  • Run highly consultative sales cycles with a focus on deep discovery, understanding their business, listening to customer needs and being an effective champion for their point of view in the organization.
  • Understand the customer’s technical requirements and map them to the capabilities of Twilio’s communications API platform so that together you can design a solution for their specific use case needs.
  • Effectively communicate with all levels of the customer organization such as developers, managers, and executives. Our customers are often software engineers, application owners, product managers, line of business executives, VP’s of innovation, omni-channel and digital strategy stakeholders.
  • Serve on a cross-functional account team with representatives from product, finance, partners, support, and services teams.
  • Run a disciplined forecast, consistently achieve goals, and present guidance to executive management.

    Qualifications

    Not all applicants will have skills that match a job description exactly. Twilio values diverse experiences in other industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. While having “desired” qualifications make for a strong candidate, we encourage applicants with alternative experiences to also apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

    Required:

    • Possess a total of 8 years of sales experience, with a minimum of 3 years dedicated to major account or strategic sales and a track record of selling complex technical solutions.
    • Familiarity with Twilio ecosystem of Tools: Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn SalesNav, ZoomInfo, Looker, Tableau, G-Suite, Gong
    • Accountable for relationship management, cross sells, upsells and solutions consulting.
    • Comfortable working with business and highly technical leaders, while influencing their understanding and building supportive partnerships.
    • Analytical account development strategy based on using data to find opportunities and prove value.
    • Demonstrated success by exceeding quota on a consistent basis.
    • Demonstrated track record of managing business forecasts and financial models.
    • Entrepreneurial mindset with appetite to define processes and build programs.
    • Ethical. Hands on. Passionate. Creative. Team-player.
    • Eager to deliver excellence.
    • Excellent verbal and written communication & presentation skills.Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent years of experience.

    Desired:


    • Domain expertise from a highly quantitative industry such as DevOps, Fintech, advertising optimization, investment banking, security or commodity trading especially in non-standard segments.
    • Software, SaaS, CPaas or PaaS selling experience.
    • Deep experience working with telecom companies, including SMS aggregators, carriers, or global communications platforms (CPaaS or PaaS)
    • Experience selling API based solutions

    Location

    • This role will be remote.
    • Approximately 15% travel is anticipated.

    What We Offer

    There are many benefits to working at Twilio, including, in addition to competitive pay, things like generous time-off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

    Twilio thinks big. Do you?

    We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

    So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now!

    If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of Colorado, California, New York, Washington and Washington D.C. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.

    Compensation

    The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

    *Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.

    The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

    • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Minnesota or Vermont : $132,192 - $165,240.
    • Based in Washington D.C., Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay Area): $139,536 - $174,420.
    • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or the San Francisco Bay area, California: $X146,880 - $183,600.
    • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.
    • This role is eligible to earn commissions.

    The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

    Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until Nov 1, 2026 but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

raw.description:
Company Overview

See

Job Summary

We are seeking a Strategic Account Executive to originate, shape, and close transformational software partnerships with leading utilities. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a commercial builder who can create opportunity from ambiguity, lead a complex 6-12+ month enterprise sale, and earn credibility from the executive suite through technical, operational, procurement, legal, and regulatory stakeholders.

You will own account strategy and the commercial relationship for approximately 5–7 named Tier 1 utilities. You will build the business case, coordinate the full Gigawatt pursuit team, close an initial deployment, and remain accountable for major module and platform expansion. The role reports to GTM leadership and works closely across Gigawatt teams.

Key Responsibilities

Own named-account strategy and revenue: Develop and execute account plans for a focused portfolio of strategic utilities, with clear pathways from executive access and qualified opportunity through initial close and multi-module expansion.

Build pipeline from the ground up: Create opportunities through targeted outreach, industry relationships, partners, events, and insight-led engagement; maintain sufficient pipeline coverage to deliver against annual and multi-year revenue goals.

Lead the end-to-end enterprise sale: Drive discovery, qualification, solution shaping, value engineering, commercial proposals, RFI/RFP responses, procurement, negotiation, and contracting through close.

Multi-thread complex buying committees: Build trusted relationships across executive sponsors, operational and functional leaders, technology and security teams, procurement, finance, legal, and other key influencers. Identify champions, blockers, decision criteria, and the path to approval

Quarterback the opportunity team: Bring Product, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Services, Partnerships, and executives into each pursuit at the right time. Establish clear roles, next steps, decision gates, and accountability.

Navigate utility markets: Leverage deep understanding of utility procurement cycles, regulatory dynamics, long sales cycles, and risk-averse decision-making to shorten time-to-value and win strategic accounts.

Forecast with discipline: Maintain accurate CRM data, opportunity plans, mutual action plans, pipeline reporting, and forecasts. Surface risks early and bring a clear point of view on how to create momentum.

Bring the market back into Gigawatt: Translate customer feedback, competitive intelligence, procurement patterns, and regulatory or market developments into actionable input for product strategy, positioning, and the GTM playbook.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of enterprise software sales experience, with a strong track record of originating and closing net-new business.
  • Demonstrated success personally closing complex, multi-year, seven-figure platform or transformation agreements with large enterprises.
  • Ability to build compelling business cases, quantify value, and communicate effectively with board-level, executive, operational, and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong strategic account-planning skills, including identifying champions, economic buyers, decision-makers, and potential sources of resistance.
  • Technical curiosity and ability to develop fluency in an AI-native, data-intensive platform and its role within a customer's enterprise architecture.
  • Builder’s mindset with the ability to operate with pace, ambiguity, limited playbooks, and high personal accountability in an early-stage environment.
  • Excellent written, presentation, negotiation, and executive communication skills.
  • Experience with modern CRM, pipeline management, and rigorous forecasting practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling into utilities, energy, or other regulated and infrastructure-intensive industries such as telecom, government/public sector, or similar.
  • Existing relationships and executive network within utilities and/or energy.
  • Experience selling AI, data, cloud, or other technically complex enterprise platforms.
  • Experience within a high-growth, early-stage or scale-up software company.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree is a plus.

Location

  • Remote but Chicago, Austin, Nashville are preferred.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and equity package.
  • Opportunity to shape a transformative AI product in a vital industry working with a rock-star team.
  • Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, remote work flexibility, and 401k match.
  • Collaborative culture focused on innovation and impact.
  • If you are passionate about the future of AI in utilities, apply today!

Position: Executive Assistant to the CEO
Number of hours: 20 hours/week
Schedule: IST

Tasks required:

  • Provide high-level confidential administrative support to the CEO first and foremost, and the Senior Leadership team as required.

  • Manage and maintain CEO's extremely active calendar of appointments, schedules and travel arrangements.

  • Screen CEO's emails, archive and professionally compose replies/correspondence on behalf of the CEO when required.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact between executives and internal/external stakeholders, including screening and prioritizing emails and phone calls

  • Plan, book, and organize complex domestic and international travel itineraries, including flights, accommodations, and ground transportation as needed

  • Prepare and edit reports, presentations, and documents, while maintaining an organized filing system for easy retrieval

  • Assist in preparing meeting agendas, taking meeting minutes, and ensuring timely distribution of materials to participants

  • Provide project support by conducting research, gathering data, and assisting with project coordination and follow-ups

  • Handle sensitive and confidential information with the utmost discretion and professionalism

  • Proactively identify and resolve administrative issues, demonstrating a solution-oriented approach

  • Collaborate effectively with other team members and departments to ensure seamless workflow and the achievement of organizational goals

  • Other ad hoc tasks that would be assigned

Requirements:

  • Must have 3 years of proven work experience as a Virtual Executive Assistant to the President/CEO or a relevant role

  • Familiarity with current technologies, like desktop sharing, cloud services and VoIP (G Suite, Zoe, Basecamp, Zoom, Slack, Asana, Notion, etc.)

  • Strong proficiency in office software and communication tools

  • Knowledge of online calendars and scheduling (Calendly, Google Calendar)

  • Expert level written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to ask clarifying questions and work with senior management, internal and external clients.

  • Strong organizational skills that reflect the ability to perform and prioritize multiple tasks seamlessly with excellent attention to detail.

  • Discretion and the ability to handle confidential information

  • Excellent phone, email and instant messaging communication skills

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented; able to efficiently prioritize multiple tasks

  • Adaptability and a proactive mindset

  • Professional demeanor and strong interpersonal skills

  • Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented environment

  • Self-disciplined and organized; able to consistently hit daily and monthly targets with limited supervision

raw.description:
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Executive, AI Solutions Product Leader - REMOTE to join our team in Plano, Texas (US-TX), United States (US).

Role Overview

NTT DATA is building AI Service-as-Software as a new product-led growth engine and one of the company's key strategic bets. We are seeking an Executive, AI Solutions Product Leader to stand up dedicated executive product leadership for the AI Solutions Platform, three industry-focused AI products, and shared platform capabilities.

This role will shape and execute the AI Service-as-Software product agenda, directly driving a strategic bet in partnership with NTT DATA AI Vista. The leader will translate AI strategy into a scalable, repeatable product portfolio with clear roadmaps, strong product maturity, improved platform reuse, commercialization-ready offerings, and disciplined product operating practices.

This is not a traditional Product Owner or consulting delivery role. It is an executive product leadership role focused on moving NTT DATA from bespoke AI services toward repeatable, platform-led AI Native growth.

What You Will Lead

  • AI Solutions Platform product strategy and roadmap, including reusable horizontal capabilities across industries.
  • Three industry-focused AI products, led by Senior Director-level Product Owners, with shared product standards and operating discipline.
  • Shared platform capabilities such as agent orchestration, knowledge grounding, workflow automation, data integration, model management, governance, and enterprise integration.
  • Product packaging and commercialization support, working closely with AI Vista, AI Market Makers, global industry teams, regional sales, and AI delivery.
  • A lean, high-impact product organization in a product job family that is new to NTT DATA and requires scarce AI product, industry, and platform leadership capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Shape Product Portfolio Strategy

  • Define and refine the product strategy for the AI Solutions Platform and three industry-focused AI products.
  • Translate the AI Service-as-Software ambition into a clear portfolio roadmap, product maturity milestones, and execution priorities.
  • Recommend portfolio sequencing, business cases, and investment priorities for executive review.
  • Assess client needs, market demand, AI platform trends, competitive dynamics, regulatory considerations, and commercial relevance to inform product direction.
  • Translate the AI Service-as-Software ambition into a clear portfolio roadmap, product maturity milestones, and execution priorities.
  • Recommend portfolio sequencing, business cases, and investment priorities for executive review.
  • Assess client needs, market demand, AI platform trends, competitive dynamics, regulatory considerations, and commercial relevance to inform product direction.

Lead Product Leaders

  • Lead, coach, and develop Senior Director-level Product Owners responsible for industry products and shared platform capabilities.
  • Set expectations for product strategy, discovery, roadmap quality, execution discipline, stakeholder alignment, and product performance.
  • Build a consistent product operating model across the portfolio, including governance rhythms, roadmap standards, product reviews, metrics, and escalation paths.
  • Develop product leadership capability in a job family that is strategically important and not historically common at NTT DATA.

Guide Platform Product Execution

  • Guide the roadmap and execution of the horizontal AI Solutions Platform in partnership with Product Engineering, AI/ML, architecture, cloud, security, and delivery teams.
  • Define reusable platform capabilities that can be leveraged across industries and client environments.
  • Promote a 70% standardized / 30% configurable model to improve repeatability, scalability, deployment speed, and margin potential.
  • Ensure products are designed for enterprise-grade security, reliability, usability, compliance, operational readiness, and integration into client environments.

Support Commercialization and Growth

  • Improve product-led commercialization through packaging inputs, pricing inputs, sales enablement, product narratives, demos, and executive client positioning.
  • Support strategic pursuits where AI Service-as-Software products are central to the opportunity.
  • Partner with AI Vista, AI Market Makers, global industry leaders, regional sales, finance, marketing, delivery, and product engineering stakeholders.
  • Help directly drive the $125M current-year AI Service-as-Software strategic bet while sales targets, delivery revenue ownership, and client delivery accountability remain with business, sales, and delivery leadership.

Convert Market Learning into Product Reuse

  • Work with Forward Deployed Engineering, delivery teams, industry leaders, sales teams, and strategic clients to identify repeatable AI use cases.
  • Determine which client-specific patterns should be recommended for productization as shared capabilities, templates, accelerators, or platform services.
  • Ensure field insights and client adoption data inform roadmap updates, platform improvements, launch readiness, and industry product evolution.

Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in enterprise product leadership, AI platforms, digital platforms, enterprise software, productized services, or cross-industry solution development.
  • Experience leading senior product leaders or cross-functional product teams in complex, matrixed environments.
  • Proven ability to shape and scale product portfolios, platform capabilities, or enterprise solution offerings.
  • Strong understanding of AI, GenAI, agentic workflows, enterprise data platforms, cloud ecosystems, model lifecycle management, integration architecture, and enterprise software delivery.
  • Experience working across product, engineering, architecture, sales, delivery, finance, marketing, and senior executive stakeholders.

Job Title: Precision Medicine Executive, Rare Blood Disorders Mid-Atlantic


  • Location: Remote/ US

About the Job


The Precision Medicine Executive, Rare Blood Disease is a field-based commercial role focused on encouraging diagnostic testing and enhancing patient identification for systemic mastocytosis and future precision medicine therapies within Sanofi’s portfolio. This individual will partner with key accounts, diagnostic laboratories, and cross-functional Sanofi teams to support disease education, testing adoption, and account-level execution aligned to business and patient needs.


Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi:


We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve lives.

Main Responsibilities

  • Build relationships with key account stakeholders, including pathology, laboratory, clinical, and executive decision-makers, to support appropriate diagnostic testing and patient identification.
  • Develop and execute account plans that advance high-quality diagnostic, biomarker, and genomic testing aligned to Rare Blood Disease priorities.
  • Educate stakeholders on systemic mastocytosis, diagnostic pathways, and the role of precision medicine in patient care.
  • Partner with commercial, medical, marketing, access, and field teams to deliver approved education, resources, and account-level initiatives.
  • Identify and communicate customer needs, market insights, diagnostic barriers, and opportunities to improve testing pathways.
  • Serve as a regional subject matter expert for diagnostics and precision medicine in systemic mastocytosis and future applicable therapies.
  • Represent Sanofi at relevant local, regional, and national congresses and customer-facing forums in accordance with company policies.
  • Maintain compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements, healthcare laws, Sanofi Code of Conduct, and EBI Guidance

About You

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 5+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, biotechnology, or related life sciences industries and in diagnostics or precision medicine
  • Ability to travel regularly within the assigned geography.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree in life sciences, medicine, pharmacy, business, or a related field.
  • Background in pathology, molecular biology, diagnostics, hematology, oncology, rare disease, or precision medicine.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and planning skills with the ability to work effectively in a field-based, cross-functional environment.
  • Working knowledge of diagnostic testing, biomarker or genomic testing, and patient identification pathways.
  • Experience engaging external healthcare stakeholders and account decision-makers in complex clinical or laboratory environments.
  • Experience supporting specialty product launches, indication expansions, diagnostic strategy, or market development.
  • Understanding of diagnostic market dynamics, including reimbursement, regulatory, policy, provider, patient, and payer considerations.
  • Ability to influence without authority, build credibility, align stakeholders, and drive adoption of new approaches or technologies.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with a patient-focused and compliance-oriented mindset.

Why choose us?


  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.​​
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.​​
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.​​
  • ·Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.

Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.

Location: This position may be performed remotely, but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.

The Opportunity

Praxis is seeking an experienced Program Executive to lead one of our high-priority development programs in earlier-stage clinical development. This leader will own the cross-functional strategy, execution, and governance required to advance a potentially best- or first-in-class therapy through proof-of-concept and key value-inflection milestones, while building a clear path toward later-stage development.

Working across Research, Development, Regulatory, Technical Operations, Translational Sciences, Medical, and other functions, you will align teams around the most important questions, translate emerging data into decisive action, and drive high-quality execution. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, challenges assumptions, and knows when to accelerate, adapt, or stop.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead the integrated program strategy and development plan through early clinical development, proof-of-concept, and preparation for later-stage development.
  • Drive cross-functional execution, governance, and decision-making against program objectives, timelines, and key scientific, clinical, and business milestones.
  • Own program strategy, budget, resource planning, and investment recommendations, including acceleration, adaptation, and go/no-go decisions.
  • Partner across Clinical Development, Research, Translational Sciences, Regulatory, Technical Operations, Medical, Biometrics, Finance, and other functions to build an integrated evidence-generation strategy.
  • Evaluate emerging clinical, translational, regulatory, competitive, and operational data to identify risks, opportunities, and alternative development paths.
  • Lead preparation for key health authority interactions and ensure alignment across clinical, regulatory, CMC, and evidence-generation strategies.
  • Represent the program with executive leadership, governance committees, partners, and external stakeholders while fostering accountability, transparency, and high performance.

Qualifications and Key Success Factors

  • Demonstrated experience leading or co-leading therapeutic programs through early clinical development and meaningful value-inflection points, including first-in-human, dose optimization, proof-of-mechanism, proof-of-concept, or transition to later-stage development.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership with accountability for integrated program strategy and execution in Phase 1 and/or Phase 2 development.
  • Direct ownership of program strategy, budgets, resource planning, governance, and investment recommendations for complex development programs.
  • Experience integrating clinical, translational, biomarker, preclinical, regulatory, and competitive evidence to make sound decisions with incomplete or evolving data.
  • Experience leading or preparing significant interactions with FDA and/or other global health authorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead matrixed teams, resolve competing perspectives, and influence senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end drug development and the ability to connect near-term decisions to long-term product and patient impact.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing therapies in CNS
  • Experience with rare disease development, biomarker-driven development, patient stratification, or innovative proof-of-concept strategies.
  • Alliance or partnership management experience.
  • Success operating in lean, fast-paced biotechnology organizations where leaders move fluidly between strategy and execution.

The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement. You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

Annualized Base Salary
$300,000—$350,000 USD

Compensation & BenefitsAt Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and their people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive.  This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans. We also provide company-paid life insurance, AD&D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future?  We match dollar-for-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long-term stock incentives and ESPP.  We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company-wide shutdowns.  Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring.  We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results.  Let’s achieve the impossible together!

Company Overview

Praxis Precision Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company translating genetic insights into the development of therapies for central nervous system disorders characterized by neuronal imbalance. At Praxis we share a common vision of reshaping the human condition into a more freeing and fulfilled existence by developing high impact medicines for patients and families affected by and living with complex brain disorders. Our core Values of Trust, Ownership, Curiosity and Results are foundational to every aspect of our business and are exemplified by each and every one of our team members.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
Guided by our core values, at Praxis Precision Medicines, Inc. we continue to DARE FOR MORE® to advance, promote, and champion diversity, equity, and inclusion by encouraging individuals to bring their authentic selves and perspectives to work each day. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to providing opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, genetics, military service and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Attention: Job Scam Alert
Praxis has recently become aware of fraudulent job recruitment postings from individuals claiming to represent Praxis. These postings seek financial information in connection with fraudulent opportunities for employment. If you suspect any fraudulent activity or misrepresentation in connection with a Praxis job opportunity, please report it to

does not accept unsolicited submissions from recruitment agencies for open positions. We ask all recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting any Praxis employee regarding any position. Position Summary

The Executive Underwriter – Professional Liability is responsible for driving profitable growth through the underwriting and management of a portfolio of Architects & Engineers (A&E) Professional Liability risks, while supporting broader Errors & Omissions (E&O) initiatives. This role evaluates complex risks, develops tailored coverage solutions, and partners closely with retail brokers to expand business opportunities and strengthen key market relationships.

The Executive Underwriter serves as a senior technical resource within the team, balancing growth and profitability objectives while partnering with underwriting leadership on portfolio strategy, broker engagement, and market development.

Location: Remote

What will your job entail?

Key Responsibilities:

Underwriting & Portfolio Management

  • Independently underwrite and manage a portfolio of Professional Liability risks, with a primary focus on Architects & Engineers accounts.

  • Evaluate small and middle market risks, including complex exposures, to ensure sound risk selection and profitable portfolio growth.

  • Analyze submissions, financial information, loss history, and operational exposures to determine appropriate pricing, coverage structure, and terms.

  • Underwrite both admitted and surplus lines business within delegated underwriting authority.

Broker & Market Development

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with retail brokers and distribution partners on a national basis.

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities within targeted markets and industry segments.

  • Negotiate pricing, coverage, and policy terms while maintaining underwriting discipline and profitability objectives.

  • Collaborate with brokers to develop solutions that meet client needs and support long-term business growth.

Strategy & Technical Expertise

  • Support underwriting leadership in executing portfolio strategies and achieving business objectives.

  • Monitor market conditions, industry trends, and competitive developments impacting Professional Liability business.

  • Contribute technical expertise related to A&E Professional Liability and other E&O products, including Accountants Professional Liability exposures.

  • Assist in the development and enhancement of underwriting guidelines, product offerings, and best practices.

Collaboration & Portfolio Performance

  • Partner with Claims, Actuarial, Product, Legal, and Compliance teams to support underwriting decisions and portfolio management.

  • Monitor portfolio performance, including premium growth, retention, profitability, and loss ratio trends.

  • Maintain accurate underwriting documentation and ensure compliance with company guidelines and regulatory requirements.

  • Provide mentorship and technical guidance to less experienced underwriting staff as needed.

Qualifications:

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Business Administration, Finance, Insurance, or a related field preferred.

  • 10+ years of Professional Liability / E&O underwriting experience.

  • Significant experience underwriting Architects & Engineers Professional Liability risks required.

  • Exposure to other Professional Liability products preferred.

  • Experience underwriting both admitted and surplus lines business.

  • Demonstrated success evaluating small and middle market accounts, including complex risks, while balancing growth and profitability objectives.

  • Established relationships with retail brokers within the Professional Liability marketplace strongly preferred.

Licenses & Certifications

  • State Property & Casualty and/or Surplus Lines license required.

  • CPCU, AU, RPLU, or other relevant insurance designations preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Deep expertise in Professional Liability and Errors & Omissions underwriting.

  • Strong understanding of Architects & Engineers risk exposures and coverage considerations.

  • Advanced risk assessment, pricing, and coverage analysis capabilities.

  • Proven relationship-building and broker management skills.

  • Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation abilities.

  • Strategic mindset with a focus on profitable growth and portfolio management.

  • Ability to work independently while serving as a senior technical partner within the team.

As the first dedicated commercial hire in Australia, you will shape the national commercial strategy, build executive relationships, and lead high-value opportunities across enterprise, government, and research institutions. You will translate customer priorities into funded programmes, commercial agreements, and long-term strategic accounts.

The role combines cloud-services revenue growth with the development and execution of complex, multi-year infrastructure deals. Working closely with APAC and global leadership, you will prioritise opportunities and direct commercial, technical, and executive resources towards sustainable growth across Australia.

Key Responsibilities:

Australian Commercial Strategy and Strategic Accounts

  • Define and execute the Australian commercial strategy, prioritising accounts, sectors, and partnerships with the strongest revenue and strategic potential.

  • Build trusted relationships with enterprise, government, research, and funding stakeholders, strengthening Quantinuum’s credibility and maintaining engagement.

  • Develop account plans that align customer objectives, investment priorities, and procurement pathways with Quantinuum’s capabilities.

  • Own opportunity qualification, revenue delivery, forecasting, and commercial execution, expanding initial engagements into long-term strategic relationships.

  • Provide market intelligence to guide strategy and investment, and mobilise global resources to progress priority opportunities with independence and accountability.

Cloud Services and Customer Expansion

  • Grow cloud-services revenue by identifying valuable customer applications and converting technical interest into paid engagements.

  • Work with customers and internal specialists to establish business cases, adoption roadmaps, and commercial models that support sustained usage.

  • Lead negotiations for cloud-access agreements, renewals, and account expansion.

  • Identify opportunities to broaden customer relationships across Quantinuum’s portfolio, including on-premises deployments where appropriate.

On-Premises Deals and Strategic Programmes

  • Originate and lead on-premises quantum computing opportunities with enterprise, government, and research customers.

  • Establish executive sponsorship, funding pathways, technical requirements, and infrastructure readiness for significant investments.

  • Coordinate technical, scientific, deployment, legal, finance, and executive leadership teams through evaluation, procurement, negotiation, and contract execution.

  • Structure high-value, multi-party and multi-year agreements, aligning customer commitments with deployment and delivery requirements.

  • Develop partnerships that strengthen proposals, enable implementation, and support long-term adoption.

You must have:

  • Demonstrated experience in strategic, complex solution sales within the scientific technology, advanced computing, or enterprise infrastructure sectors

  • Experience navigating technical evaluations, public-sector procurement, funding processes, and multi-stakeholder decisions.

  • Demonstrated success leading strategic technology sales and closing complex, high-value agreements in Australia.

  • Experience developing executive relationships across enterprise, government, and research organisations.

  • A track record of growing cloud or platform-services revenue and progressing infrastructure or on-premises opportunities.

  • Strong commercial judgment, including account prioritisation, business-case development, deal structuring, and negotiation.

  • Ability to lead cross-functional deal teams and influence senior stakeholders without direct reporting authority.

  • Disciplined pipeline management and forecasting, combined with the adaptability required to build a new market.

  • Ability to work independently in an emerging market while collaborating effectively within a global matrix organisation.

  • Ability and willingness to travel regularly within Australiaand internationally as required.

  • National computing programmes, research infrastructure, or strategic government technology investments.

  • Established customer, government, research, and partner networks across Australia.

raw.description:
About Concord Technologies

Our fax-delivery suite of products allows our clients to exchange millions of patient information, insurance and other documents safely, swiftly and securely every business day. Concord’s use of Artificial Intelligence, analytics, and other cutting-edge technology also analyzes the data being transferred within a fax, then delivers it into the right inboxes and workflows, fundamentally changing how data moves.

More than 2,300 healthcare organizations, financial providers, and companies in other equally document-intensive industries trust Concord to deliver their confidential and sensitive information. We care about our customers, and with a retention rate of more than 98%, it’s clear they love the service and value we provide.

We have been in business since 1996 and growing faster than ever. Our products are getting smarter, our customers are getting bigger, and our user community is exploding. To continue meeting market demand and anticipating our customers’ needs, we are expanding our offerings. That means assembling a world-class team to take us through this next phase of growth. We hope you’d like to join us!

About the role

We’re seeking a high-performing Enterprise Sales Executive to drive new business growth in our Gulf States region by selling Concord’s Cloud Fax and Document Processing SaaS solutions into large healthcare systems. This is a strategic role focused on helping hospitals modernize their document workflows and improve compliance, interoperability, and operational intelligence.

Essential Functions:

  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting to close for enterprise healthcare accounts.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans to penetrate and expand within healthcare systems.
  • Build trusted relationships with C-suite, IT, and clinical operations leaders.
  • Deliver compelling solution presentations and ROI-driven proposals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product, and customer support teams.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline and forecasting in CRM (Salesforce).
  • Stay informed on healthcare regulations (HIPAA, HITRUST) and industry trends.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of enterprise sales experience in healthcare SaaS, preferably in Cloud Fax, Document Management, or Workflow Automation.
  • Proven success selling into hospitals, health systems, and payer organizations.
  • Strong understanding of EMRs (Epic, Cerner), interoperability challenges, and healthcare IT.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% as needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with HL7, FHIR, and API-based integrations.
  • Experience navigating complex procurement cycles in healthcare.
  • Background in consultative or solution-based selling.

Compensation Range: $250,000 OTE

Range can flux dependent on experience, education/training, etc.

Additional employee benefits at Concord Technologies:

  • 401K plan w/ 6% company match (vests immediately)
  • Flex-Time off + sick time
  • 10 company holidays
  • Full suite of health benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision)– employee only coverage covered at 100% (no employee cost). For employees + dependents, Concord covers 60% of premiums.
  • Voluntary insurance options:
    • Pet insurance
    • Employee Life and AD&D
    • Spousal Life and AD&D
    • Child Life and AD&D
  • Paid Parental Leave program
  • Free unlimited ORCA card (Seattle area residents)
  • Employee Rewards and Recognition through NectarHR
  • Unlimited access to Udemy for Business

Concord Technologies is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. It is the policy of the Company to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

raw.title: Strategic Account Executive
raw.excerpt: About LogicGate LogicGate is the leading AI GRC platform for the Enterprise, helping governance, risk, and compliance teams limit surprises, strengthen resilience, augment program performance, and confidently quantify impact and business value.
raw.description:
About LogicGate
LogicGate is the leading AI GRC platform for the Enterprise, helping governance, risk, and compliance teams limit surprises, strengthen resilience, augment program performance, and confidently quantify impact and business value. Built to provide a centralized view of risk and compliance, with AI intelligence woven into the platform's core, LogicGate delivers real-time insights and actionable data to help drive current business decisions, with the flexibility to scale alongside evolving business needs. Recognized as a Leader in the GRC Market, LogicGate continues to further solidify its position as a best-in-class platform.

The GRC MarketGovernance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) is a rapidly expanding sector, with a global market size projected to reach $104.5 billion by 2031. LogicGate is at the forefront of this industry transformation, empowering enterprise professionals to navigate complex regulatory environments, manage critical uncertainty, and operate with integrity at scale.

Strategic Account Executive

Location: United States - Remote

About the role

Our Strategic Account Executives have a passion for pitching novel technology in big markets. You’ll target large enterprises in all verticals with a focus on their GRC programs. We are disrupting the GRC software industry as a recent Forrester Wave Leader by providing a solution end users can self-manage, saving enterprises huge amounts of time and money and you’ll focus on identifying target accounts and bringing them through the full sales process. This is an opportunity to play a key role in building a business, have a huge and direct impact on top line revenue growth, and be part of a collaborative, high-performing sales team.

How you’ll spend your time:

  • Strategically developing a territory plan for a targeted list of accounts in Salesforce leveraging best in class sales technology including marketing automation, buyer intent signals, pipeline analytics, and more!
  • Generating new business pipeline primarily by cold prospecting through partner collaborations, social communication, email and phone calls.
  • Form strategic sales plan to target use cases within industry verticals.
  • Taking a customer through the full lifecycle of an opportunity including qualification/ discovery, demo (in partnership with a Solutions Engineer), building relationships within an organization, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Being an advocate for our customers. Actively listening to understand their goals and share these potential opportunities with our product team.
  • Leveraging sales enablement tools to effectively measure activities and develop best practices. Continuously refining and improving on sales activities.
  • Consulting and advising our customers on best practices for their use case on the LogicGate platform.
  • Deliver world class customer service in every customer interaction

We get excited about you if you have:

  • Proven sales experience. You will ideally have 10+ years of total Sales experience, specifically 5+ years of large enterprise sales experience selling B2B SaaS technology.
  • Curiosity and the desire to understand our customer’s problems – and effectively communicate how LogicGate can add value.
  • Great listening skills, as well as humility. We won’t be the right solution all the time for every organization, so we believe in understanding customer needs first before we make our pitch.
  • A tech savvy seller – can quickly pick up new technology and understands our platform front and back. Previous experience in BPM or GRC software is a huge plus.
  • Great people skills. Ability to quickly understand your audience and tailor the right message to them, typically via web conference.
  • Excitement to build lasting relationships. Someone who is in it for the long term and understands the value in building trust with customers.
  • Proficiency in using Salesforce.com and sales automation software.
  • Willingness to be creative, test solutions, measure results and iterate on a process for continual improvement.

The anticipated on-target earnings range for the role is $290,000 - $350,000 per year + equity + benefits. Actual salaries may vary and will be based on factors, such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Internal candidates who have current pay within or above the hiring range are still encouraged to apply if interested.

How We WorkAt LogicGate, we empower organizations to transform risk into a strategic advantage. As we continue to scale, we are looking for driven, high-performing individuals who are ready to take ownership, raise the bar, and do the best work of their careers.

Our culture is built on execution, collaboration, and a shared commitment to excellence. We believe the strongest, most innovative teams are forged by diverse perspectives. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment where differences are celebrated and supported.

Global Total Rewards
We invest in our people with a comprehensive and competitive rewards package designed to support our team members across the US and the UK:

  • Compensation & Equity: Competitive base salaries, variable compensation plans, and equity options.
  • Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive health, wellness, and lifestyle benefits tailored to your region.
  • Time Away: Generous paid time off and annual company holidays so you can recharge and return at your best.
  • Growth & Development: Continuous career advancement through structured mentorship, leadership training, and premium learning platforms.

Recognized as a top workplace by Built In, Crain’s Chicago Business, and the Chicago Tribune.

This position is a chance to join a dynamic, expanding company with prospects for individual and career growth. As one of the 5 largest insurance brokerage firms in the U.S., Alliant provides property and casualty, workers' compensation, employee benefits, surety, and financial products and services to clients nationwide.

More information is available at www.alliant.com.

SUMMARY

Responsible for independently managing client relationships and delivering strategic consulting services related to value-based contracting with healthcare providers. Leads the day-to-day service and strategic relationship management of assigned health plan and provider accounts, coordinating resources to deliver measurable client value accross the policy term

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Responsible for the day-to-day management of assigned health plan and provider accounts in a client-facing capacity.

Contributes to relationship development and long-term account growth between Alliant and each client.

Helps develop a three-year reinsurance strategy for each client, informed by loss ratios, benchmarking, loss development, and targeted premium and rate goals.

Coordinates the implementation of Alliant resources, including Risk IQ, Actuarial, Clinical, Claims, and Service teams.

Coordinates installation meetings with the carrier, client, and Alliant service team to establish a smooth support model for each new policy term.

Develops an annual service calendar for each client, including quarterly client touchpoints.

Oversees premium and enrollment tracking with staff support.

Maintains client tracking for key account components, including updated DOFRs, policy changes, and client staff and leadership changes.

Partners with the Claims team to ensure client needs are addressed promptly and effectively.

Coordinates with claims team to ensure policy is meeting claims adjudication outcomes.

Manages all policy reporting and final submission requirements.

Oversees client data requests/needs throughout the policy term.

Owns assigned carrier renewals and new-business marketing within the health plmarkets.

Processes BOR requests for both renewals and new business.

Shares responsibility with the market leader for all pre-renewal meetings.

Leads proposal generation to include service summaries, claims recoveries, key other relevant KPIs.

Communicates renewal timelines, milestones, and expectations to clients.

Participates in managed-care conferences and industry events.

Travels as needed for face-to-face client meetings.

Supports new business meetings as needed both virtually and in person.

QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

Ten (10) or more years of experience in Managed Care Reinsurance

Valid Insurance License

SKILLS

Demonstrated ability to exercise discretion and independent judgement in solving complex business problems.

Excellent analytical, financial, and strategic thinking skills.

Proven ability to influence stakeholders and drive decision-making.

Advanced in Microsoft Office Suite.

Excellent time management skills.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Ability to prioritize work for multiple tasks and deadlines.

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

We are proud to provide comprehensive, high quality employee programs to meet employees' needs now and in the future, including a very competitive financial package. We encourage you to explore what we have to offer.

collaboration with RTS sales, solution, and delivery teams

sales, solution, and delivery stakeholders
