Overview

Lumicera Health Services is seeking a Payer Contracting Executive to join our team!

The Payer Contracting Executive serves as a dedicated negotiator focused on expanding payer access across commercial, Medicare Part D, and Medicaid opportunities. The primary responsibility of this position is to lead payer negotiations end to end, including rate and term negotiation, network participation, performance guarantee structures, and renewal strategy, to grow covered lives and protect margin for the specialty pharmacy. The Payer Contracting Executive will develop and execute a payer access roadmap, identify and pursue networks in which Lumicera and its partner pharmacies are not currently participating, and secure agreements that maximize access to patients and members.

The Payer Contracting Executive will support Lumicera and all strategic partners for whom Lumicera provides shared services to help meet strategic goals and mitigate financial losses. This position partners closely with trade relations, account management, finance, legal, and compliance, and interfaces with external payer representatives with respect to specialty pharmacy services and contracting duties.

Is this you? Find out more below!

Responsibilities

How do I make an impact on my team?

  • Lead payer negotiations end to end, including rate and term negotiation, network participation, performance guarantee structures, and renewal strategy.
  • Develop and execute a payer access roadmap for expanded payer contracts, investigating current networks where Lumicera and its partner pharmacies are not in network.
  • Independently outreach to payers to identify credentialing and network requirements and to pursue new access opportunities.
  • Establish, monitor, and negotiate pricing and service agreements with payers, following company policy regarding contract management, including legal and compliance review and oversight.
  • Complete credentialing and new contract applications for payer and government clients, and compile supporting documents and reports for payer applications, contracts, and business reviews.
  • Track agreements through the contracting process from reception to completion with both internal and external stakeholder input.
  • Meet with payer representatives to determine account management needs of the payer and to ensure contract compliance.
  • Reenroll and recredential existing payer and government plans, monitoring proactively to ensure no gaps in coverage.
  • Coordinate projects involving contracts and data needs for master service agreements, shared service agreements, and scope of work documents, including data and enhanced service opportunities.
  • Develop relations and contacts with established payers and resolve discrepancies with claims and payments.
  • Review operational and documentation processes to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and payer contracts.
  • Ensure all specialty pharmacy reporting requirements are met to maintain network contracts.
  • Analyze, compile, and prepare data analytics and presentations for payer clients and leadership.
  • Provide periodic and detailed reporting of activities and opportunities to leadership.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable state and federal regulations.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

What our team expects from you?

  • Bachelor's degree required. Master of Business Administration (MBA) or other graduate degree preferred.
  • Certified Pharmacy Technician or relevant industry certification preferred.
  • 5 years of payer contracting, managed care, or specialty pharmacy experience required.
  • Experience negotiating payer or network agreements, preferably in specialty pharmacy or managed care contracting, required.
  • Working knowledge of commercial, Medicare Part D, and Medicaid payer environments and network access requirements required.
  • Participate in, adhere to, and support compliance program objectives.
  • The ability to consistently interact cooperatively and respectfully with other employees.

What can you expect from Lumicera?

  • Top of the industry benefits for Health, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • 20 days paid time off
  • 4 weeks paid parental leave
  • 9 paid holidays
  • 401K company match of up to 5% - No vesting requirement
  • Adoption Assistance Program
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Educational Assistance Plan and Professional Membership assistance
  • Referral Bonus Program – up to $750!

Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

Within Danaher the work our diagnostic businesses do saves lives - and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact - innovating at the speed of life.

We’re accelerating the development of cutting-edge diagnostics to solve some of the world’s most pressing health challenges. Across our diagnostics operating companies we are driving innovation through partnerships with top academic institutions and leading players in biopharma and translational research. We’re bringing the best minds together to accelerate innovation and unlock the full potential of the latest scientific advances. Together, we’re expanding access to precision diagnostics for millions of people worldwide - and we’re using our unmatched global scale and proven playbook to make it happen, from hospital labs to mobile clinics. By helping providers, patients, and families get faster, more precise diagnostic results, we’re improving treatment options and saving lives.

Your responsibilities include cultivating strong relationships with global health systems, managing opportunities and deployment projects, and engaging executive sponsors to ensure customer satisfaction. You will lead business operations within Large Network Groups, expand client relationships, address customer issues, and sell at strategic levels while collaborating with functional teams across sales, operations, and services. By developing insightful account plans and business strategies aligned with customer and company goals, you will drive growth, market share, and brand awareness through customized offerings that simplify supply chains and strengthen industry partnerships, leveraging Danaher’s expertise to enhance both customer outcomes and business performance.

This position is part of a small and nimble sales team that are growth experts in diagnostics, and is a fully remote role.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Strategic Relationship Management: Build and nurture strategic, C-suite relationships across large network groups and global accounts, transforming interactions into long-term partnerships focused on mutual value.
  • Account Planning & Growth: Develop and execute multi-year strategic account plans that align with customer business and financial goals, driving sustained partnerships and consistent revenue growth.
  • Commercial Leadership: Lead all commercial activities, including sales pipeline management, RFP oversight, and compliant deal closure to achieve positive margin expansion.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate closely with internal cross-functional teams—including sales, service, and delivery operations—to ensure unified execution and attainment of account objectives.
  • Customer Engagement & Service Delivery: Oversee all aspects of customer engagement to guarantee high-quality service delivery from installation through post-maintenance, promptly addressing and escalating issues as necessary.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor's degree (preferably in business or sciences); Master's degree preferred.

  • Executive Communication & Negotiation: Strong communication, negotiation, and demonstrated ability to deliver excellent executive-level presentations.
  • Customer Focus & Project Management: A customer-focused mindset combined with solid project management skills.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Hospital operating financials and healthcare economics
  • Strategic Business Acumen: Ability to deeply understand customer business and financial goals, translating them into a sound strategy that positions Beckman Coulter as their partner of choice, with a strong grasp of LAB operating financials and healthcare economics.

Role Overview

Are you a dynamic negotiator with a passion for driving business growth? ProAg is seeking an Executive Underwriter – Specialty to lead the charge in building relationships and expanding our market presence. In this role, you’ll be the go-to resource for agents, helping them grow their book of business while serving as a trusted partner to our sales team and supporting our underwriting teams forward. You’ll play a critical role in facilitating the underwriting process, driving profitable growth, and shaping the future of our underwriting discipline.

In this Exciting Opportunity, You Will:

  • Develop business plans with agencies that improve book performance for profitability, retention, premium growth, and new business production.
  • Evaluate new and renewal policy applications and related documents to classify and assess each risk, determine acceptability, assign rating, indicate endorsements and limits, and determine appropriate pricing.
  • Cultivate relationships with internal and external contacts to facilitate the underwriting process, promote business development, and to remain abreast of industry trends. Serve as a resource to other departmental staff.
  • Serve as a resource to other departmental staff with regards to underwriting procedures and other departmental guidelines.
  • Utilize knowledge of automated underwriting and/or processing systems to develop information for new or renewal policies.
  • Adhere to all company underwriting authority directives, underwriting guidelines, and other applicable company policies and procedures.

What You Bring

  • Approximately six years of relevant and progressive professional experience.
  • At least two years of leadership experience, guiding teams to meet their goals.
  • Previous agriculture or crop insurance industry experience but is not required.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Administration, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field, or the equivalent education and/or experience.
  • Ability to negotiate to enable business outcomes that support ProAg's strategic goals
  • Utilize with a data-centered approach when making business and tactical decisions.
  • Solid written and verbal communication skills with an emphasis on confidentiality, tact, and diplomacy to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.
  • Knowledgeable of industry changes, legal updates, and technical developments related to applicable area of the Company's business to proactively respond to changing business environment.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefit package
  • Strong learning culture with ongoing development opportunities
  • Opportunities for growth and career advancement
  • Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, with eligibility beginning on your first day of employment
  • Basic life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) plan with 6% company match
  • 20 days of PTO, three floating holidays, approximately 10 paid holidays, and volunteer time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • Access to our award-winning wellness program, including mental health services, fitness network membership, and a complimentary Headspace subscription
  • Student loan matching program
  • Employee discount program
  • An opportunity to do meaningful work and love what you do

What We Represent:

A career with purpose. Our crop insurance professionals work each day to bring peace of mind and protection to American farmers and ranchers. Join a team who truly cares.

  • Part of something bigger: We offer a career with purpose as you support the farmers and ranchers who create food, fuel, and fiber for the world.
  • Personal connections: We are built on strong relationships and appreciation of your individuality.
  • A team who cares: We look out for each other personally and professionally because we care about each other.
  • Innovators by trade: We’re committed to a brighter tomorrow for our team members and agriculture.
  • The best of both worlds: We combine personal connections with powerful resources, thanks to our culture and the backing of Tokio Marine HCC.

The Company:

ProAg, a member of the Tokio Marine HCC group of companies, is positioned as a financially strong and well-capitalized insurer with an AM Best rating of A++. With 100 years of service to our agents & insureds, we stand committed to continuing the principles that ProAg was founded on: Integrity, Loyalty, and Customer Service. Tokio Marine HCC is a leading specialty insurance group with offices in the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, and other exciting locations. With the strength and stability that comes from being a member of the Tokio Marine Group, and more than fifty years of growth, profitability, and stability, we offer important insurance products that most people don’t even know exist. Every policy we write is special, enabling our clients to do amazing things.

Pay Transparency

The pay range for this position is $120,000 - $170,000 which includes geographic adjustments, where applicable. The pay range is the range THMCC, in good faith, believes is the range of compensation for this role at the time of this posting. The hired applicant will be offered pay within the entire range based on the candidate’s geographic location, qualifications, work experience, education, and/or skill level. The Company is fully committed to ensuring equal pay opportunities for equal work regardless of color, race, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, religion, age, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local pay equity laws.

Disclaimer

After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if the Company is concerned about a conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction or challenge the accuracy of the background report. The Company will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable federal, state and local laws, such as the Violent Crime Control and Law Enforcement Act of 1994 (18 USC § 1033(e))(the “VCCLEA”), which restricts financial institutions and insurers such as TMHCC from employing individuals with certain types of criminal convictions. Where the hiring and employment of individuals is not restricted by the foregoing, the Company will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history in compliance with applicable law such as the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the San Diego Fair Chance Ordinance, and the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.]

Equal Opportunity Employer

TMHCC is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances.

Client Development Executive

Altera Digital Health – US Remote

Overview
Altera Digital Health is seeking an experienced and driven Net-New Enterprise Sales Executive to join our Ventus team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving new customer acquisition within the US healthcare provider market. Your primary focus will be selling our innovative Ventus Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) solutions to large, acute-care health systems, particularly those utilizing Cerner/Oracle Health, Epic, and Meditech environments. This position requires a proven professional skilled in new business development, capable of establishing and nurturing executive relationships, building a robust sales pipeline, and closing complex SaaS opportunities with health systems exceeding $1 billion in annual revenue.

Key Responsibilities

  • Generate net-new bookings by identifying and closing opportunities within target health systems.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key executive stakeholders, including CFOs, CIOs, and VPs of Revenue Cycle, HIM, and Patient Financial Services.
  • Drive the adoption of Ventus solutions, including Ventus Intelligent Coding (VIC), Ventus Contract Management (VCM), and Ventus Contract Analysis (VCA).
  • Strategically expand Altera's footprint within the Oracle Health (Cerner) installed base.
  • Build and manage a long-term pipeline for Altera's ARC RCM modernization opportunities.

Qualifications

  • Experience:
    • 5-15 years of enterprise technology sales experience within the healthcare industry.
    • Proven success as a quota-carrying individual contributor in a healthcare SaaS sales environment.
    • Demonstrated experience acquiring net-new logos and selling complex solutions into hospitals, regional health systems, IDNs, or Academic Medical Centers.
    • A consistent history of meeting or exceeding sales quotas.
    • Direct experience selling Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), Coding, Revenue Integrity, Contract Management, or Claims Management solutions is highly preferred.
    • Familiarity with the Oracle Health / Cerner, Epic, or Meditech EHR markets is a significant advantage.
  • Education:
    • A Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Healthcare Administration, or a related field is preferred.

Working Arrangements
This is a remote position based in the United States. Work is performed during a standard work week, with flexibility as defined by assignment requirements. This role may require work during non-standard hours to meet business and client needs, particularly during peak times such as the end of a quarter or year.

Travel
Up to 20% travel may be required to meet with clients and attend industry events.

If required, the salary range(s) are displayed below and are specifically for those potential hires who will perform work in or reside in the location(s) listed, if selected for the role. Any offered salary is determined based on internal equity, internal salary ranges, market data, ranges, applicant's skills and prior relevant experience, certain degrees and certifications (e.g. JD, technology), for example.

80-120k USD

Why Altera?
At Altera Digital Health, you will have the opportunity to profoundly impact the lives of patients by empowering healthcare providers to deliver superior care. You will join a passionate and gifted team committed to innovation and excellence. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package and the opportunity to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Certrec is seeking a full-time Business Development Executive focused on the New Nuclear Market to develop and grow relationships with companies advancing next-generation nuclear technologies and new nuclear projects. This position will be responsible for identifying, developing, and closing opportunities with technology developers, utilities, project developers, engineering firms, investors, and other organizations involved in the licensing, development, construction, and operation of new nuclear facilities. The ideal candidate will combine strong nuclear licensing and regulatory knowledge with the ability to manage complex, consultative sales cycles and translate customer needs into effective Certrec solutions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

New Nuclear Business Development

Develop and execute a strategic business-development plan for the new nuclear market. Build and maintain a qualified pipeline of opportunities across the advanced reactor and new nuclear sectors. Identify prospective customers, partners, and influencers across the new nuclear ecosystem, including advanced reactor and SMR companies, utilities, project developers, engineering firms, suppliers, fuel-cycle organizations, and government entities. Partner with Sales Team on market research, prospecting, lead generation, outreach, and relationship development activities, while maintaining primary ownership and accountability for New Nuclear opportunities through the full sales lifecycle. Establish relationships with senior executives, licensing leaders, regulatory affairs teams, project managers, and technical decisionmakers. Conduct discovery meetings to understand customer business objectives, licensing challenges, project schedules, and compliance needs. Represent Certrec at industry events and monitor market trends, competitor activity, regulatory developments, and new nuclear project activity to identify emerging opportunities.

Consultative Sales and Account Management

Lead and maintain ownership of New Nuclear opportunities from qualification through proposal development, negotiation, and close, including opportunities generated directly or indirectly. Develop account strategies for key new nuclear prospects and customers. Develop and present tailored solutions for key prospects, partnering with Certrec subject-matter experts to deliver technically accurate proposals, presentations, demonstrations, statements of work, and RFP responses that clearly connect customer needs to measurable value. Maintain accurate opportunity, account, activity, and forecast information in the company’s CRM system. Develop pricing and proposal strategies with company leadership and negotiate commercial terms that support Certrec's business objectives. Maintain ongoing customer relationships following close, supporting onboarding, renewals, expansion, and cross-selling opportunities while ensuring commitments are documented and fulfilled.

Internal Collaboration

Collaborate with technical, licensing, regulatory, project management, marketing, and executive teams to communicate customer requirements, market intelligence, competitive information, and emerging needs that may inform Certrec's products and services. Contribute to New Nuclear go-to-market strategy, sales forecasting, business reviews, and strategic planning.

Nuclear Licensing Knowledge The ideal candidate will be familiar with the licensing and regulatory environment for new nuclear facilities, including several of the following:

NRC licensing processes and regulatory frameworks. New plant licensing pathways, including early site permits, construction permits, combined licenses, and operating licenses. Advanced reactor and small modular reactor licensing considerations, including regulatory engagement and pre-application activities. Licensing and regulatory documentation, including safety analysis reports, licensing-basis documentation, regulatory commitments, and correspondence. Quality assurance, environmental review, and site characterization requirements. Licensing document management, configuration control, audit readiness, and operational program requirements. Stakeholder interactions among utilities, technology vendors, the NRC, contractors, and other organizations supporting new nuclear projects.

This is not intended to be a purely transactional sales role. Success requires the ability to understand complex nuclear licensing challenges and communicate credibly with the professionals responsible for them.

Headquartered in Ipswich, MA, EBSCO employs more than 2,700 people worldwide, with most embracing hybrid or remote work models. As an AI-enabled service leader, we thrive on innovation, forward-thinking strategies, and the dedication of our exceptional team. At EBSCO, we’re driven to inspire, empower and support research. Our mission is to transform lives by providing reliable and relevant information — when, where and how people need it. We’re seeking dynamic, creative individuals whose diverse perspectives will help us achieve this global, inclusive mission. Join us to help make an impact.

Your Opportunity

The Customer Success Executive (CSE) partners with EBSCO Clinical Decisions customers to ensure successful onboarding, product adoption, and long-term value realization of EBSCO solutions. Acting as the primary point of contact post-sale, CSEs collaborate with internal teams including Sales, Marketing, Product, and Editorial to deliver a seamless and value-driven customer experience.

This Customer Success Executive will support customers across the North Midwest and West Coast regions. Candidates should be open to travel and located within 45 minutes of a major metropolitan airport. Ideally, candidates will be based in the Chicago or Denver area.

What You'll Do

Drive Value & Strategic Alignment

  • Review each customer’s Value Hypothesis and align product capabilities to stated needs and success metrics.
  • Establish clear timelines and KPIs to guide value realization.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to proactively deliver recommendations that enhance outcomes and demonstrate product impact.

Lead Onboarding & Enablement

  • Define onboarding goals, deliver change management support, and coordinate with the Clinical Implementation team.
  • Support awareness campaigns and provide product training to ensure users understand key features and use cases.
  • Empower internal product champions and share self-service resources to promote internal adoption.

Support Technical Implementation

  • Lead the end-to-end onboarding process for EBSCO Clinical Decisions products
  • Provide expert guidance and support to customers during the implementation process, coordinating with IT teams to ensure that the system is properly configured and integrated with existing systems, including EHR integration, toolbar links, IdP SSO via SAML and SMART on FHIR, HL7 Infobutton & Mobile Device Management (MDM)
  • Manage Implementation timelines, resources, and budgets to ensure project milestones are met.
  • Monitor and report on Implementation progress, identifying and mitigating risks as needed.

Ensure Ongoing Success & Growth

  • Deliver proactive, data-driven engagement strategies that sustain usage and satisfaction throughout the customer lifecycle.
  • Monitor product usage against KPIs and offer strategic interventions to prevent churn and promote growth.
  • Conduct regular business reviews to track performance, address evolving needs, and identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities.
  • Manage the renewal process and ensure alignment across internal teams for customer retention and expansion.

About You

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in project management, customer engagement, success, marketing, or support roles
  • Strong understanding of clinical workflows, EHR systems, and SSO authentication protocols.

  • Proven track record of successfully managing complex implementation projects.
  • Excellent written and oral communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.

  • What sets you apart:
  • 7 years of experience in project management and experience within the healthcare industry.
  • Clinical informatics and/or background and knowledge of healthcare industry trends, regulations, and best practices.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address issues that may arise during adoption and ongoing success.

raw.description:
At Curriculum Associates, we believe in the potential of every child and are changing the face of education technology with award-winning learning programs like i-Ready that serve a third of the nation’s K–8 students. For more than 50 years, our commitment to making classrooms better places, serving educators, and supporting accessible learning experiences for all students has driven the continuous improvement of our innovative programs. Our team of more than 2,500 employees is composed of lifelong learners who stand behind this mission, working tirelessly to serve the educational community with world-class programs and support every day.

Curriculum Associates is a mission-driven K–8 education company, and our leaders play a direct part in how we support educators and students. The Senior Executive Recruiter owns the search process for our most senior and business-critical roles, including Director, VP, and C-suite positions, as well as hard-to-fill specialized leadership roles.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will act as a strategic talent advisor to executives and hiring leaders, shaping search strategy, building relationships with leaders in and beyond education, and delivering an exceptional candidate experience that reflects our values.

The impact you’ll have:

Lead end-to-end executive searches

  • Own the full search lifecycle, from intake and role definition through sourcing, assessment, offer negotiation, and close
  • Partner with hiring executives to define success profiles, search criteria, and realistic timelines
  • Run confidential searches with discretion and sound judgment

Advise as a strategic talent partner

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and the executive team on leadership hiring, market trends, compensation benchmarks, and talent availability
  • Translate business strategy and workforce planning into clear executive talent plans
  • Provide candid guidance on search scope, candidate fit, and tradeoffs

Source and build executive talent pipelines

  • Develop proactive sourcing strategies to reach passive candidates, including leaders from education, ed-tech, and adjacent industries
  • Build and maintain a network of senior leaders, industry contacts, and external search partners
  • Maintain warm pipelines for anticipated future leadership needs

Assess and evaluate candidates

  • Conduct in-depth screening and structured interviews to evaluate leadership capability, mission alignment, and cultural contribution
  • Design and facilitate interview plans and panels that are consistent, fair, and evidence-based
  • Synthesize feedback and present clear, well-supported recommendations to decision makers

Drive an inclusive and equitable process

  • Build diverse slates and apply inclusive hiring practices throughout the search
  • Coach interviewers on bias awareness and structured evaluation
  • Help ensure every candidate is treated with respect and transparency

Negotiate and close

  • Partner with Total Rewards and HR leadership on offer structure, executive compensation, and equity considerations
  • Guide candidates through negotiation, relocation, and onboarding transitions
  • Support early-stage integration of new executives in partnership with HR and hiring leaders

Manage external search partners

  • Select, direct, and evaluate retained search firms when appropriate
  • Ensure external partners represent our brand and mission well and deliver quality results

Improve the executive hiring function

  • Contribute to the design of executive hiring standards, tools, and best practices
  • Track and report on search metrics, pipeline health, and quality of hire
  • Use applicant tracking system data and market intelligence to continuously improve outcomes
  • Mentor other recruiters and share executive search expertise across the Talent Acquisition team

Success in This Role Looks Like:

  • Senior leadership searches are filled with high-quality, mission-aligned leaders within agreed timelines
  • Hiring executives view you as a credible, strategic partner
  • Candidates, whether hired or not, describe a professional and respectful experience
  • Executive pipelines are strong, diverse, and ready ahead of need

What we’re looking for:

  • 10+ years of progressive recruiting experience, including 5+ years leading executive or senior leadership searches (Director, VP, and C-suite), in corporate talent acquisition, retained search, or both
  • Demonstrated track record of closing confidential, high-stakes searches and delivering high-quality hires within agreed timelines
  • Experience advising senior executives on search strategy, candidate assessment, market conditions, and executive compensation
  • Proven ability to source passive candidates and build executive networks through direct outreach, referrals, and relationship building
  • Skill in structured interviewing and leadership assessment, with the judgment to evaluate both capability and mission alignment
  • Experience negotiating complex executive offers, including base, incentive, equity, and relocation, in partnership with Total Rewards or HR
  • Experience building diverse candidate slates and applying inclusive, evidence-based hiring practices
  • Strong communication, discretion, and influencing skills, with credibility at the executive level
  • Proficiency with applicant tracking systems and recruiting data, including pipeline and search metrics reporting

Benefits and Pay Range:

Pay Range – This role’s range is $93,250 - $166,250 The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that Curriculum Associates considers in making compensation decisions based on our Compensation Philosophy. Actual base pay within that range will vary based upon several factors including, but not limited to, prior experience and relevant skill sets. At Curriculum Associates, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances for each case. This role is also eligible to participate in the company bonus plan. The Company recognizes that minimum wage varies by location and will ensure all compensation decisions comply with applicable state and local laws.


Benefits – Benefit eligible employees (and their families) are covered by medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance. Employees can enroll in our company’s 401k plan and receive an employer match. Employees have access to a flexible vacation and sick policy in addition to twelve paid holidays and a winter office closure between Christmas and New Year's, as well as a number of additional perks and benefits.


Application deadline: October 31, 2026. This is subject to close earlier if there is a high volume of applicants or a qualified hire is made.

Job Description:

Client Advocate Executive -HIS


3M Health Care is now Solventum


At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role


As a Client Advocate Executive, you will serve as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to some of the most innovative healthcare organizations globally. This role is designed to influence client success at the highest levels, drive measurable business outcomes, and strengthen Solventum’s position as a leader in Health Information Systems. The CAE will be expected to cultivate executive-level relationships, drive top quartile client performance, proactively removing barriers inhibiting success and looking for growth opportunities within the organization. The ideal candidate will have hospital/healthcare system workflow and analytics knowledge, a working knowledge of the Health Information Systems product portfolio and the ability to function as an advocate for both the client/partner and HIS through their relationships.

  • Driving best practice performance to assist organizations, achieving top quartile performance, effective revenue cycle processes and clinical efficiencies and outcomes
  • Working with a highly experienced team to drive customer retention/renewals of the Solventum HIS portfolio
  • Nurture and build relationships with CXO, VP and Department Managers to maximize value.
  • Advise clients on business process and customer workflow improvement that takes place in this changing market segment.
  • Drive cross-functional focus on Customer Outcomes, Value, and Experiences

As a Client Advocate Executive, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:


Client Care & Advocacy -

  • Cultivating executive-level relationships, positioning Solventum as a strategic partner and thought leader.
  • Leveraging performance insights to guide client decisions and shape long-term partnership strategies.
  • Coordinating with internal Health Information Systems departments to raise client issues and concerns.
  • Engaging with technical teams for any integration needs.
  • Championing continuous improvement through Voice of Customer (VOC) programs, innovation initiatives and process improvements.
  • Serving as the client’s advocate within Solventum, articulating partnership value and influencing internal priorities.
  • Elevating client visibility through strategic recognition programs and reference opportunities.

Retention and Revenue - Responsible for continued partnership and success with Health Information Systems on existing products/services and for recognizing additional business needs/sales opportunities with the client. Be in alignment with sales team as new needs arise.

  • Monitoring for emerging risks and escalate to implementation, support, and development functions when warranted.
  • Identifying potential products/solutions at risk and escalate to business leaders
  • Identifying growth opportunities and collaborate with sales teams to advance strategic initiatives.
  • Driving strategies that protect and expand revenue by aligning client needs with Solventum’s solution roadmap.

Value Realization– Lead ROI analysis and performance reviews to demonstrate solution impact and inform executive decision-making.

  • Driving in-depth analysis of client performance metrics to inform strategic decisions, with emphasis on product outcomes (top quartile performance) and financial impact.
  • Developing and executing action plans that align client objectives with measurable outcomes.

Strategic Execution - Ensure consistent, high-level engagement across executive client leadership to reinforce partnership value.

  • Serving as the Client Advocate for activities across HIS with assigned organization partner.
  • Engaging HIS business leaders where appropriate to coordinate activities across multiple HIS departments, engage subject matter experts (SMEs) for respective projects.
  • For providers, conducting current-state workflow and configuration review with client implementing Solventum best practice workflows.
  • Engaging in feedback sessions to refine and improve content and workflow, implementation best practice, outstanding decisions that impact clients.
  • Engaging with client to understand their technical environment and any changes that will require Solventum engagement.

Strategy and Planning - Understanding the client/partners’ short and long-term strategy with the goal to further integrate HIS Solutions. Developing consistent ongoing onsite presence.

  • Partnering with clients to co-create strategic roadmaps that integrate HIS solutions into their long-term vision. Updates plan as decisions are made internally and externally.
  • Understanding strategy, organizational structure, technical architecture changes and the impacts/opportunities for HIS.
  • Ensuring client/partner is fully aware of HIS solution roadmaps and assists in planning for both changes in current portfolio workflows and portfolio evolution to solve client problems.
  • Monitoring market trends and organizational shifts to identify opportunities for deeper solution alignment.

Leadership and Coordination - Responsible for leading the team to ensure account satisfaction and ongoing client engagement.

  • Setting the agenda for advocacy engagements, driving conversations that shape client strategy.
  • Leading client meetings and coordinate follow-up on all requested items.
  • Positioning Solventum as an industry leader by sharing insights, thought leadership, and best practices.
  • Fostering innovation that enhances client experience and strengthens competitive advantage.

Performance and Analytics

  • Defining and tracking KPIs that measure adoption, satisfaction, and value realization.
  • Delivering executive-level reporting and insights that inform strategic decisions and reinforce partnership impact.
  • Championing participation in industry benchmarks (e.g., KLAS) to validate performance and drive continuous improvement.
  • Responsible for ensuring that baseline data has been secured on clients assigned prior to go live of product/service.
  • Regular analysis of clients analytics and performance data and delivering ROI/Performance reports to the client on a scheduled basis.
  • Actively stay up to date with knowledge of industry changes and product changes.
  • Participating in relevant corporate programs/initiatives, complies with professional and quality standards, complies with corporate policies and procedures, and acts in a manner consistent with Solventum’s values and ethical standards.

Your Skills and Expertise


To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher from an accredited institution
  • AND seven (7) years of clinical coding/health information management experience, RN, consulting or acute care CDI experience
  • AND five (5) years of ICD-10-AM/ACHI/Australian Coding Standards knowledge and AR-DRG methodologies experience

OR

  • Associate degree from an accredited institution
  • AND at least eleven (11) years of clinical coding/health information management experience, RN, consulting or acute care CDI experience
  • AND five (5) years of ICD-10-AM/ACHI/Australian Coding Standards knowledge and AR-DRG methodologies experience

In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

  • CHIM or Eligible for membership of HIMAA or Valid RN or License with minimum of five (5) years acute care experience
  • Minimum of five (5) years of CDI experience
  • Deep understanding of and relationship among clinical documentation, medical record coding, healthcare billing and revenue cycle management
  • Extensive experience with and understanding of health information applications (PAS, EHR, EMR, Encoder, CAC/CDI, etc)

Travel: May include up to 50% domestic

Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).


Supporting Your Well-being

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

  • Use ClickUp to manage daily to dos, meeting actions, and project priorities

Responsibilities:

  • Manage inbox triage: drafting, follow ups, decision flags, and escalating what matters

Executive Producer; Glory Franchise

Reach Game Studios is looking for a lead/executive producer to work on the studio's upcoming FPS RPG, GLORY and shape the franchise going forward.

Responsibilities:

As executive producer you will be responsible for:

  • Along with the guidance of senior leadership and the Board, overseeing the development of Glory as a franchise, including our flagship debut title, Glory, as well as ancillary products within the brand.
  • Providing outstanding leadership and mentorship, motivating a talented team of designers, artists, and engineers on an ambitious title.
  • Working collaborately with the leadership team and line producers to budget, scope, schedule and deliver key milestones.
  • Working closely with the key creative team (including the Creative and Art Directors to name a few) to align the development vision with creative vision, as well as the goals for the franchise.
  • Being central to the recruitment process and providing help, insight, and consulting the relevant team members during the process. Identify top talent and the need for talent openings.
  • Communicating the progress of development to the key stakeholders.
  • Effectively communicating the entire project vision to the collective team, and ensure consistency throughout the entire team.
  • Introducing and implementing methodology to improve efficiency and productivity, while maintaining the key culture of the studio.

Requirements:

For this role we are looking for:

  • A demonstrated experience in game production or creative product management (e.g. app development), we are curently not seeing hard product management.
  • A demonstrated experience devising and implementing business plans, product pitches and/or a familiarity or experience with developing original intellectual property.
  • A familiarity with game production processes and the various methodologies used, as well as knoweldge about when and where to implement methodologies that improve studio output.
  • A creative leader and driven communicator who can effectively communicate various aspects of the business and development to the right people.
  • A background encompassing creative work, business-driven production with management experience.
  • A passion for videogames, and a solid understanding of the industry, including all the various aspects of game production (including budgeting, scheduling, HR, design, art, animation, localisation and QA, and third-party liaising and timeline management).
  • The ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

Remuneration:

The position is currently a contract royalty-based position, with view to full-time employment post-launch. The contract also includes immediate stock options with bonus options following on-time release.

Contract amount is competitive and negotiable.

Location:

While we prioritize Australian/New Zealand applicants, we are a remote studio and consider international applications.

Apply:

To apply, please click on the "Apply Now" button below.

Reach Game Studios Pty. Ltd. is a game development studio based in Sydney, Australia. Currently, the studio is working on action FPSRPG Glory. Reach Game Studios is a proudly diverse studio who value staff from all backgrounds and beliefs.

Gartner Executive Programs (ExP) is a service within Gartner Executive Technology Services (ETS) and is the indispensable tool for digital leaders. It is an exclusive, membership-based organization serving over 8,500 CIOs and senior IT leaders across 87 countries. These members (including Fortune 500 companies & Governments around the world) benefit from the convenience of a single source of knowledge and insight focused on CIO-level challenges, service delivery in their context, the shared knowledge of the world's largest community of CIOs, and the assurance of Gartner objectivity and independence.

  • Manage a portfolio of 28+ member relationships

  • Leverage subject matter expertise to create service solutions for clients utilizing all ExP products

  • Conduct a mix of on-site and virtual briefings, including workshops, research analyst visits, roundtables and webinars

  • Present or facilitate at ExP events where relevant

  • Build a strong partnership with Gartner’s Sales organization and collaborate with them to ensure member engagement and renewal of ExP business

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

  • Own and drive named account relationships across hyperscale, wireless, semiconductor, private 5G, NTN (non-terrestrial networks), and NEM (network equipment manufacturer) customer segments, in partnership with Marketing, Product Line Management, and Regional Sales leadership.

  • Gather and share competitive intelligence — competing products, systems, and positioning — with Product Line Management and Business Units to sharpen VIAVI's differentiation.
  • Solid understanding of major network transformations (5G/6G, RAN evolution, virtualization, and AI) and how VIAVI's portfolio helps customers in each target segment achieve their goals.
  • Track record of positioning complex, multi-product solutions (hardware and software) to technical and commercial stakeholders.

Ideal candidate would need to have the following characteristics to be successful:

  • LEADERSHIP: Although this is a individual contributor role, a preferred candidate will have strong leadership traits to work in a large matrixed environment. They should have the ability to build strong account strategies, set goals, motivate others, communicate effectively, assign ownership across organizations and hold people accountable to support goals.

Proven background and success building new logos and opening new market verticals, including through prospecting, networking and using relationship skills to open new opportunities for VIAVI. Ability to introduce cutting edge and new solutions to customers.

Must have proven experience operating with broad teams to achieve goals and execute on account / market strategies.

Can clearly demonstrate the ability to sell past technical requirements and into the economic drivers that help delivery positive business outcomes.

Dark Matter Mission Statement

To be the trusted innovation partner that empowers home lending. We fulfill this mission by earning trust through accountability and integrity, bringing clarity to complex challenges, collaborating across our ecosystem, and remaining dedicated to meaningful innovation and customer outcomes.


Position Summary

The Sales Executive IV - Strategic Partnerships is a quota-carrying sales role responsible for generating and closing revenue through a portfolio of strategic relationships, including technology providers, industry organizations, consultants, referral sources, and other ecosystem partners. The role builds and manages executive-level relationships, develops partner-specific account plans and qualified pipeline, and leads opportunities from initial identification through partnership go-to-market by educating partners on Dark Matter Technologies’ value, technology, client base, and ecosystem opportunities.

This role combines strategic partnership development with the ability to educate and inform partners about Dark Matter Technologies’ products, services, technology, client base, market reach, and ecosystem value. The Sales Executive positions solutions in the context of each partner’s business model and growth objectives, prepares estimates, negotiates commercial terms, and coordinates internal resources to deliver outcomes that align partner expectations with the company’s ability to execute. Success is measured by quota attainment, closed revenue, pipeline creation and conversion, forecast accuracy, and the growth and productivity of assigned relationships.


Essential Responsibilities

  • Own and achieve an assigned individual revenue quota, sales goals, and other performance objectives for the strategic partnerships channel.
  • Build, manage, and expand a portfolio of strategic partner relationships that generate referrals, partner-sourced opportunities, integrated solution sales, and recurring revenue growth.
  • Develop and execute relationship and account plans that define revenue targets, priority opportunities, key stakeholders, and the actions required to close business.
  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships with current and prospective partners, consultants, industry organizations, and other sources of qualified opportunities.
  • Create and maintain a healthy, qualified pipeline by identifying market opportunities, securing partner commitment, and advancing deals through each stage of the sales process.
  • Lead assigned opportunities from discovery through close by educating partners on Dark Matter Technologies’ technology, platform capabilities, client demand, market reach, and integration value; aligning the opportunity to the partner’s business objectives; positioning the solution; and managing pricing, negotiation, and contracting.
  • Structure and close agreements that create customer and partner value, meet revenue and margin expectations, and align with Dark Matter Technologies’ delivery capabilities and risk requirements.
  • Identify expansion opportunities within existing partner relationships, including new products, services, integrations, referral arrangements, pricing initiatives, and additional revenue channels.
  • Translate knowledge of Dark Matter Technologies’ products, services, technology, customer use cases, client base, markets, and competitive environment into clear business, integration, and revenue value that enables informed partner investment and go-to-market decisions.
  • Prepare and present pricing, commercial recommendations, partnership plans, business cases, forecasts, and performance updates to partner executives and internal leadership.
  • Maintain accurate and timely CRM records, including opportunity stage, amount, close date, next steps, relationship activity, and forecast; provide clear visibility into pipeline health, risks, and commitments.
  • Coordinate Product, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Implementation resources to resolve obstacles and move opportunities from strategy through execution and revenue realization.
  • Represent the company at industry events, partner meetings, executive forums, and trade associations to deepen relationships, strengthen market presence, and create new sales opportunities.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Performance Expectations

  • Consistent attainment of assigned revenue quota and sales objectives.
  • Measurable partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline growth.
  • Effective conversion of qualified opportunities into signed agreements and closed revenue.
  • Accurate, disciplined forecasting and CRM management.
  • Growth in revenue, opportunity volume, and strategic value across assigned relationships.
  • Effective management of complex sales cycles from discovery through close.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, finance, marketing, technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
  • 10+ years of progressive field sales, enterprise sales, strategic partnerships, business development, alliance management, or related commercial experience.
  • Demonstrated success carrying and attaining a revenue quota and closing complex, high-value sales or partnership agreements.
  • Proven experience building executive-level relationships and generating revenue through partners, channels, referrals, alliances, or ecosystem relationships.
  • Experience managing a full sales cycle, including prospecting, discovery, solution development, pricing, negotiation, contracting, forecasting, and close.
  • Experience engaging mortgage, fintech, financial services, and technology providers at the C-suite level, including educating executive stakeholders on technology capabilities, client demand, market opportunities, integration value, and the commercial benefits of partnership.
  • Strong record of leading cross-functional pursuits in a complex, matrixed environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in mortgage technology, fintech, financial services, or another regulated, technology-enabled industry.
  • Experience selling software products, technology-enabled services, integrations, platforms, or transaction-based solutions.
  • Experience developing or scaling referral channels, strategic alliances, and partner-led go-to-market motions.
  • Working knowledge of technology integrations, platform partnerships, commercial agreements, pricing, and product commercialization.
  • Established network among relevant technology and service providers, consultants, industry associations, financial institutions, or customer organizations.
  • Knowledge of Dark Matter Technologies’ products, services, and capabilities.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Expertise in translating complex technology solutions into clear business value for external partners. Ability to educate stakeholders on platform capabilities, market reach, client demand, and ecosystem opportunities, helping partners understand the strategic and revenue benefits of integration investments. Fosters alignment between business objectives and technology initiatives, enabling partners to make informed decisions that support mutual growth, customer adoption, and market expansion.
  • Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to establish credibility, communicate value, and influence senior decision-makers.
  • Strategic and commercial acumen, including the ability to translate partner relationships and market insights into qualified pipeline and closed revenue.
  • Strong pipeline management, forecasting, account-planning, and CRM discipline.
  • Financial and analytical capability, including pricing, business-case development, revenue forecasting, and performance measurement.
  • Cross-functional leadership and execution discipline, with the ability to coordinate resources and maintain deal momentum across long, complex sales cycles.
  • Ability to remain effective under pressure, manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, and travel up to 25%.

Compensation and Classification

  • This is a quota-carrying sales position with a competitive base salary and eligibility to participate in the applicable sales commission plan. Commission plan details are provided upon hire.

Core Values

  • Accountability: Owns commitments, sales activity, forecast accuracy, quota performance, and measurable customer and partner outcomes.
  • Integrity: Acts ethically and communicates transparently throughout the sales process, earning lasting trust with customers, partners, and colleagues.
  • Clarity: Simplifies complex solutions, commercial terms, priorities, and value propositions so stakeholders can make confident decisions.
  • Collaborative: Brings together the right internal and external capabilities to create stronger solutions and close business.
  • Dedicated: Maintains sustained focus on relationship development, pipeline progression, customer value, and revenue results.

WHO WE ARE

Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're looking for a high-performing, hunter-oriented Enterprise Account Executive to drive growth across the TOLA (Texas, Oklahoma, Louisiana, Arkansas) SLED (State, Local Government & Education) market.

In this role, you'll own the full enterprise sales cycle, partnering with state agencies, higher education institutions, and local government organizations to help them secure their most critical data as they adopt AI and cloud technologies. You'll work collaboratively with Sales Engineering, Customer Success, and our partner ecosystem to develop strategic account plans, generate pipeline, and close complex enterprise opportunities.

  • Experience selling into State, Local Government, and/or Higher Education (SLED).
  • Consistent history of exceeding quota and closing complex enterprise deals.
  • Executive-level communication skills.
  • Experience with long procurement-driven sales cycles.
  • Understanding of AWS, Azure, or GCP and modern security concepts preferred.

Position Summary
The Executive Client Partneris responsible forleadingDataSpring’smost strategic and consequential client relationships, including marquee health plan and healthcare organization partners represented onDataSpring’sBoard of Directors.

This role serves as the senior relationship owner across both executive decision-makers and operational leaders, ensuringDataSpringunderstands each partner’s strategic priorities, delivers measurablevalueandremainspositioned as a trusted, long-term advisor. The Executive Client Partner will build and sustain relationships across the client enterprise, from C-suite and board-level stakeholders to operational,technicaland functional leaders responsible for day-to-day execution.

The role is guided by four core principles:Protect, Influence,Innovateand Partner.

The Executive Client Partner will protectDataSpring’smost important relationships and revenue, influence strategic decisions and future direction,identifyopportunities to innovate alongside clients and partner closely withDataSpring’sExecutive Leadership Team and key cross-functional leaders to deliver a coordinated enterprise experience.

This individual will develop and execute comprehensive account strategies, strengthen executive alignment, drive value realization,anticipaterisksandidentifyopportunities to expand the partnership acrossDataSpring’sportfolio. The role requires a highly credible healthcare leader who can navigate complex organizations, build influence at the highestlevelsand translate client priorities into coordinated action acrossDataSpring.

The Executive Client Partner is a full-time, remote, exempt position and reports to the VP, Account Management.
This position will require the ability to travel up to 30% of the time.

Responsibilities

Executive Relationship Leadership

  • Serve as the senior relationship owner for a select portfolio of DataSpring’s largest, most strategic and highest-profile partners.
  • Build trusted relationships with board members, C-suite executives, senior decision-makers and operational leaders across assigned client organizations.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each client’s enterprise strategy, business objectives, operating environment, stakeholder dynamics and future priorities.
  • Establish and maintain multilevel relationship maps that ensure strong connections across executive, operational, technical, financial and procurement stakeholders.
  • Create a consistent and intentional executive engagement strategy, including executive sponsorship, strategic planning sessions, executive business reviews and ongoing leadership communication.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor who brings perspective, insight and recommendations beyond routine account management.

Protect Strategic Partnerships

  • Maintain accountability for the health, retention and long-term strength of DataSpring’s most important client relationships.
  • Anticipate relationship, performance, operational, financial and reputational risks before they affect the partnership.
  • Develop and lead comprehensive risk-mitigation and executive intervention plans.
  • Ensure emerging concerns are elevated with the appropriate context, recommended actions and clearly defined ownership.
  • Protect client trust by ensuring commitments are understood, coordinated and fulfilled across DataSpring.
  • Lead sensitive client discussions and escalations with sound judgment, executive presence and a solution-oriented approach.
  • Partner with DataSpring leadership to ensure marquee clients receive a consistent, proactive and differentiated experience.

Influence and Strategic Alignment

  • Translate client strategies, market pressures and leadership priorities into actionable implications for DataSpring.
  • Influence internal priorities by representing the voice of strategic clients across the Executive Leadership Team, Product, Sales, Operations, Marketing, Technology and other key functions.
  • Provide client and market intelligence that informs product strategy, operating priorities, investment decisions and go-to-market planning.
  • Shape executive conversations around client value, strategic direction, industry change and the future of the partnership.
  • Build alignment among client executives, operational stakeholders and DataSpring leaders around shared priorities and desired outcomes.
  • Help clients understand and prepare for DataSpring’s strategic initiatives, platform evolution and future-state capabilities.

Innovation and Partnership Expansion

  • Identify opportunities to innovate with clients through new solutions, expanded use cases, strategic pilots and collaborative initiatives.
  • Develop a clear understanding of client whitespace, unmet needs and future priorities.
  • Connect DataSpring’s broader portfolio and capabilities to client objectives in ways that create measurable enterprise value.
  • Partner with Sales and commercial leaders to develop and advance qualified growth and expansion opportunities.
  • Support strategic commercial discussions, renewal planning and complex negotiations in partnership with Sales, Finance, Legal and executive leadership.
  • Facilitate client participation in advisory groups, innovation forums, market-shaping discussions and other strategic initiatives.
  • Position DataSpring as a proactive partner in solving complex healthcare administrative and data challenges.

Strategic Account Planning and Value Realization

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive, multiyear strategic account plans for each assigned partner.
  • Define clear relationship, adoption, value, retention, innovation and growth objectives.
  • Establish measurable success outcomes and ensure DataSpring can demonstrate the value delivered through its solutions and partnership.
  • Lead executive business reviews that connect performance, insights and opportunities to the client’s strategic priorities.
  • Monitor account health across relationship strength, engagement, solution adoption, operational performance, support experience, financial position and future opportunity.
  • Translate account data, client feedback and industry trends into clear recommendations and executive action plans.
  • Maintain accurate and timely strategic account information in Salesforce and other designated systems.

Enterprise Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with DataSpring’s Executive Leadership Team to establish and execute coordinated strategies for marquee client relationships.
  • Lead cross-functional account teams that may include Sales, Product, Operations, Technology, Implementation, Analytics, Finance, Legal and Communications.
  • Establish clear ownership, decision-making, timelines and accountability across complex client initiatives.
  • Ensure clients experience DataSpring as one coordinated organization rather than a collection of separate functions or products.
  • Mobilize the appropriate internal leaders and subject-matter experts based on client priorities, risks and opportunities.
  • Facilitate internal executive account reviews to assess relationship health, strategic priorities, commitments and next actions.
  • Provide guidance and leadership to Client Partnerships colleagues supporting the operational aspects of assigned accounts.

Organizational and Market Leadership

  • Model the standards, behaviors and strategic discipline expected across the Client Partnerships organization.
  • Contribute to the development of executive-engagement practices, strategic account playbooks, health frameworks and relationship-management standards.
  • Share market, client and competitive insights that strengthen DataSpring’s enterprise strategy.
  • Represent DataSpring at client events, executive meetings, industry forums and other external engagements.
  • Support a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation and client-centered decision-making.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare administration, public health or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • Ten to fifteen years of progressive experience in strategic account management, client partnerships, customer success, consulting, healthcare leadership or another senior client-facing role.
  • Significant experience working with health plans, provider organizations, healthcare technology companies or healthcare administrative solutions is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success managing complex, high-value enterprise relationships with multiple products, stakeholders and business priorities.
  • Experience engaging and influencing board members, C-suite executives and senior operational decision-makers.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to establish credibility as a trusted strategic advisor.
  • Demonstrated success protecting and expanding strategic client relationships, including retention, renewals, adoption, value realization and growth.
  • Experience developing and executing multiyear strategic account plans and executive-engagement strategies.
  • Ability to understand complex healthcare business challenges and connect them to data, technology and administrative solutions.
  • Strong commercial judgment, including experience identifying whitespace, shaping expansion opportunities and supporting complex commercial discussions.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify emerging risks, lead executive escalations and navigate sensitive or high-stakes client situations.
  • Experience leading complex cross-functional teams and initiatives without direct authority.
  • Ability to influence internal executives and translate client priorities into organizational action.
  • Strong strategic thinking, business judgment and decision-making capabilities.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation and facilitation skills, including the ability to lead board-level and executive-level discussions.
  • Ability to synthesize client, market, financial, product and operational information into clear insights and recommendations.
  • Strong organizational discipline and the ability to manage a select portfolio of highly complex relationships and priorities.
  • Experience with Salesforce or another enterprise customer relationship management platform.
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly for executive meetings, client engagements and industry events.

Who We Are

DataSpring is the trusted data connector at the core of healthcare. For more than 25 years, we have powered the industry with the largest and most complete healthcare data foundation in the U.S., including more than 4.8 million provider data records sourced directly from providers and member data representing 75% of covered lives supplied by health plans. By improving how essential information flows across the system, DataSpring helps healthcare operate more efficiently, accurately, and with greater confidence.

What You Get

At DataSpring, you will do meaningful work at the intersection of healthcare, data, and technology, helping solve complex problems that make the healthcare system work better. You will collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about accuracy, trust, and meaningful impact in a fully remote environment.

DataSpring offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company contributions and matching, paid parental leave, tuition assistance, and generous paid time off. We are committed to investing in our people and supporting professional growth over time.

Equal Opportunity Employer

DataSpring is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering a workplace where all individuals are valued, respected, and empowered.

DataSpring does not tolerate unlawful discrimination or harassment of any kind.

About ZRG:

For nearly 25 years, ZRG has been helping our clients move forward in their industries and our candidates move forward in their careers. We started as a boutique retained executive search firm with a handful of talent professionals. Today, we are a global talent advisory firm, providing people solutions for our clients' most complex talent issues. Our core offerings include revolutionary, data-based, executive search focusing on senior leadership around the world. Our suite of on-demand talent offerings helps backfill open roles and address project-based work with specialized talent. Our consulting and advisory solutions focus on key issues like culture, strategic alignment, coaching, and sales optimization.

Leveraging our global platform of over 500 teammates with a tech-powered solution kit, ZRG is a leading talent advisory firm for leading-edge clients.

Role Summary:

Bravanti (a ZRG Company) helps leaders, people, and organizations find the power within to lead bravely and be prepared to meet challenges and seize opportunities in a continually uncertain business environment.

Bravanti’s Executive Coaching team is seeking exceptional, experienced executive coaches to join our cadre of elite partners. We are proud of the high-caliber practice we have built and the transformative impact our coaches deliver to leaders and their organizations.

We partner with coaches who share our belief that executive coaching changes lives in powerful ways—starting with clear leadership goals, but always addressing the whole person. Coaching empowers good leaders to become great, delivering measurable personal growth and organizational ROI. Our engagements are structured, time-bound, and built on trust, mutual respect, ownership, and accountability.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct formal, contractual executive coaching engagements focused on clearly defined leadership goals and holistic personal/professional development.
  • Serve as guide, challenger, and cheerleader—keeping the process on track, providing insight, removing obstacles, and holding the leader accountable to their goals.
  • Monitor and measure individual leader progress and organizational ROI throughout the engagement.
  • Deliver coaching within a finite, momentum-driven timeframe that maximizes benefit and sets the leader up for long-term success post-engagement.
  • Uphold the highest standards of trust, confidentiality, mutual respect, and professionalism in every client interaction.

Qualifications:

  • Graduation from an ICF-accredited coaching school.
  • At least 5 years of experience coaching executives in formal, contractual engagements (or equivalent equitable experience).
  • Demonstrated personal corporate leadership experience and a high level of business acumen.

If interested complete this survey.

This is an exclusive, independent contractor affiliation with Bravanti. Coaches can maintain their own thriving private practices and commit to exclusive partnership with us for executive coaching services (exceptions for non-profit or academic affiliations).
