Position: Executive Assistant to the CEO – Executive Operations & Account Management

Location: Remote – South Africa

Employment Type: Permanent, Full-Time

Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 08:00–16:00 Pacific Time (USA)

South African Working Hours:

  • 17:00–01:00 SAST during US daylight saving time.
  • 18:00–02:00 SAST during US standard time (from 1 November 2026).

Start Date: As soon as possible

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a highly organised, proactive and experienced Executive Assistant to provide direct support to the Founder & CEO of a fast-growing, US-based technology business.

This is an exciting opportunity for a high-performing professional who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment and enjoys taking ownership of executive administration, financial operations, client communications and business coordination.

The successful candidate will act as the CEO's right hand, ensuring daily operations run smoothly while supporting strategic business activities.

This position offers a clear career progression opportunity into Account Management, with increasing responsibility for client relationships, customer onboarding and project coordination

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. Executive & Personal Assistance

  • Manage the CEO's inbox, calendar, appointments and daily scheduling.
  • Draft professional, accurate and well-structured emails and client communications.
  • Coordinate meetings with clients, prospects, partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Arrange travel, accommodation and business appointments.
  • Handle personal administration, expense tracking and ad hoc requests.
  • Conduct research and prepare reports, presentations and meeting summaries.
  • Anticipate the CEO's needs and proactively manage priorities.

2. Financial Administration & Operations

  • Manage bill payments, vendor payments and invoicing.
  • Assist with payroll administration and payment processing.
  • Track expenses, invoices and financial records.
  • Coordinate internal administrative processes and operational workflows.
  • Ensure payments, documentation and financial information are accurate and processed on time.
  • Identify opportunities to improve administrative efficiency and implement better systems.

3. Client Communication & Account Support

  • Prepare professional client follow-up emails based on meeting notes and discussions.
  • Coordinate client meetings, scheduling and ongoing communication.
  • Respond to client requests and ensure timely follow-ups.
  • Assist with customer onboarding and implementation processes.
  • Track client deliverables, action items and outstanding tasks.
  • Support account management activities as knowledge of the business develops.
  • Maintain excellent communication standards when dealing with senior stakeholders and enterprise clients.

4. Project Management & Business Coordination

  • Coordinate projects, deadlines and internal team activities.
  • Monitor outstanding tasks and ensure deliverables are completed.
  • Maintain organised workflows and project documentation.
  • Support quality assurance reviews of software, data and internal processes.
  • Identify operational challenges and proactively recommend solutions.

5. Systems, Technology & AI Tools

  • Use Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Calendar, Docs and Sheets.
  • Work with Microsoft Excel for reporting, tracking and administration.
  • Utilise HubSpot CRM for client information, follow-ups and account coordination.
  • Leverage AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and automation platforms to improve productivity.
  • Use AI-assisted meeting notes and summaries to prepare accurate, professional client correspondence.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline repetitive administrative processes.

Minimum Requirements

  • 5–10 years of relevant experience in executive assistance, business administration, operations or similar roles preferred.
  • Previous experience supporting a US-based startup CEO or Founder remotely is essential.
  • Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Demonstrated experience drafting professional client-facing emails and business correspondence.
  • Hands-on experience with invoicing, vendor payments, bill payments and payroll administration.
  • Strong proficiency in Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, particularly Excel, calendars and document management.
  • Excellent organisational, multitasking and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Experience managing confidential business and financial information.
  • Comfortable working US Pacific Time hours on a permanent basis.
  • Must be available for full-time, exclusive employment, without conflicting employment commitments.

Advantageous Experience

  • Experience working within a SaaS, technology or startup environment.
  • Customer success, client onboarding or account management experience.
  • HubSpot CRM experience.
  • Familiarity with AI tools, workflow automation and productivity platforms.
  • Experience coordinating projects and customer implementations.
  • Exposure to sales support, lead management, prospecting or business development.
  • Experience supporting high-value enterprise clients.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Exceptionally detail-oriented: Produces accurate, polished work with no careless errors.
  • An outstanding communicator: Writes clear, concise, professional emails and confidently communicates with senior stakeholders.
  • Proactive and independent: Anticipates needs, solves problems and takes initiative without constant direction.
  • Highly organised: Effectively manages multiple priorities, deadlines and responsibilities.
  • Commercially minded: Understands the importance of client relationships, customer experience and business growth.
  • Tech-savvy: Comfortable learning new systems and using AI tools to improve efficiency.
  • Accountable and reliable: Takes ownership of responsibilities and consistently delivers results.
  • Ambitious: Interested in long-term career development and progressing into account management.

Career Growth Opportunity

This position is designed for someone seeking more than a traditional Executive Assistant role.

As the successful candidate becomes familiar with the company's operations, technology and client base, they will have the opportunity to transition into broader Account Management and Customer Success responsibilities, including:

  • Managing client relationships and communications.
  • Coordinating customer onboarding and implementation projects.
  • Overseeing client requests, deliverables and follow-ups.
  • Supporting long-term customer satisfaction and retention.

Application Requirements

Shortlisted candidates may be required to complete:

  1. An updated CV outlining relevant executive support and operational experience.
  2. A short video introduction demonstrating professional communication skills.
  3. A brief written assessment involving drafting a client-facing email from meeting notes.

Summary:

VIAVI (NASDAQ: VIAV) is a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. VIAVI is also a leader in light management technologies for 3D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications.

We are the people behind the products that help keep the world connected at home, school, work, at play, and everywhere in between. VIAVI employees are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Position Summary

VIAVI Solutions is seeking an accomplished sales executive to lead growth for our NITRO CORE, NITRO RAN, and NITRO AIOps assurance solutions across North America. In this strategic role, you will own the full sales cycle within a portfolio of existing and target accounts, positioning VIAVI software, services, and hardware against our customers' most pressing network challenges. This position reports to the Vice President of Sales, Americas.

As wireline and wireless networks grow more complex, operators depend on real-time visibility into network and service performance to protect the subscriber experience. The VIAVI NITRO portfolio delivers that visibility: NITRO CORE for mobile packet and IMS core assurance, NITRO RAN for radio access network performance, and NITRO AIOps for AI-driven service operations and automation. You will work closely with end customers, development partners, and VIAVI engineering and marketing teams to shape solution strategy, grow market share, and translate complex technology into a clear business case.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the North America sales strategy for NITRO CORE, NITRO RAN, and NITRO AIOps in support of VIAVI growth objectives.
  • Drive the solution-sales effort in assigned accounts, managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from qualification through close.
  • Build and maintain executive-level customer relationships and support customers across the full product life cycle.
  • Align VIAVI solutions to customer business metrics and KPIs, scoping projects that combine software, services, and hardware.
  • Conduct competitive analysis through research and dialogue with customers, partners, and VIAVI business-unit experts, and use it to sharpen positioning.
  • Partner with customers, sales, and business development to identify and define solution requirements, and articulate VIAVI key value propositions.
  • Collaborate with VIAVI engineering, support, and services teams to define and deliver new solutions.
  • Manage the interfaces between the client and VIAVI business-unit support teams.
  • Support management in building business plans and new growth initiatives for North America.

Pre-Requisites / Skills / Experience Requirements:

Required Qualifications

Role Overview:

The National Account Executive (NAE) is responsible for strategic management of large and/or complex national accounts. This role focuses on driving revenue through deep customer engagement, consultative partnership, and the sale of additional products and services. The NAE leads the development and execution of account strategies, oversees implementation for new and expanding business, and plays a critical role in maintaining persistency, profitability, and customer satisfaction.

Travel up to 25% is required.

**Preferred candidate location is within the Pacific or Mountain time zones, and/or Texas.**

What You’ll Do:

Strategic Account Management:Manage a disciplined engagement process including goals, strategies, and tactics to grow and retain a book of business. Develop deep, trust-based relationships that support a consultative partnership with customers. Act as a strategic advisor, ensuring alignment to customer objectives and evolving business needs.

Book of Business Management:Build and execute annual plans to achieve targets for persistency, profitability, renewals, and referrals. Maintain strong ownership of results and demonstrate urgency to exceed performance expectations. Promote new products, initiatives, and value-added services across assigned accounts.

Pre-Sale and Sales Support:Participate in pre-sale meetings and finalist presentations. Partner with Sales Representatives to enhance producer relationships and improve sales success rates. Identify and develop credible referral opportunities.

Implementation & Onboarding Oversight:Lead onboarding of new sold cases and additional lines of coverage. Establish expectations with clients and producers regarding contract provisions and requirements. Coordinate cross functional partners to ensure accurate and timely case installation. Collaborate closely with the National Account Service Representative to maintain smooth administrative setup.

Service Administration & Issue Resolution:Oversee service requests, issue resolution, contract changes, and administrative inquiries in partnership with the Service Representative. Maintain proactive communication with clients and producers throughout the lifecycle of the account.

Ongoing Client & Producer Engagement:Plan and lead quarterly client meetings with proactive, strategic agendas. Monitor changes in client needs, HR priorities, and corporate environments to anticipate emerging opportunities. Support annual enrollment planning and execution. Identify and pursue additional lines of coverage and cross sell opportunities.

Renewal Strategy & Execution:Coordinate renewal deliverables across underwriting, claims, and sales. Leverage trends and financial analysis to deliver meaningful product and performance insights. Identify rate guarantee extension opportunities well in advance of renewal. Lead postmortem analyses for any cancelled cases to drive organizational learning.

  • Minimum 5 years in Account Management or Underwriting.
  • Group Life & Health Sales License required.
  • Financial and analytical acumen with strong presentation skills.
  • Competitive market insight into group insurance products and strategies – specifically Absence, Life, and Supplemental Health.

raw.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Bilingual Spanish-English Executive Assistant to provide administrative and executive support to leadership. The ideal candidate is fluent in both Spanish and English, has strong written and verbal communication skills, and can manage schedules, coordinate meetings, handle correspondence, and support day-to-day business operations. This role requires discretion, adaptability, and the ability to communicate professionally with Spanish- and English-speaking clients, colleagues, and business partners.

I. Executive and Administrative Support

  • Provide day-to-day administrative support to executives and leadership.

  • Manage calendars, schedule appointments, coordinate meetings, and send reminders.

  • Organize travel arrangements, including flights, accommodations, itineraries, and transportation.

  • Prepare meeting agendas, take minutes, and track action items.

  • Maintain organized digital files, documents, and records.

II. Bilingual Communication and Coordination

  • Communicate professionally with clients, colleagues, and business partners in both Spanish and English.

  • Draft, proofread, and translate emails, business correspondence, reports, and other documents as needed.

  • Assist with Spanish-English communication during meetings, calls, and virtual conferences.

  • Respond to inquiries, relay messages, and coordinate information between Spanish- and English-speaking stakeholders.

  • Ensure communications are clear, accurate, and appropriate for the intended audience.

III. Email and Correspondence Management

  • Monitor and organize executive inboxes, prioritize messages, and flag urgent matters.

  • Draft responses to routine inquiries and follow up on pending communications.

  • Maintain professional correspondence with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Track important deadlines, requests, and commitments to ensure timely responses.

Requirements:

  • Fluency in both Spanish and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages.

  • Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or in a similar support role.

  • Excellent organizational, time-management, and multitasking skills.

  • Strong written communication, proofreading, and document preparation skills.

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, calendar management tools, and virtual meeting platforms.

  • Ability to handle confidential information and exercise sound judgment.

  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote-work setup.

  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines.

  • Availability to work according to the executive's required time zone.

Qualifications:

  • Previous experience supporting U.S.-based executives or international teams.

  • Experience working in a remote or virtual support environment.

  • Familiarity with project management tools, CRM platforms, and business communication software.

  • Experience translating or coordinating professional communications between Spanish- and English-speaking stakeholders.

HIS Sales Strategy Executive – Ambulatory Care (Solventum)


3M Health Care is now Solventum


At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.


We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.


The Impact You’ll Make in this Role

As a Sales Strategy Executive – Ambulatory Care Revenue Cycle, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

  • Bringing industry expertise and advisement to clients and prospects to set short- and long-term strategic direction to meet their needs in the ambulatory Revenue Cycle.
  • Achieving overall sales objectives and quota, partnered with the account sales teams, by providing strategic positioning of ambulatory care services and solutions.
  • Collaborating with account teams, during the sales process, to tailor and present HIS solutions and services for multi-faceted clients using revenue cycle expertise
  • Promoting the adoption of Solventum Ambulatory solutions by serving as subject matter expert and an industry spokesperson.
  • Aligning with product launch and marketing teams to develop target-market strategies as emerging technology becomes generally available.

Your Skills and Expertise

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher AND seven (7) years of health information technology and/or consulting services in a private, public, government or military environment.

OR

  • High School Diploma AND eleven (11) years of health information technology and/or consulting services in a private, public, government or military environment.

AND

  • 3 years of leadership experience in revenue cycle within ambulatory care settings—including hospital outpatient departments, physician offices, and clinics—or in health information technology, consulting services, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

  • Comprehensive understanding of ambulatory revenue cycle operations, including document capture, coding, clinical documentation improvement, billing, and payment across hospital outpatient departments, physician offices, and clinics.
  • Leverage industry experience to strategically align Solventum value proposition to the objectives of the client organization during the sales process
  • Ability to analyze client revenue cycle data, translate findings into actionable strategies, and clearly communicate return on investment throughout the sales process.
  • Experience positioning and presenting value/benefits with “C level” decision makers
  • Serve as a trusted advisor in a team-selling environment, demonstrating a client-centric approach throughout the sales process.
  • MBA preferred

About the Team

Join a high-performing sales team focused on helping financial institutions mitigate risk, prevent fraud, and make informed identity and trust decisions. Our team partners with broker-dealers, banks, wealth management firms, and other financial services organizations to deliver innovative fraud, identity, risk, and analytics solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.

We are a collaborative, client-focused group that works closely with Product, Data Science, and Professional Services teams to deliver strategic solutions that address complex industry challenges and create long-term customer value. We seek experienced sales professionals who have successfully engaged executive leadership within major financial institutions and guided organizations through enterprise-wide technology and risk transformation initiatives.


About the Role

We are seeking a results-driven Enterprise Sales Executive / Account Manager to lead growth initiatives within the broker-dealer and broader financial services market. This role is primarily focused on identifying, developing, and closing new business opportunities while strategically managing a select portfolio of existing accounts.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of enterprise sales success selling software, data, analytics, fraud, identity, risk, or fintech solutions to large financial institutions. You will build executive-level relationships, develop strategic account plans, and position high-value solutions that help clients achieve their business objectives while driving significant revenue growth.

This role requires a consultative sales leader who excels in complex, multi-stakeholder sales environments and can effectively navigate executive decision-making processes across Tier 1 banks, broker-dealers, capital m

arkets firms, and other financial services organizations.

Responsibilities

  • Drive new business development within the broker-dealer and financial services market through proactive prospecting, pipeline generation, strategic account engagement, and executive relationship development.
  • Identify, qualify, and close complex, high-value, multi-year sales opportunities with enterprise clients.
  • Develop and execute territory plans focused on broker-dealers, banks, wealth management firms, capital markets organizations, and adjacent financial services institutions.

  • Experience selling SaaS, data, analytics, or risk platforms within regulated financial services environments.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms, strategic account planning, and sales forecasting methodologies.
  • Strong analytical, business development, and strategic planning capabilities.
  • Experience developing executive business cases, board-level presentations, and enterprise proposals for large financial institutions.
  • Established network of executive relationships within the broker-dealer, banking, wealth management, or financial services sectors.

raw.description:
This is a remote role; however, we only operate in the following states: AZ, FL, GA, IL, IN, MA, MI, MN, MO, NC, NJ, NY, OH, PA, TX and WI.

ABOUT SULLIVANCOTTER

SullivanCotter partners with health care and other not-for-profit organizations to enhance performance and improve outcomes by developing and implementing integrated workforce strategies. Using our time-tested methodologies and industry-leading research and information, we provide data-driven insights, expertise, and solutions to help organizations align business strategy and performance objectives – enabling our clients to deliver on their mission, vision and values.

ABOUT THE EXECUTIVE WORKFORCE SERVICES PRACTICE

Our Executive Workforce Services consultants provide comprehensive advisory services spanning executive compensation, governance, and leadership strategy. We help organizations define and implement effective executive compensation programs that align with market benchmarks, organizational strategies, and regulatory requirements. Our expertise includes governance support for boards and committees, performance evaluations for executives, and design of competitive total compensation. We also advise on executive benefits and pay-for-performance strategies. Additionally, we provide insights on emerging trends, regulatory compliance, mergers and acquisitions, and employment agreements to ensure a holistic and compliant approach to executive talent management.

PRIMARY ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Provide comprehensive executive compensation consulting services and develop, implement, and/or administer executive compensation programs
  • Provide subject matter expertise and serve as a market expert regarding specific client market compensation issues
  • Conduct executive job evaluations; analyze job responsibilities, activities, duties, requirements, and organizational structure and recommend internal job placement in the appropriate level and title
  • Conduct market pricing, peer group selection, survey analyses, interpreting compensation data, financial modeling, and special research projects
  • Analyze data to determine the appropriate compensation level and job title for existing and proposed executive positions, including more complex positions involving responsibilities within multiple focus areas
  • Identify complex job matching and data issues and proactively consult with clients and key associates to determine the appropriate course of action, acting quickly to remove obstacles impeding project steps
  • Effectively keep the project manager apprised of project status, including delays or potential problems, holding self and team members accountable for client deadlines and deliverables
  • Assist with more complex report and proposal writing related to describing and summarizing project objectives, methodologies, analysis and results, and proof for accuracy
  • Serve as a peer reviewer and mentor of technical knowledge to effectively guide more junior associates in complex research, data collection, and analytics
  • Participate in appropriate client delivery team meetings to understand team and client initiatives
  • Establish client relationships and act as a key point of contact for client inquiries, as appropriate
  • Shadow project and client relationship managers at client meetings or teleconferences, as requested

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in a business-related field, ideally with an emphasis in finance, economics, statistics, mathematics, accounting, or health care administration
  • One to five years of progressive experience directly consulting with clients
  • Three to five years of related analytical experience required involving data analysis, financial modeling, and presentation design
  • Compensation consulting experience preferred
  • Solid technical knowledge and experience working with Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; basic programming experience is a plus
  • Strong critical thinking skills and the ability to:
    • Determine appropriate data analytic approaches and tools based on project tasks and client requirements
    • Analyze, organize, and interpret data using a logical and systematic process
    • Remove irrelevant data when conducting analytical work and developing creative solutions
    • Visualize and articulate complex problems and concepts
    • Recognize patterns in complex sets of data and recommend practical models
    • Identify and recommend solutions to remove obstacles impeding project steps or task achievement
  • Knowledge of laws and regulations that impact our health care clients
  • Excellent interpersonal, writing, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to:
    • Make clear and convincing oral presentations that achieve a specific purpose
    • Successfully tailor communications to the audience, as appropriate
    • Effectively present facts, analysis, and conclusions or solutions in a way that demonstrates command of content
    • Write concise project communications, documents, and presentations with an appropriate level of technical detail and complexity
    • Use an appropriate writing style consistent with organizational guidelines, templates, and brand standards
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills; ability to manage and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Self-starter with demonstrated ability to successfully assist with complex project deliverables in a driven and changing organization
  • Flexible, adaptable, and able to work under tight deadlines or changing needs
  • Confidence and ability to work independently and in a team structure
  • Intellectually curious, seeking opportunities to develop new skills

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master's degree in a business-related field
  • Certified Compensation or Benefits Professional designation
  • Experience working within a consulting, compensation, or health care-related firm

SALARY, BENEFITS AND PERKS

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • Medical and dental coverage at no premium cost for employees
  • 401(k) and profit-sharing retirement plans
  • Flexible spending accounts
  • Paid time off (PTO)
  • Company-paid holidays
  • Gender-neutral parental leave
  • Bereavement and pet leave
  • Continuing education and professional accreditation sponsorship
  • Life and AD&D insurance
  • Short- and long-term disability
  • Employee assistance program
  • Mental health support program
  • Additional perks

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors including but not limited to academic achievements, skills and experience. The range listed is just one component of the compensation package offered to candidates.

  • $101,400 - 142,000 annually

OUR VALUES IN ACTION: HOW WE CARE

We live our values daily through four commitments:

  • Connect: Collaborate selflessly to support others, advance ideas, and solve problems using critical thinking.
  • Act: Bring integrity and respect to every interaction—no exceptions.
  • Reach: Commit to continuous learning and knowledge sharing that strengthens teams and clients.
  • Embrace: Foster inclusion and belonging so everyone can thrive and contribute.

raw.excerpt: Evergreen Services Group is a San Francisco-based holding company that acquires and operates B2B services companies across North America.
raw.description:
Evergreen Services Group is a San Francisco-based holding company that acquires and operates B2B services companies across North America. Since its founding in late 2017, Evergreen has completed 100+ acquisitions across Managed IT Services, Cybersecurity, ERP Software Partners and Government Services. We are driven by a people-first mission to be the best home for businesses and their leaders, by marrying capital allocation with inspired operations.

The Evergreen holding company team is comprised of 40+ professionals based in San Francisco who are focused on capital allocation, M&A, executive level hiring, strategic board leadership, and finance and accounting. Evergreen is a uniquely long-term oriented holding company that seeks to hold and grow businesses indefinitely rather than follow the 5-7 year holding period of a typical private equity fund. This allows us to take a truly long-term view on performance and people. Evergreen is backed by Alpine Investors, a leading private equity firm focused on the services and software industries with $16B+ in AUM.

The Opportunity (Future Leadership Roles)

This posting is intended to build a pipeline of exceptional leadership talent for future opportunities. It is not tied to a specific open position. We regularly acquire new businesses across the United States, and this role description reflects the type of Operating Executive profiles we seek as those opportunities arise.

We are looking for Operating Executives to take on high-impact leadership roles within new businesses acquired throughout the United States. Operating Executives will be responsible for driving organic EBITDA growth and recurring revenue at an operating company through active management and strategic leadership. We believe leadership talent is a key lever to a company's performance and are seeking Operating Executives to inspire the highest levels of performance, followership, and employee engagement within their company.

We primarily hire first-time CEOs into our operating companies and are seeking individuals who are ready to step up to the challenge and opportunity. The ideal candidate will be able to make difficult trade-off decisions between growth and profitability, hold teams accountable to budgets and targets, and create a winning environment of support and success.

With determination and persistence, Operating Executives should be willing to attack tough problems, skillfully analyze and identify root causes and partner with the leadership team to come up with actionable solutions that drive businesses growth.

Responsibilities:

P&L Ownership:

  • Develop and execute strategic plans to achieve financial targets, such as year-over-year monthly recurring revenue growth and year-over-year annual EBITDA growth.
  • Monitor and analyze financial performance, identifying areas for revenue growth and cost-saving opportunities.
  • Prepare and present financial reports, budgets, and forecasts to senior leadership and stakeholders.
  • Strong command of P&L and key levers that drive impact
  • Plan and execute long-term vision that drives sustainable growth
  • Financial discipline to drive growth in a cost-effective manner
  • Makes effective ROI resource-based decisions

Sales and Business Development:

  • Drive revenue growth through effective sales strategies, market analysis, and client relationship management.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients and partners.
  • Involvement in local organizations and business development groups, such as the Chamber of Commerce.
  • Continuously assess market trends, competitive landscapes, and customer needs to adapt and refine sales strategies.
  • Experience or ability with selling and closing on new logo.
  • Experience or ability to institutionalize sales & marketing and build a high-performing sales & marketing team.
  • Understanding of sales funnel and KPIs that drive successful sales & marketing actions and initiatives.

People Management and Leadership:

  • Experience with leading a high-performing, results-oriented team by recruiting, training, and developing team members.
  • Set clear goals and expectations, provide regular feedback, and drive a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Cultivate a healthy, effective team dynamic among the leadership team.
  • Ability to motivate and inspire.
  • Ability and willingness to delegate

Operational Excellence:

  • Streamline and optimize operational processes and procedures to enhance efficiency.
  • Ensure compliance with industry regulations and company policies.
  • Monitor inventory management, supply chain, and logistics to maintain product/service quality and availability.
  • Implement best practices and maintain a focus on quality control.

Data-Driven Decision Making:

  • Data-driven approach to prioritization of growth efforts. Sets goals and follows through with them
  • Understand, prioritize, and execute on key growth levers: new customers, retention, pricing, cross-sell/up-sell
  • Grounds decisions in data or evidence
  • Appetite to create and exceed metrics

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree; MBA or equivalent is a plus.
  • Has a track record of achieving revenue generation targets on a limited budget, with a specific focus on new logo revenue
  • Strong background in people management, including hiring, firing, training, and development.
  • Demonstrated expertise in financial management, budgeting, and P&L responsibility.
  • Resourceful and scrappy; willing to roll up sleeves to dig into large strategic challenges as well as day-to-day, unexpected crises
  • Proven experience in an SMB general management or senior leadership role is a plus. Experience in an MSP or SaaS business is also a plus.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and a strategic mindset.
  • Proficiency in utilizing technology and data-driven decision-making.
  • Exceptional leadership and team-building capabilities.

We are looking for people that are primarily Location Agnostic, or are available to relocate within one of the following regions: West, Midwest, South West, South East, North East

We encourage you to apply even if you feel that you do not meet all of the above qualifications. Frequently cited statistics show that women and underrepresented groups apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Evergreen encourages you to break that statistic and to apply. No one ever meets 100% of the requirements. We look forward to your application!

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION AT EVERGREEN

At Evergreen, we acknowledge that an emphasis on diversity, equity, and inclusion (“DE&I”) is essential to hiring phenomenal people. To create the best home for businesses and spark success at our firm and throughout our portfolio, we aim to establish an environment where every person is welcomed, accepted, and empowered to excel in their role. These beliefs run true to our People-first philosophy, which emphasizes attributes over experience, we strive to recruit and work with those from a range of backgrounds, which drives creativity and innovation. At Evergreen, we recognize that we must continue to improve and expand and we are enthusiastic about maintaining Evergreen as one of the best places to work by ensuring a culture of inclusion and allowing everyone an unbiased opportunity to grow.

Compensation

A competitive compensation package will be offered alongside a benefits package including full medical and dental coverage, unlimited PTO, 401(k) match, family planning support, and much more.

Evergreen Services Group is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion (including religious dress and grooming practices), sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, breastfeeding, and conditions related to breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, age (40 or over), physical or medical disability, medical condition, marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military and/or veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable state or federal law. As an equal opportunity employer, we offer competitive compensation packages, robust benefits and professional growth opportunities aimed at helping to improve our employees' lives and careers.

raw.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 115,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
  • An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution.
  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

In Abbott’s Electrophysiology (EP) business, we’re advancing the treatment of heart disease through breakthrough medical technologies in atrial fibrillation, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

What You’ll Work On

The Executive Clinical Specialist is responsible for being a technical leader, in the top 10% of all Abbott Clinical Employees. They provide expert consulting, teaching, and support for electrophysiologists on the EnSite Mapping System and its appropriate application in the clinical setting. The Executive Clinical Specialist is a significant driver of business within their Area and is a mentor to Principle and Senior Clinical Specialists. They are expected to provide consulting to customers on the complete EP product line. They provide collaboration with Area Vice Presidents and Regional Sales Directors to develop business at Strategic Accounts within each Area. They participate in the sales and marketing process and is responsible for ensuring all new accounts are established in accordance with Abbott’s EP Division’s educational and in-service specific objectives and that ongoing product utilization is encouraged when necessary or requested through in-lab support and consultation with the EP and other lab support personnel. They serve in a “Lead” capacity for other clinical employees in the region.

  • Manages regional training budgets as directed by the Regional Sales Director and Area Vice President to ensure goals are accomplished through fiscal responsibility.
  • Maximizes revenue opportunity through demonstrated consultative selling of a broad range of EP products at Strategic Accounts within each sales Region and Area.
  • Works with marketing and education to develop and provide formal training and education to electrophysiologists and their staff on the use of the EnSite Mapping System.
  • Works with marketing and education to develop and provide formal training and education to electrophysiologists and their staff on the use of the Claris Recording System and Viewmate Ultrasound System.
  • Demonstrates a thorough command of EnSite System related product and technical knowledge; cardiac mapping, ablation techniques, anatomy, and clinical science.
  • Provides expert clinical consultation on the use of our system to the EP, and lab support staff.
  • Coordinates all necessary logistics related to hospital training for new and existing accounts.

Who we are:

Reliable Controls is dedicated to reducing the carbon footprint of buildings around the world. Our team specializes in the design, development, and assembly of building automation controls and software programs. We're working hard to create solutions for building operators to enable the vision of Net-Zero Emissions by 2050.

We align ourselves with the right people and empower them in the right ways. An established company based in Victoria, Canada, we nurture a strong culture of communication, trust, and collaboration. Embracing a work–life balance, promoting continuous learning, and celebrating our achievements are a few of the ways we show our enduring commitment to employees.

Your mission:

As a Business Development Executive, you’ll be responsible for growing and supporting Reliable Controls’ Authorized Dealer network across the Middle East and Africa. You’ll combine your technical knowledge, commercial judgment, and relationship-building skills to help existing dealers succeed, develop new partnerships, and identify opportunities for sustainable regional growth. With significant ownership over your region, you’ll help strengthen our market presence while helping Reliable Controls earn and sustain our reputation for having the most satisfied customers in the building automation industry.

In this role you will:

  • Build strong, trusted relationships with Reliable Controls Authorized Dealers across the Middle East and Africa, helping them grow their businesses and deliver an exceptional customer experience.
  • Provide first-line technical and commercial support to dealers, helping them identify the right solutions for customer opportunities.
  • Support dealers with pricing, proposals, bids, and project opportunities to help strengthen their pipelines and achieve sustainable growth.
  • Develop dealer capabilities through training, coaching, and support of their sales and business processes, helping teams build the technical and commercial skills needed for long-term success.
  • Stay close to customers, consulting engineers, and the broader market to understand emerging needs and trends, strengthen specification opportunities, and bring actionable regional insights back to Reliable Controls.
  • Regularly review dealer performance, project pipelines, and market opportunities to identify risks and keep regional business plans on track.
  • Identify, evaluate, and cultivate new Authorized Dealers to strategically expand Reliable Controls' presence across the region.
  • Build and strengthen industry relationships by representing Reliable Controls at customer sites, trade shows, industry events, and other networking opportunities across the region.
  • Develop and execute an annual regional business plan, including dealer and sales targets.

This role might be right for you if you have:

  • 3+ years of experience in building automation or controls, ideally within engineering, technical support, systems integration, channel/distribution support, or business development.
  • Post-secondary education in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Strong technical knowledge of building automation systems, with the ability to translate customer and dealer needs into practical solutions.
  • Commercial acumen and strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to support and influence independent business partners.
  • Experience working with a dealer, distributor, systems integrator, or other channel-based network.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic language skills would be a significant asset.
  • The ability and willingness to travel approximately 30–40% throughout the Middle East and Africa to support dealers, customers, consultants, and business development activities.

You’ll be successful in this position if you:

  • Build trusted relationships and genuinely enjoy helping dealers and customers succeed.
  • Lead with honesty and integrity, making decisions that align with our values even when it means walking away from an opportunity.
  • Take ownership, follow through on commitments, and communicate openly when challenges arise.
  • Balance technical considerations with commercial opportunities to provide practical, thoughtful solutions.
  • Are proactive and comfortable working independently, setting priorities, and adapting as needs change.
  • Are excited to build for the long term and grow Reliable Controls’ dealer network and presence across the region.

What we offer:

  • A comprehensive compensation package including a base salary, commission, and company profit-sharing program.
  • Unlimited paid time off (PTO).
  • Awards and recognition for service and accomplishments.
  • Continuous personal and professional development.
  • A rewarding career doing work that matters.

We’re flexible in how this role is structured and are open to engaging the successful candidate as either an employee or an independent contractor, depending on their location and circumstances.

At Reliable Controls, we believe that a wide range of perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds make us stronger as a company and as a community. Reliable Controls is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we’re committed to fostering diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in every aspect of our organization.

When applying for a role, we recognize that each person’s career path is unique. Even if your experience doesn’t perfectly match every listed qualification, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, passion, and alignment with our values as much as direct experience.

We’re also dedicated to ensuring that every candidate enjoys a comfortable, respectful, and accessible interview experience. If you require any accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know.

At Alight, we believe a company’s success starts with its people. We are passionate about connecting purpose with impact.  Alight empowers clients to build a healthier and more financially secure workforce by unifying the benefits ecosystem across health, wealth, wellbeing, navigation, and absence management.

Our Benefits

With a comprehensive total rewards package, Alight offers programs and plans that support your mind, body, wallet, and life. Benefits include health, dental and vision coverages starting Day One. Additionally, Alight colleagues enjoy wellbeing programs, retirement plans with contribution matching, generous time off, parental leave, continuing education, and career growth opportunities – all within a thriving global organization.

Flexible Working

So that you can be your best at work and home, we consider flexible working arrangements wherever possible. Alight has been a leader in the flexible workspace and “Top 100 Company for Remote Jobs” 6 years in a row.

Great Place to Work

Thanks to the work of every colleague, Alight has received multiple awards of recognition including “Great Place to Work” for the past 7 years and Fortune’s “Best Companies to Work For.” To learn more about our company culture and awards Click Here.

We invite you to join our team! Learn more at . 

Overview

The role is accountable for achieving an assigned annual sales quota and for actively owning prospecting, opportunity creation, pipeline progression, and pursuit outcomes from initial identification through proposal development, negotiation, and closure, with a particular focus on the larger end of the state and local government market. The role is expected to consistently generate qualified pipeline and new revenue opportunities for Alight’s defined benefit and defined contribution solutions. The executive identifies priority prospects, develops senior-level relationships, leads early-stage discovery and qualification, and works with Solution Architects, Consultant Relations, and business leaders to develop and execute differentiated pursuit strategies. Success in the role will be measured by disciplined market coverage, accurate forecasting, qualified pipeline creation, advancement of strategic opportunities, and achievement of assigned revenue goals. The role requires a strategic, consultative seller who can establish credibility quickly, navigate complex buying environments, and convert market opportunities into qualified enterprise pursuits.

Key Responsibilities

Market Development and Prospecting

  • Own and achieve assigned annual new business revenue and pipeline quotas through direct prospecting, disciplined opportunity creation, qualification, and advancement of strategic Wealth opportunities through closure.

  • Develop and execute targeted account and market-development plans.

  • Identify priority organizations, buyers, influencers, consultants, and market events.

  • Create qualified opportunities through direct outreach, relationships, referrals, and consultant channels.

  • Maintain disciplined prospect, activity, pipeline, next-step, and forecast information in the company’s CRM platform to support management visibility and sales accountability.

Discovery and Qualification

  • Lead early-stage discovery to understand business priorities, buying criteria, stakeholders, competitive dynamics, timing, and funding.

  • Apply a consistent qualification methodology and be accountable for clearly documenting pursuit viability, decision criteria, risks, timing, and required next actions.

  • Recommend whether, when, and how Alight should engage each opportunity, and take ownership for advancing qualified opportunities or closing out opportunities that do not meet pursuit criteria.

Pursuit Strategy and Solution Positioning

  • Translate prospect challenges into differentiated value propositions across defined benefit, defined contribution, retirement advice and self-directed brokerage solutions.

  • Partner with solutions, pricing, proposal, legal, and operational teams to shape pursuit and proposal strategies.

  • Contribute market and buyer insights throughout RFP, pricing, negotiation, and contracting activities, while maintaining accountability for pursuit strategy, sales progression, and deal momentum.

Executive and Market Relationships

  • Build trusted relationships with senior staff, benefits, finance, procurement, and executive stakeholders.

  • Position Alight’s Wealth capabilities within standalone defined benefits and defined contribution opportunities and broader total retirement outsourcing strategies.

  • Represent Alight at industry events, conferences, consultant meetings, and targeted prospect engagements.

Qualifications

Required

  • Enterprise business-development or sales experience in retirement, benefits, HR outsourcing, or a related market.

  • Demonstrated success owning sales outcomes, generating qualified pipeline, advancing opportunities, and winning new client relationships against assigned goals.

  • Experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder buying processes.

  • Strong discovery, executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and forecasting skills.

  • Ability to translate client needs into differentiated business and solution value.

  • Willingness and ability to travel based on client and business needs.

Preferred

  • Experience with public sector defined benefits, defined contribution, retirement advice and brokerage solutions.

  • Experience working with benefits consultants and advisory firms.

  • Knowledge of total retirement outsourcing connected-benefits strategies.

  • FINRA Series 7 and 66 licenses, or willingness and eligibility to obtain applicable licenses.

This includes developing and maintaining medium and large Electrical Contractor accounts and developing contacts and sales with key end user accounts.

Candidate should be skilled in assembling large project package quotations to include IEM and non-IEM products as necessary to furnish a complete bill of material to the customer.

The general territory will be nationwide. Your office base will be remote.

  • Work with Sales Director to establish, own, execute and continuously develop an agreed & sponsored Account plan

  • Use personal & internal resources to develop proposals that meet/exceed client requirements
  • Follow the client buying journey / process so as to commercially respond & offer proposals
  • Oversee the effective handover to IEM Project Management team
  • Maintain an ongoing oversight to all commercial related engagements for customer success/satisfaction and our performance as vendor
  • Be highly knowledgeable of the client’s business, commercial condition, structure, strategy, operations and challenges. In order to articulate this in terms of opportunity, growth and risk
  • Be highly knowledgeable on IEM products, services, general business, structure, strategy and operations in order to articulate this in terms of value to clients business

  • Be responsible for managing forecasting and providing information to Sales Director for capacity planning

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering or related field.

  • Work with Sales Director to establish, own, execute and continuously develop an agreed & sponsored Account plan.

At IEM, you’ll join a team that powers some of the world’s most ambitious projects. raw.description:
Apiphani is a technology-enabled managed services company dedicated to redefining what it means to support mission-critical enterprise workloads. We’re a small but rapidly growing company, which means there’s lots of room for growth and learning opportunities abound!

Apiphani is dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment for all as a fundamental component of our business. Diversity and inclusion are the bedrock of creativity and innovation. Without diversity of experience and thought, we would fail to progress as a company and as a team. Apiphani strives to foster an environment of belonging, where every employee feels respected, valued, and empowered. We embrace the unique experiences, perspective, and cultural background, which only you can bring to the table.

Position Summary

The Territory Sales Executive is a quota-carrying, geographic-territory role responsible for driving new revenue across a defined regional territory of ICP-aligned target accounts within Apiphani's core vertical markets. This role owns the full account and opportunity lifecycle, from account planning through negotiation and close, across SAP consulting, migration, and Day 2/managed services engagements. The ideal candidate is a consultative, quota-proven seller who can efficiently cover a broad territory of accounts across multiple verticals and reposition legacy managed-services conversations as agentic AI-enabled transformation.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying transformation and operations/Day 2/Managed Services sales experience
  • Proven track record carrying a $3M quota, with demonstrated history of exceeding quota (top 10–20% of company) in prior roles
  • Strong SAP domain expertise (both technical and relationships) in regulated industries such as Energy/Utilities, Oil & Gas, Transportation, Industrial Manufacturing, Aerospace & Defense, Telecommunications, Pharmaceuticals
  • Demonstrated ability to target, engage, and manage a geographic territory of ICP-aligned targets focused on our core vertical markets
  • Proven track record identifying, engaging, sustaining, and closing large, complex annuity-based deals in excess of $3M TCV

Key Responsibilities

Revenue & Pipeline Ownership

  • Drive new revenue at prospective and existing accounts within an assigned territory, selling across the SAP consulting, migration, and managed services marketplace
  • Own the entire account and opportunity sales cycle end-to-end, for both short- and long-term engagements
  • Build and execute a predictable closing plan; negotiate and close complex managed services engagements
  • Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene and leverage automation for timely, accurate pipeline and sales-cycle management
  • Qualify key clients and opportunities across the territory against a well-defined ICP

Territory & Account Management

  • Develop and maintain account plans, Win Themes, relationship maps, and competitive landscaping across a portfolio of ICP-aligned accounts within the assigned territory
  • Operate with an account-focused sales approach rather than a transactional/opportunity-driven one
  • Balance efficient coverage of a broad territory with a longer-term account growth vision, while meeting near-term revenue and profitability targets

Positioning & Storytelling

  • Act as a natural storyteller, translating a customer's critical business and technology issues into profitable migration and agentic-led managed services opportunities using a consultative/solution-selling methodology
  • Creatively construct value propositions customized to each client's specific goals, objectives, and constraints
  • Reposition traditional managed-services conversations as platform-led, agentic AI sales — articulating how Apiphani's proprietary AI engine, Luumen, captures existing ECC processes and carries institutional knowledge into the Day 2 S/4HANA environment
  • Build business cases grounded in future-state efficiency and knowledge continuity, appropriate to selling an emerging solution category, rather than point-in-time cost comparisons
  • Structure both combined migration-and-Day-2 engagements and standalone migration deals designed to convert into long-term managed-services relationships via an embedded AI-driven capability

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Leverage AI tools (Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, etc.) to accelerate internal and external sales processes, deliverables, and value propositions
  • Use account intelligence platforms (Draup, ZoomInfo, etc.) to understand key account initiatives, constraints, and core strategies, and convert that intelligence into strategic account plans

Qualifications & Skills

  • Working technical fluency in SAP ECC-to-S/4HANA migration concepts, Day 2 managed services, and applied AI/automation — sufficient to engage IT and business stakeholders as a credible technical counterpart
  • Strong knowledge of SAP, Red Hat, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and ServiceNow
  • Thrives with autonomy; operates with the highest level of integrity while thinking big and embracing ambiguity and challenges
  • Strong territory-management discipline: ability to prioritize a volume of ICP-aligned accounts and manage a full, active pipeline across the region

raw.description:
Design Your Future With Us. Creativity lives here. We celebrate craftsmanship, design, and inspired living. Whether you are in marketing, tech, or logistics, your voice and vision matter. We showcase employee spaces, share design stories, and promote growth through a culture of flexibility, storytelling, and opportunity. From onboarding to day-to-day, we help you bring your style to life.

Location: Remote (United States or Canada)

About the Role

    One Kings Lane is building a dedicated new business development function to grow its highest-value, highest-retention customer segments: the trade and hospitality space. As Business Development Executive, Trade & Hospitality, you will own net-new account acquisition end to end — sourcing, prospecting, pitching, and closing interior designers, design firms, hotels, and hospitality groups.

    Success in the first 6–12 months means building a trade and hospitality pipeline from the ground up, establishing repeatable outreach workflows powered by AI tools, and closing larger accounts that drive recurring, project-based revenue.

    This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

What You'll Do

  • Identify, prospect, and close new B2B accounts in the trade and hospitality space — interior designers, design firms, hotels, and hospitality groups.
  • Build and manage your own pipeline of larger accounts with the goal of driving repeat purchasing and long-term retention, not one-time transactions.
  • Field inbound and outbound calls directly with prospective trade and hospitality accounts — this is a hands-on, high-touch role.
  • Use AI tools to scale and sharpen outreach — prospecting, list-building, messaging, and follow-up — covering more ground as a single-threaded new business function.
  • Implement and oversee AI-driven workflows to increase productivity and deal velocity; write clear prompts, validate outputs, and iterate based on results.
  • Own funnel metrics and pipeline health; improve CRM discipline, reporting consistency, and forecasting accuracy.
  • Build scalable processes for lead routing, opportunity tracking, and follow-up; identify opportunities to shorten sales cycles and increase conversion.
  • Coordinate with the inbound/existing-accounts owner to ensure clean handoffs once accounts are established and to keep account strategy aligned.
  • Partner with merchandising, operations, and vendor teams to support inventory planning and special orders for trade and design clients.

Required Qualifications

  • 5–8 years of B2B sales or business development experience, ideally with exposure to trade, design, hospitality, or a related relationship-driven, high-touch sales environment.
  • Proven track record of sourcing and closing net-new accounts — not just managing an existing book of business.
  • Comfort working independently and remotely, with the discipline to self-manage a pipeline without day-to-day oversight.
  • Familiarity or comfort using AI tools to support prospecting and outreach workflows.
  • Strong phone and relationship-building skills; comfortable being the primary point of contact fielding calls directly with prospects.

Why Join

    The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.

raw.description:
Job Description

VICTAULIC

Title: Commercial/Mechanical Business Development Executive

Location: San Francisco Bay Area (remote)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Department/Function: Sales/Business Development

Immigration sponsorship: None

ABOUT VICTAULIC

Victaulic, headquartered in Easton, Pennsylvania, is the global leader in mechanical pipe joining solutions, delivering advanced technologies and engineering services to address complex piping challenges faced by engineers, site owners and contractors. Since 1919, our innovative solutions have improved construction productivity and reduced risks, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget. With over 6,000 employees spanning 50+ locations worldwide, our teams are dedicated to delivering advanced technologies and engineering expertise that address real-world challenges across a wide range of industries.

Our sustainable solutions, made from high quality, graded scrap steel, promote circular construction by making piping systems infinitely reconfigured and minimizing environmental impact. Today, our high-quality products are used in more than 140 countries, supporting some of the world’s most critical and prestigious structures.

An Industry Leader With a Heart as Big as Its Ambition and Innovation

At Victaulic, we’re committed to constructing a better world for and with our people.

Let’s Build a Better World Together.

Our commitment to our people is built on four pillars:

  • We build from within.
  • We stand behind our people.
  • We foster an environment for constant learning.
  • We engineer change for a more stable and sustainable world.

YOUR IMPACT STARTS HERE

The Business Development Executive (BDE) spearheads strategic business development initiatives within a designated geographic territory, serving a pivotal role in advancing Victaulic solutions. Focused on enhancing specification standing through a market-centric approach, their primary objectives revolve around implementing the market box strategy, collecting valuable market intelligence, and obtaining comprehensive project information, including detailed scopes of work. The BDE proactively cultivates Victaulic opportunities by targeting, engaging, and influencing key stakeholders, including owners and engineers.

WHAT YOU’LL BUILD & OWN

  • Strategically evaluate assigned territory, collaborating with the Regional Business Development Manager and/or Divisional Sales Leader to prioritize target accounts.
  • Develop and execute an annual business plan aimed at elevating Victaulic's specification standing, emphasizing a comprehensive market box strategy encompassing both master and project specifications, as well as owner guidelines.
  • Drive the penetration and expansion of Victaulic's influence within assigned accounts (owners, engineers, GCs) by crafting and fortifying owner guidelines, master specifications, and project specifications.
  • Leverage Salesforce to effectively capture, share, and collaborate account and project details with the commercial sales team, ensuring seamless communication and coordination.
  • Facilitate effective project handoffs at the appropriate phase of the project lifecycle with the commercial sales team.
  • Attains comprehensive expertise in various aspects, including:
    • Product features and benefits, account influences, market and product applications, and technical language, encompassing material science knowledge.
    • Specifications as an industry document, comprehending both content and language intricacies.
    • Competitive products and their positioning in the market
  • Cultivate and foster industry connections with clients and prospects.
  • Stay abreast of market trends and competitor dynamics.
  • Employ strategic social engineering to enhance relationships and gather market intelligence.
  • Engage with local trade organizations and professional associations, actively becoming integral to the industry fabric in the assigned territory.
  • Fulfill additional responsibilities as assigned.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or construction management strongly preferred.
  • Previous sales experience preferably related to the commercial construction industry or engineering fields.
  • Proven track record of success, including business development, sales, and account management while achieving targets and complex sales.
  • Established owner group relationships in healthcare, higher education, and airports throughout the area.
  • Understanding of HVAC piping system solutions.
  • Established owner group relationships.
  • Capable of lifting 50+ pounds.
  • Willingness to travel overnight as required by the position and territory

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Engineering skills in writing and developing design specifications a plus.
  • Proficient project management and communication skills.
  • A self-starter who enjoys working in an autonomous leadership role while being a member of a team of highly skilled colleagues.
  • Ability to demonstrate drive, resiliency, and adaptability while possessing a team mindset.
  • Ability to demonstrate learning agility, creative thinking, problem solving and resourcefulness.
  • Solid organizational and time management skills; able to work in a virtual setting with minimal supervision.

WHAT WE OFFER

Build A Better Career

  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Career development programs and internal promotion pathways—we build from within
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuous learning opportunities

Build A Better Future

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
  • Retirement savings plans with company match
  • Life insurance and disability coverage

Build A Better You

  • Paid time off, holidays, and flexible work arrangements where applicable
  • Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and wellness resources
  • Inclusive, team-oriented culture where people look out for one another

Build A Better World

Join a company whose products contribute to a safer, more sustainable built environment every day.

COMPENSATION

The base salary range for this position is typically between $150,000.00–$210,000.00 annually. Top end of range can be exceeded, as actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, skills, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for variable compensation in addition to the full benefits package described above.

IMMIGRATION SPONSORSHIP

Victaulic does not provide immigration sponsorship (e.g., H-1B, TN, or other work visa sponsorship) for this position. All applicants must be currently authorized to work in the applicable country on a full-time basis without the need for employer-sponsored immigration support now or in the future.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Victaulic is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EOE/M/F/Vets/Disabled) employer and welcomes all qualified applicants. Applicants will receive fair and impartial consideration without regard to race, gender, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic data, or other legally protected status. Background checks may be required as part of our pre-employment process.

VICTAULIC STAFFING PARTNER COMMUNICATION POLICY

All staffing agencies are strictly forbidden from directly contacting any Victaulic employees, except those within the Human Resources/Talent Acquisition team. All communications, inquiries and candidate submissions must be routed through Victaulic’s Human Resources/Talent Acquisition team. Non-compliance with this policy may result in the suspension of partnership, cancellation of the current contract, and/or the imposition of a mandatory probation period before any future business can resume. Additionally, non-compliance may lead to a permanent ban on future business. This policy ensures a streamlined and compliant recruitment process.

Let’s Build a Better World Together.

raw.title: Veradigm Outcomes Executive
raw.excerpt: This position is responsible for the full strategic relationship across a portfolio of enterprise payer accounts — health plans, managed care organizations, and other risk-bearing entities — for the Veradigm Payer Products portfolio.
raw.description:
This position is responsible for the full strategic relationship across a portfolio of enterprise payer accounts — health plans, managed care organizations, and other risk-bearing entities — for the Veradigm Payer Products portfolio. The Veradigm Outcome Executive (VOE) is the most senior client-facing individual contributor for these accounts, with particular focus on risk adjustment and quality programs (HEDIS and Stars) and on payer-provider clinical data exchange. Serving as the integration layer across Sales, Consulting, Support, and A/R, the VOE drives retention, expansion, and wallet share through deep knowledge of each plan’s medical economics, quality and risk performance, and regulatory obligations. The role operates with significant autonomy and is fully accountable for C-suite engagement, annual account planning, QBR cadence, and measurable revenue outcomes.


CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the primary strategic partner to C-suite and senior functional leadership within an assigned portfolio of enterprise payer accounts — including Chief Medical Officer, Chief Actuary, quality and Stars leadership, risk adjustment leadership, and Chief Information Officer — owning the full client relationship across quality, risk, network, and regulatory touchpoints
  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships through on-site visits, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), and proactive engagement, establishing Veradigm as a trusted long-term partner
  • Understand and document each plan’s enterprise priorities — Stars and HEDIS targets, risk adjustment accuracy, medical loss ratio pressure, value-based care strategy, and interoperability mandates — and develop and execute annual account plans focused on retention, optimization, and expansion
  • Analyze plan membership, line-of-business mix, and product utilization data to identify whitespace across Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, commercial, and ACA lines of business; translate findings into actionable pipeline and sales strategy
  • Position Veradigm risk adjustment and quality solutions against each plan’s annual program cycle — chart retrieval and review, supplemental data submission, gap identification and closure, and audit readiness — and align proposal timing to that cycle
  • Position payer-provider clinical data exchange solutions, connecting plan requirements for clinical data acquisition, interoperability compliance, and prior authorization workflow to Veradigm’s provider network and data assets
  • Drive ACV quota attainment and MBO performance through disciplined pipeline management, accurate forecasting, and timely opportunity progression
  • Navigate payer procurement, security review, and contracting processes, coordinating Legal, InfoSec, and Privacy to move enterprise agreements and data use terms to signature
  • Advocate internally for client needs — surface product feedback, coordinate cross-functional issue resolution, and represent the payer voice in roadmap and strategy discussions
  • Partner with Consulting, Support, and A/R to ensure dependable delivery and early resolution of at-risk situations before they affect retention
  • Maintain deep working knowledge of CMS and NCQA program mechanics — risk adjustment models and submission, RADV audit exposure, HEDIS measure specifications, the Medicare Advantage Stars program, and federal interoperability and prior authorization rules — to credibly advise executive stakeholders
  • Conduct whitespace and competitive analysis to expand Veradigm’s footprint within each plan and identify new use cases across additional lines of business

Compensation Range:

$163,000-$216,300

Compensation for this job is subject to market conditions, geographic considerations, the candidate’s unique skills and experience, state and local laws, and budget. Our commitment to pay transparency is a testament to our dedication to creating a fair, equitable, and inclusive workplace. By continuously analyzing market trends, staying abreast of changes in state laws, and making budgetary adjustments accordingly, we strive to ensure that our compensation practices reflect the value we place on our associates’ unique contributions and support their professional growth.


Enhancing Lives and Building Careers


Veradigm believes in empowering our associates with the tools and flexibility to bring the best version of themselves to work and to further their professional development. Together, we are In the Network. Interested in learning more?


Take a look at our Culture, Benefits, Early Talent Program, and Additional Openings.


Visa Sponsorship is not offered for this position.


At Veradigm, our greatest strength comes from bringing together talented people with diverse perspectives to support the needs of healthcare providers, life science companies, health plans, and the patients they serve. The Veradigm Network is a dynamic, open community of solutions, external partners, and cutting-edge artificial intelligence technologies that provide advanced insights, technology, and data-driven solutions. Veradigm offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including holidays, vacation, medical, dental, and vision insurance, company paid life insurance and retirement savings.


Veradigm’s policy is to provide equal employment opportunity and affirmative action in all of its employment practices without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, age, individuals with disabilities, sexual orientation or gender identity or expression or any other legally protected category. Applicants for North American based positions with Veradigm must be legally authorized to work in the United States or Canada. Verification of employment eligibility will be required as a condition of hire. Veradigm is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse and inclusive workforce.
