raw.description:
The BFSI Acquisition Sales Executive is responsible for driving new business growth by acquiring new logos within the US banking, financial services and insurance market. This role owns the entire sales cycle, from lead generation and prospecting through to contract closure, ensuring a seamless and professional experience for potential clients. The Acquisition Sales Executive orchestrates internal teams to develop and present compelling, client-specific solutions that address prospect needs and differentiate Rackspace in the marketplace. Upon successful deal closure, the role ensures a smooth transition and handoff to the designated client partner or customer success manager for ongoing relationship management. This position is critical to expanding Rackspace’s customer base and achieving strategic revenue objectives, while upholding the company’s standards of excellence and customer focus.

Career Level Summary

  • Recognized as an expert within the company and requires in-depth and/or breadth of expertise in own job discipline and broad knowledge of other job disciplines within the organization function
  • Solves unique problems that have a broad impact on the business.
  • Contributes to the development of organizational sub-function strategy.
  • Progression to this level is typically restricted on the basis of business requirements.
Critical Competencies
  • Excellence: Exceeds expectations by consistently demonstrating accountability, discipline, high performance, and a proven track record of exceptional results.
  • Customer-driven: Prioritizes customer needs and satisfaction through collaborative and proactive problem-solving, and an unwavering commitment to customer success.
  • Expertise: Possesses deep understanding of customer needs and continually grows and enhances skills to provide customer-focused solutions.
  • Agility: Quickly adapts and responds to dynamic customer needs and expectations through innovative solutions.
  • Compassion: Cultivates a positive and supportive environment to effectively work together towards a common goal, fostering trust within Rackspace and with external stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
  • Own and drive revenue growth within target market, leveraging a cross-functional approach to maximize account potential.
  • Prospect and qualify opportunities within target market, ensuring a robust and healthy sales pipeline.
  • Orchestrate internal teams (Enterprise Solutions, Product, Services, and Client Partners in exceptions) to develop and deliver tailored solutions that address specific client needs and business objectives.
  • Coordinate closely with the Market Unit Lead and VP of Sales to identify priority target accounts and drive a focused, data‑informed pursuit strategy.
  • Manage the end-to-end sales process, including negotiation and closing of deals, while ensuring a seamless transition to client partners for ongoing relationship management.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and sales forecasting, providing timely updates to leadership.
  • Consistently meet or exceed established sales targets and key performance indicators, including bookings, revenue, sold gross margin, and Customer NPS.
Knowledge
  • Expert-level knowledge in professional sales training and sales process
  • Expert-level understanding of the processes, procedures and systems used to accomplish the work and familiarity with the broader underlying concepts in own job discipline
  • Expert-level knowledge of Rackspace product portfolio, strategy, competitors, and customers
Skills

•Consultative Selling

•CRM Software Skills

•Negotiation Skills

•Pipeline Management

•Presentation Building

•Sales Lead Generation Skills

•Solutions Development

•Solution-selling Skills

Education
  • High School Diploma or regional equivalent required
  • Bachelor's Degree required, preferably in field related to role. At the manager’s discretion, additional relevant experience may substitute degree requirement

Experience

  • 12 - 14 years of experience in the field of role required
Disclaimer

It is not designed to contain or to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of the employee assigned to this job.

The compensation range for this position ranges from $165,109.00/year in our lowest geographic market up to 290,614.50 USD/year in our highest geographic market. About Rackspace Technology

We are the multicloud solutions experts. We combine our expertise with the world’s leading technologies — across applications, data and security — to deliver end-to-end solutions. We have a proven record of advising customers based on their business challenges, designing solutions that scale, building and managing those solutions, and optimizing returns into the future. Named a best place to work, year after year according to Fortune, Forbes and Glassdoor, we attract and develop world-class talent. Join us on our mission to embrace technology, empower customers and deliver the future.

More on Rackspace Technology

Though we’re all different, Rackers thrive through our connection to a central goal: to be a valued member of a winning team on an inspiring mission. We bring our whole selves to work every day. And we embrace the notion that unique perspectives fuel innovation and enable us to best serve our customers and communities around the globe. We welcome you to apply today and want you to know that we are committed to offering equal employment opportunity without regard to age, color, disability, gender reassignment or identity or expression, genetic information, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity status, military or veteran status, nationality, ethnic or national origin, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any legally protected characteristic. raw.description:
Payment Sales Executive What We Need Corpay is seeking to hire an experienced and highly motivated Payment Sales Executive. This position falls under our Cross-Border line of business and will be located via remote in the United States. Corpay Cross-Border is a global leader in international payments, embedded payment technologies, and foreign exchange (FX) risk management. Reporting directly SVP of Payments Solutions. This person will partner with fintech platforms, vertical SaaS providers, marketplaces, and professional services firms to embed global payment and FX capabilities directly into their platforms via APIs, file-based integrations, and white-labeled solutions. You will be responsible for driving revenue through platform-led and embedded payments sales, owning the full enterprise sales lifecycle—from prospecting and solution design through contract execution and commercialization—while collaborating closely with product, implementation, and partner teams. This is a high-impact, quota-carrying role for a self-directed sales contributor who thrives in complex sales environments and can articulate the value of embedded cross-border FX solutions to both business and technical stakeholders. How We Work As a Payment Sales Executive, you will be expected to work onsite if you are located by a local office. If you don’t live close to a Corpay office, you will be expected to work remote. Corpay will set you up for success by providing:

  • Assigned workspace
  • Company-issued equipment
  • Formal, hands-on training

Roles Responsibilities Enterprise & Platform Sales

  • Proactively source, develop, and close new enterprise opportunities with fintechs, vertical SaaS platforms, marketplaces, and professional services firms seeking to embed cross-border payments and FX capabilities.
  • Leading complex, consultative sales cycles involving API-based, embedded payments, and platform integrations, engaging stakeholders across products, engineering, finance, compliance, and executive leadership.

Embedded Payments & API-Led Growth

  • Positioning Corpay’s embedded FX and international payments solutions as a core revenue and customer value driver within partner platforms.
  • Partnering with prospects to design scalable, API-driven payment flows that support global customer expansion and monetization.

Revenue Ownership & Monetization

  • Owning and exceeding assigned revenue targets, generating income through FX spreads, transaction fees, and value-added services.
  • Building and maintaining a robust pipeline across both near-term opportunities and long-term strategic platform partnerships.

Partner & Market Development

  • Leveraging industry relationships to expand Corpay’s footprint within the embedded finance and cross-border payments ecosystem.
  • Acting as a market-facing ambassador for Corpay at industry events, partner meetings, and executive briefings.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Working closely with internal product, solution engineering, implementation, compliance, and marketing teams to scope solutions, accelerate deal velocity, and ensure successful go-lives.
  • Supporting development of case studies, partner enablement materials, and go-to-market strategies.

Deal & Pipeline Management

  • Tracking all opportunities, forecasts, and partner activity via Salesforce, maintaining accurate and actionable reporting

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in enterprise sales within payments, fintech, FX, treasury, or embedded finance
  • Proven experience selling cross-border payments, FX solutions, or embedded/integrated payment platforms
  • Strong understanding of technology-based payments, and platform architectures
  • Demonstrated success selling to fintech's, SaaS platforms, marketplaces, or professional services firms
  • Ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles, including C-level, product, and technical buyers
  • Consultative selling mindset with strong business acumen and solution-oriented approach
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into commercial value
  • Highly self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment
  • Bachelor’s degree required (College or University)
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce or similar CRM

Preferred Experience

  • Direct experience with embedded payments, platform monetization, or B2B2X payment models
  • Background in international payments, foreign exchange, or global treasury solutions
  • Existing network within fintech, vertical SaaS, or professional services ecosystems

Benefits & Perks

  • Comprehensive Benefits Package including, Medical, Dental, Vision and Paramedical benefits, as of day one
  • Optional company match RRSP program
  • Virtual fitness classes offered company-wide
  • Time-off including major holidays, vacation, sick, personal, & volunteer time
  • Discounted gym membership rate
  • Philanthropic support with both local and national organizations
  • Fun culture with company-wide contests and prizes

Pay Transparency

Manage complex relationships across different functions, ensuring alignment to increase market share. Build relationships at the executive level with assigned partners.

raw.excerpt: CSC Generation is the AI-native holding company re-engineering omnichannel retail.
raw.description:
CSC Generation is the AI-native holding company re-engineering omnichannel retail. We acquire iconic brands and transform them with Genesis, our operating platform combining a Data Fabric, Automation Engine, proprietary tools, and shared services to modernize operations, elevate customer experience, and expand margins. With $1B+ in revenue across 13 brands, our portfolio includes Sur La Table, Backcountry, One Kings Lane, and others that serve as real-world innovation labs.

Reports to: Chief Administrative Officer

Location: Remote (US or Canada), with regular collaboration across CSC Generation brands

About the Role

    This role exists to find and close executive, strategic, and highly specialized hires across CSC Generation's portfolio — the kind of searches where the right candidate is passive, hard to find, and being courted by everyone else. As Executive & Strategic Recruiter, you will own end-to-end search strategy and execution, partnering directly with hiring executives to define roles, map talent, and close candidates who weren't looking.

    In the first 6–12 months, success means you have personally sourced and closed multiple senior-level searches, built a warm pipeline of high-value passive candidates, and established yourself as a trusted advisor to hiring executives across the portfolio.

    This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end search strategy and execution for executive, strategic, and hard-to-fill roles across CSC Generation's portfolio brands and shared services, including sourcing approach, assessment criteria, and offer strategy in partnership with hiring executives.
  • Proactively source passive candidates through direct outreach, competitive talent mapping, referral networks, and platforms like LinkedIn — going well beyond inbound applicant flow.
  • Partner directly with hiring executives to define hard-to-articulate role profiles and translate them into actionable sourcing strategies.
  • Close searches where the ideal candidate profile is narrow, such as roles requiring deep applied AI or data science experience.
  • Build and maintain relationships with high-value passive candidates over time, even when there is no open role, so the pipeline is warm when the need arises.
  • Manage confidential searches with judgment and discretion, including roles tied to organizational restructuring or leadership transitions.
  • Provide market intelligence on talent availability and competitive hiring activity to inform how and where CSC Generation competes for talent.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated track record of sourcing and closing passive candidates for hard-to-fill executive or specialized roles — not just managing inbound pipelines. You have personally sourced and closed 10–15 or more senior-level searches in the last 12 months.
  • Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy, ambiguity, and direct executive access as an individual contributor.
  • A genuine network and the instincts to know who to call, not just how to run a search.
  • Technical fluency with modern AI and automation tools, with demonstrated ability to use these tools to increase effectiveness and productivity while exercising judgment about where human review is required in candidate evaluation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Search firm or agency recruiting background — you know how to cold-approach someone who wasn't looking and make them interested in speaking with you.
  • Experience recruiting technical, data science, or AI talent, given CSC Generation's AI-first operating model.
  • Retail, e-commerce, or multi-brand holding company experience.

Why Join

    The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.

  • Cross-Functional Impact: Your work touches every brand and function in the portfolio. Every search you close directly shapes the leadership and capabilities of CSC Generation.
  • AI-First Skill Building: You will operate inside an AI-native company that expects you to leverage modern tools and continuously sharpen how you source, evaluate, and close talent.
  • End-to-End Ownership: You own your searches from intake through close — no handoffs, no committees. You set the strategy, run the process, and deliver the hire.
  • Competitive Benefits (US): Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.
  • Competitive Benefits (Canada): Paid time off policies, RRSP match, medical, dental, and vision coverage, a variety of supplemental benefit options, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.

Interview Process

    1. Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.
    2. Hiring Manager Interview - Conversation with the Chief Administrative Officer focused on your search approach, sourcing methodology, and how you close passive candidates at the executive level.
    3. In-Person Interview - We'd like to meet you at one of our office hubs (Salt Lake City, Austin, or Toronto). Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter.
    4. Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible.
    5. Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.

    Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly.

  • Part of our interview process is a mandatory in-person interview with someone on our team prior to an offer. Candidates that are unwilling or unable to meet for an in-person interview will be removed from consideration immediately.

CSC Generation will conduct an exhaustive background check including verifying dates of employment directly with your former employer.

CSC Generation is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The CSC Generation family of brands is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, please contact .

For Ontario applicants, please note that this posting is for an existing vacancy. This position is not open to B.C. residents and cannot be filled by a B.C. resident.

For US-based candidates, this posting is intended for candidates that reside in the following states:
AZ, DE, FL, GA, IN, LA, MI, MS, MO, NV, NC, OK, PA, TN, TX, UT, WV, WI, and WY.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie-detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Physical Clinical Executive, Clinical Solutions - APAC

About Clinical Solutions

Elsevier Clinical Solutions delivers trusted, evidence-based content and technology-enabled solutions that support healthcare professionals, institutions, and patients across the care journey. Our portfolio includes Clinical And Drug Reference, Clinical Decision Support, Patient Engagement, Performance Improvement, Workflow Solutions, Clinical Pathways, Order Sets, Care Planning, and emerging AI-enabled solutions.

Our products help healthcare organizations improve clinical decision-making, support patient safety, reduce variability in care, enhance workflow efficiency, and promote the use of trusted evidence at the point of care.

About the Role

Elsevier is seeking a Physician Clinical Executive to drive the growth of Clinical Solutions across the APAC region. Based in Malaysia and reporting to the Product Sales Director, Clinical Solutions, this role serves as the physician-level clinical authority for commercial teams, customers, and partners, bringing deep clinical expertise and consultative leadership to the region.

The successful candidate will be a qualified medical doctor with clinical practice experience and the ability to act as a trusted clinical advisor to healthcare organizations across APAC. They will advise customers on the clinical value and strategic application of Elsevier’s Clinical Solutions portfolio, including Clinical Decision Support, solutions such: ClinicalKey, ClinicalKey AI, Drug Information, Clinical Pathways, and other Workflow Solutions.

This role will work closely with sales, product, marketing, customer success, implementation, and regional leadership teams to drive revenue growth, customer engagement, product adoption, and thought leadership across APAC.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the clinical authority and trusted physician advisor within sales engagements across APAC, leading opportunity identification, qualification, development, account planning, and solution-based customer engagements.
  • Deliver clinical presentations, demonstrations, workshops, and value discussions tailored to healthcare executives, physicians, pharmacists, nursing leaders, informatics teams, digital health stakeholders, and clinical leadership teams.
  • Partner with commercial teams to position Elsevier Clinical Solutions across hospitals, health systems, academic medical centers, ministries of health, private healthcare groups, and other provider organizations.
  • Lead conversations on clinical workflow integration, Clinical Decision Support, AI-enabled solutions, evidence-based practice, Care Standardization, Patient Safety, Clinical Quality, Medication Safety, Clinician Productivity, and Patient Engagement.
  • Translate clinical needs, physician workflow challenges, and healthcare priorities into effective solution positioning, while advising customers on driving informed clinical decisions, clinician usage, learner engagement, and patient interactions.
  • Lead post-sale physician engagement, gathering customer feedback, clinical insights, and outcome data to drive adoption, value realization, customer experience improvements, and expansion opportunities.
  • Lead the regional positioning and expansion of ClinicalKey AI and other AI-enabled Clinical Solutions, providing physician-led thought leadership on the responsible, ethical, safe, and effective use of AI in clinical workflows.
  • Drive customer and commercial team engagement on GenAI adoption, trust, governance, Clinical Safety, workflow impact, evidence-based use, change management, and the value of AI solutions for healthcare organizations and clinical education.
  • Synthesize and communicate market trends, customer needs, competitive activity, Healthcare Transformation priorities, Digital Health developments, Clinical Informatics trends, and physician workflow insights to inform product strategy, roadmap priorities, customer experience, and regional market requirements.
  • Represent Elsevier Clinical Solutions as a physician thought leader through customer meetings, conferences, webinars, industry forums, publications, and sales enablement initiatives, while leading training, knowledge sharing, clinician advisory activities, and cross-regional collaboration with clinical experts.

Requirements

  • Medical degree required (MD, MBBS, MBChB, or an equivalent internationally recognized medical qualification), with current or previous medical registration, licensure, or eligibility to practice medicine in at least one relevant jurisdiction.
  • Proven clinical practice experience as a physician, with a strong understanding of physician workflows, clinical decision-making, multidisciplinary care delivery, and hospital or health system operations.
  • Experience in clinical leadership, clinical education, Clinical Informatics, Digital Health, Healthcare Technology, Evidence-Based Medicine, or related healthcare innovation environments is highly desirable.
  • Experience supporting Healthcare Technology, Clinical Decision Support, electronic medical records, AI-enabled healthcare solutions, evidence-based clinical content, and digital workflow tools is highly desirable.
  • Strong consultative and customer-facing skills, with the ability to engage credibly with physicians, healthcare executives, informatics teams, pharmacists, nurses, commercial stakeholders, and translate clinical challenges into solution-based recommendations and value propositions.
  • Excellent presentation, communication, storytelling, stakeholder management, analytical, and organizational skills, with the ability to synthesize complex clinical, technical, and commercial information.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively within commercial environments, partner with sales teams as a credible clinical expert, and work successfully across countries, cultures, functions, and time zones.
  • Knowledge of AI, GenAI, Responsible AI, and healthcare AI applications is a strong advantage; fluency in English is required, additional APAC languages are advantageous, and willingness to travel across APAC is required.

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working for you

We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:

  • Medical Inpatient and Outpatient Insurance: Coverage for your healthcare needs.
  • Long Service Award: Recognition for your dedication and loyalty.
  • Flexible Working Arrangements: Balance work and personal life effectively.
  • Access to Learning and Development Resources: Empowering your professional growth.

About the Business

About us

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

About the role

We're looking for a Major Account Executive to own and grow a book of strategic enterprise accounts. This is a role for someone who can run complex, multi-threaded sales cycles into security-conscious buying committees (CISO, CIO, procurement, legal, and often the board) and close 3-year enterprise commitments in a competitive, incumbent-heavy market, while navigating channel partners (e.g. VARs and Distributors).

You'll be selling into organizations where a security failure is existential, where the buying process is genuinely adversarial by design, and where trust is earned through technical credibility and long-term relationships, not charisma. If you've sold into security teams before, you know this isn't a "build rapport and close" motion — it's proving you understand the threat model as well as the buyer does.

Responsibilities

  • Own and grow a book of major/strategic accounts, running the full cycle from qualification through multi-year contract negotiation and close
  • Navigate multi-stakeholder buying committees — security, IT, legal, procurement, and executive sponsors — building consensus across functions with genuinely competing priorities
  • Partner with technical presales Solutions Architects to run live technical evaluations and proof-of-concepts that hold up under real scrutiny from technical buyers
  • Structure and negotiate enterprise contracts, with a strong bias toward multi-year (3-year) terms
  • Build and defend a business case that speaks fluently to both risk reduction (CISO language) and ROI (CFO language) — you need both, not one
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline hygiene on long-cycle (6–9 month), high-ACV deals
  • Prioritize Customer Success for account health, since renewal risk on an account this size is a shared problem, not a handoff

Skills and Qualifications

  • 8+ years of closing experience in enterprise cybersecurity/SaaS
  • Demonstrated ability to close deals upwards of $1M ARR or more and 6+ month sales cycles
  • Track record of navigating security-specific procurement: vendor risk assessments, SOC 2 / ISO 27001 diligence, security questionnaires, and legal review cycles that are more adversarial than typical SaaS procurement
  • Comfort being technically challenged in a room — you don't need to be an engineer, but you need to hold your own when a CISO pressure-tests your claims
  • Experience structuring and closing multi-year contracts, not just annual renewals
  • A hunter mentality — use relationships & partnerships to find leverage to close deals
  • and this role rewards depth and judgment over sheer volume

Perks

  • 100% medical, dental and vision coverage
  • Flexible PTO policy
  • Annual home office stipend and WeWork access
  • Mental & physical health wellness programs (One Medical, Headspace, Wellhub, and more)!
  • Competitive compensation and opportunity for advancement

Why Coalition?

Work at Coalition is centered on the joint mission to Protect the Unprotected. We have built a remote-first, highly inclusive culture that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. Coalition’s exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion.

We’re always looking for collaborative, inquisitive individuals to join #OurCoalition.

Visit our Newsroom >

Privacy Notice

Coalition is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information responsibly. We collect, use, and store personal information as necessary for the recruitment process and in compliance with applicable privacy laws and regulations in all regions where we operate. We want you to understand what personal information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding access, correction, and deletion of your data where applicable. Information submitted, collected, and processed as part of your application is subject to Coalition's Privacy Policy. For further details, please review our full Privacy Policy or contact us with any questions regarding how your information is handled.

Our Privacy Policy >

Safe Hiring Notice

All legitimate communication from Coalition comes from @coalitioninc.com emails, and open roles are listed only on our Careers page. We never ask for payment, banking details, or personal identification before an offer is accepted through our secure systems. If you believe you’ve been a victim of fraudulent recruiting, follow guidance from the Federal Trade Commission (FTC).

Anti-Discrimination Notice

Coalition is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all individuals, without discrimination or harassment on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable laws in each country where we operate. This commitment includes, but is not limited to, ensuring equal treatment in recruitment, selection, training, promotion, transfer, compensation, and all other aspects of employment. Coalition does not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, and we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace.

Accommodations

Coalition is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, including applicants and employees, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in each country where we operate. Our policy is to support equal opportunity in the hiring process by considering qualified applicants regardless of disability or other protected characteristics, unless providing accommodation would impose an undue hardship or disproportionate burden. If you require accommodation to complete an application, interview, pre-employment testing, or participate in the selection process, please contact us at . We also consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in line with applicable laws and regulations in each jurisdiction.

To all recruitment agencies: Coalition does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our email alias, employees, or other physical or virtual organization locations. Coalition is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

You'll win new enterprise accounts and expand GitLab's footprint within existing customers, using a consultative approach to understand their business needs and guide successful adoption and expansion. Join our Public Sector team!

Akamai has supported the Department of Defense for over 20 years, securing digital properties and managing enterprise identity solutions. A new team is being built to serve the DoD Fourth Estate, encompassing defense agencies and field activities. This role involves leading hybrid sales efforts and overseeing this dedicated account team.

Partner with the best

Drive growth by developing and managing relationships with major accounts, ensuring client satisfaction and achieving revenue objectives. Collaborate with internal teams to deliver tailored solutions, addressing both new and existing customer needs. Leverage industry insights to identify opportunities, build trust, and maintain long-term partnerships that contribute to organizational success.

As a Major Account Executive New and Existing Accounts, you will be responsible for:

  • Managing the DoD Fourth Estate territory, covering agencies, and achieving new logo, expansion, and renewal targets effectively.
  • Growing the installed base by protecting renewals, expanding existing programs and turning current services into enterprise-wide adoption.
  • Identifying, developing, and securing new business opportunities with Fourth Estate organizations not currently partnered with Akamai.
  • Driving the integrated account team by establishing strategy, conducting reviews, and guiding resources toward the most valuable opportunities.

  • Navigating DoD procurement options, including contract vehicles, OTAs, cloud marketplaces, and reseller channels, while collaborating with Federal Solutions teams.
  • Maintaining accurate account plans, pipeline and forecasts in Salesforce, and bringing customer requirements back to Product Management.

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Demonstrate 8+ years in enterprise technology sales, including 5+ years specializing in Department of Defense Fourth Estate agencies.
  • Have a track record of both growing large existing accounts and closing new logo business against quota.
  • Have experience leading or coordinating a cross-functional account team of engineers, account managers and business development partners.

Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
Security: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
AI: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.

Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

For US based candidates only - The On Target Earnings (OTE, base salary + commissions) for this position ranges from $173,600 - $312,400/year; a candidate’s OTE is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and location. raw.excerpt: This is a remote position. The opportunityMastarRec is a retained executive search firm focused on senior Risk, Compliance, Regulatory and Cybersecurity leadership.
raw.description:
This is a remote position.

The opportunity

MastarRec is a retained executive search firm focused on senior Risk, Compliance, Regulatory and Cybersecurity leadership. We are expanding our U.S. client-development capability and are looking for an experienced, commercially credible professional who already understands how to build senior-level relationships and originate executive-search business.

This is not a high-volume recruiter role and it is not a salaried employee vacancy. It is designed as an independent business-to-business contractor relationship for someone who can create and develop their own U.S. client opportunities, while using MastarRec's brand, executive-search capability and agreed commercial resources to convert suitable opportunities into retained assignments.

What you will do
  • Develop your own relationships with U.S. CEOs, CROs, CCOs, CISOs and other senior decision-makers in Financial Services, FinTech and related regulated markets.
  • Identify genuine business, regulatory, growth, succession, risk and leadership pressures that may create a need for senior executive capability.
  • Originate qualified client opportunities and introduce them to MastarRec for retained executive-search discussions.
  • Lead or participate in commercial conversations where appropriate, with Tariq Masood, Founder & CEO, available for founder-to-executive and closing conversations.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity and relationship records using agreed MastarRec processes.
  • Protect the MastarRec brand through professional, relationship-led business development; no indiscriminate candidate or client spam.

What this opportunity is not
  • It is not a fixed-hours call-center role.
  • It is not an employee position with a guaranteed salary, employee benefits or prescribed daily working schedule.
  • It is not primarily a candidate-sourcing desk.
  • It is not an invitation to mass-message prospects or represent unverified vacancies.

Requirements

Who we want to speak with
  • Experienced executive-search, recruitment, staffing, retained-search or professional-services business developers with U.S. market credibility.
  • Professionals comfortable speaking directly with C-suite and senior Risk, Compliance, Regulatory or Cybersecurity leaders.
  • People who can independently decide how, when and where to develop their market and who are comfortable being accountable for commercial results.
  • Professionals with an existing network in U.S. Financial Services, FinTech, banking, payments, insurance, asset/wealth management, cybersecurity or adjacent regulated sectors.
  • Individuals who value consultative conversations and long-term relationships over transactional vacancy chasing.
90-day pilot success measures
  • Qualified senior decision-maker conversations.
  • Client discovery meetings with genuine leadership or succession issues.

·Retained-search opportunities created.

  • Retained proposals issued and assignments won.
  • Collected search revenue from contractor-originated business.
  • Quality of client relationships and commercial intelligence, not raw dial or message volume.
How to apply
Please send a concise introduction explaining your U.S. market background, the sectors and senior decision-makers you know best, and examples of executive-search, recruitment or professional-services business you have personally originated. We are particularly interested in people who can demonstrate relationship-led business development rather than high-volume outreach.

Company:MastarRec Limited |

Founder & CEO:Tariq Masood


Benefits

Commercial model

The proposed pilot is performance-based. The final commission schedule will be stated in the written contractor agreement. Our intended starting model is a substantial share of MastarRec's net collected search fees on qualifying new client business personally originated by the contractor. Commission becomes payable only after the relevant client payment has been received and cleared by MastarRec, subject to the agreement's account-ownership, refund, replacement, tax and clawback provisions.

For discussion, Commission is 22% of qualifying net search fees actually collected by MastarRec from new client business personally originated by the contractor. The final structure may vary according to the scope of the contractor's role, whether MastarRec provides delivery support, and applicable legal/tax requirements.

Independent contractor basis

The successful professional will be expected to operate as an independent businessperson, subject to the final written agreement and applicable federal and state law. The contractor will ordinarily control the manner, means, timing and location of their work; remain responsible for their own ordinary business expenses, taxes and insurance; and, subject to confidentiality, conflict and account-protection obligations, remain free to provide services to other clients. MastarRec will define required commercial outcomes, brand/confidentiality standards and client-account protections rather than prescribing day-to-day working methods.

Important notice

This specification describes MastarRec's intended commercial model and is not a legal determination of worker status. Worker classification depends on the actual facts and circumstances and may differ under federal, state and local law. MastarRec will complete appropriate legal/tax review before engagement. No candidate should rely on the title, commission method or written agreement alone as determining independent-contractor status.

LifeStance Health Values

  • Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.

  • Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.

  • Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.

Benefits

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Excited about trailblazing a new sales channel and approach for LifeStance.
  • Comfortable navigating nonstandard sales processes and structuring mutually beneficial partnerships.
  • Passionate about mental healthcare and LifeStance’s mission.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Ability to be a strategic thought-partner with customers to help identify challenges and solutions to health system leadership.
  • Proactive self-starter who is motivated to achieve goals and metric-based targets.
  • Detailed-oriented and disciplined.
  • Enjoy blending strategic thinking and disciplined execution.
  • Cross functional collaboration and relationship building.
  • Ability to set the right expectations with referral partners.
  • Open to receiving constructive feedback.
  • Navigating conflict and tradeoffs between team goals and business objectives.

Job Description:

This position is responsible for generating revenue for Vertex through the sale of Vertex tax solutions to prospects and existing clients. Develop strategies and account plans to penetrate a defined territory and targeted accounts. This will include navigating through an organization to leverage Vertex solutions as an enterprise-wide, global value proposition. Understand customer business and service requirements to develop tailored Vertex solutions, including development of long-term relationships with customers as well as development of account plans for new relationships. Target accounts include new and existing customers within an assigned territory.


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Generate revenue for Vertex by selling Vertex transaction tax solutions in a defined territory.
  • Includes targeting specific accounts, developing strategy, gaining a clear understanding of companies' tax and technical environments, and selling Vertex solutions that best fit such requirements.
  • Drive opportunities at the strategic and tactical level by selling the enterprise-wide value proposition associated with Vertex solutions to the highest levels within our customers’ organizations. Includes establishing relationships with key customer and partner contacts and selling into complex, multi-department enterprises; leveraging and developing strategy with Sales
  • Management to manage and maximize accounts' value to Vertex.
  • Understand customer’s business requirements, direction, and strategic vision of tax by building customer relationships at the highest levels, providing valuable input that influences their vision and tactics, and developing plans to assist them in achieving their goals. Developing and responding to RFPs, developing joint proposals with Vertex Consulting, and fostering relationships/partnerships between Vertex, customer(s), and/or partners.
  • Gain support for customer initiatives by working with key customer contacts to help sell their ideas throughout their organization; assist in building business cases and work with stakeholders to sell ideas internally at Vertex; help influence partners' development of new interfaces that utilize Vertex products.
  • Build customer awareness and understanding of Vertex’s business direction by managing accounts in a way that keeps key Vertex customers informed of Vertex's business direction. Stay informed of internal initiatives, related partner and industry developments and, as appropriate, communicate these to the customer and connect the customer with key people at Vertex.
  • Enhance job knowledge by staying abreast of customer-related news and developments, attending educational workshops; reviewing professional publications; establishing personal networks; participating in professional societies; developing and/or maintaining proficiency in the latest productivity and technical tools. Apply broad knowledge of Vertex’s services, products, and marketing techniques to develop large opportunities and close sales.
  • Support a dynamic team environment at Vertex by collaborating and/or participating with other functional areas and team initiatives, contributing time, effort, and ideas toward enhancing Vertex solutions and the customer experience.
  • Participate in other projects or duties.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • N/A

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Excellent interpersonal, organizational, time management, negotiating, and decision-making skills.
  • Superior closing and decision-making skills.
  • Superior presentation and communication (verbal and written, including at the executive level) skills.
  • Strategic thinking, relationship-building, problem-solving.
  • Strong knowledge of the software and tax industries.
  • Understanding solutions, vision, and direction of Vertex initiatives and presenting value associated with such.
  • Ability to make recommendations to effectively resolve problems or issues by using judgment consistent with company standards, practices, policies, and procedures as well as federal and state regulations and laws. 
  • Ability to organize and prioritize work and manage multiple responsibilities and tasks. 
  • Proficiency working in MS Office: Outlook, Word, and Excel.
  • Sense of urgency and a results-oriented attitude.

EDUCATION AND TRAINING:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing or Business; fifteen (15) years plus of experience in outside sales of transaction tax software (sales tax/consumer use tax/VAT) required.
  • Strong track record of relationship development and business development experience required.
  • Strong working knowledge of Vertex or comparable transaction tax software preferred.
  • Background selling software and/or consulting services to mid- or senior-level decision makers required.
  • Or equivalent combination of education and/or experience.

COMMENTS:

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals in this position. Other functions may be assigned, and management retains the right to add or change the duties at any time.



Vertex Values: Together We Win


We're building a team of people who are passionate about making an impact for our customers and committed to how that impact is achieved. Our values define the behaviors, mindset, and culture that make Vertex a great place to grow and do meaningful work.


Play to Win or We Don't Play — If we choose to do something, we're choosing to do it because we plan to win. That mindset raises our bar on product quality, customer outcomes, and how we show up for one another.


Work As a Team, Putting the Customer At the Core — Our customers are our true north. Whatever your role, ask: how will this help a customer succeed today? We earn trust through outcomes, not promises.


Achieve Excellence With Integrity, Speed, and Agility — The market isn't slowing down. We'll move faster, adapt quickly, and never compromise on doing things the right way — for teammates, customers, and partners.


Innovate Boldly With a Growth Mindset — Progress demands smart risk. We'll try new approaches, learn fast, and keep pushing the boundaries — especially where AI can remove friction and unlock value.


Communicate with Care, Candor and Transparency — Honest, constructive conversations make us better. Let's speak plainly about what's working and what isn't and help each other improve.

Pay Transparency Statement:

US Base Salary Range: $119,300.00 - $155,000.00

Base pay offered to new hires may vary based upon factors including relevant industry and job-related skills and experience, geographic location, and business needs.* The range displayed does not encompass the full potential of the role, which allows for further growth and career progression.

In addition, as a part of our total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Vertex Bonus Plan (VOB), a role-specific sales commission/bonus, and/or equity grants.

Learn more about Life at Vertex and connect with your recruiter for more details regarding Vertex's compensation and benefit programs.

*In no case will your pay fall below applicable local minimum wage requirements.

raw.description:
TELUS Health is empowering every person to live their healthiest life. Guided by our vision, we are leveraging the power of our leading edge technology and focusing on the uniqueness of each individual to create the future of health. As a global-leading health and well-being provider – encompassing physical, mental and financial health – TELUS Health is improving health outcomes for consumers, patients, healthcare professionals, employers and employees.

We are seeking a driven Sales Executive (Business Development Director) to lead new business development for TELUS Wellbeing, our holistic digital health and wellness engagement platform designed to educate, engage, and inspire employees to improve their health through sustained behaviour change.
This role is central to expanding TELUS Wellbeing’s footprint across the United States by driving sales through direct client engagement, broker partnerships, and strategic alliances, while collaborating cross‑functionally with Account Management, Marketing, Operations, and Finance teams. You will play a key role in shaping growth within our Integrated Health Solutions portfolio, helping U.S. employers build proactive, prevention‑first cultures of health.

Our Team and What We Will Accomplish Together

Our team drives transformative growth across TELUS Health’s preventative wellbeing solutions, partnering with leading North American organizations to expand access to tools that help employees build healthier habits before issues arise. You will work alongside Account Management, Marketing, Operations, and Finance teams to shape the future of employee wellness, directly impacting the day‑to‑day health and happiness of employees at organizations of all sizes. This is a high‑impact, specialty sales role where your ability to sell a proactive, behaviour‑change‑driven solution — distinct from traditional reactive benefits — will help employers build healthier, more resilient, and more engaged workforces.

What You Will Do

  • Lead business development activities across the full sales cycle for TELUS Wellbeing, managing prospective and existing clients and partners from initial engagement through contract closure.

  • Drive new‑business growth through direct sales, RFP participation, and strategic expansion within existing accounts, collaborating with Account Management to identify upsell and cross‑sell opportunities across the broader TELUS Health portfolio (EAP, virtual care, and wellbeing).

  • Build and nurture strong relationships with key stakeholders, brokers, and benefits consultants, leveraging indirect sales channels to expand market reach across your assigned U.S. territory.

  • Clearly articulate the value proposition and ROI of a preventative, engagement‑driven wellbeing platform to HR, Total Rewards, and benefits leaders — differentiating TELUS Wellbeing from point‑solution and reactive benefit offerings.

  • Present at industry conferences, client events, and finalist presentations, positioning TELUS Health as a market leader in integrated, preventative health solutions.

  • Develop and refine territory strategy aligned with broader organizational goals, conducting competitive analysis and identifying market opportunities to maximize growth potential.

  • Participate in Quarterly Business Reviews to assess sales performance, strategy effectiveness, and pipeline health, providing insights to inform future growth initiatives.

  • Enable the broader sales force by delivering product training, demo capabilities, and objection‑handling tools that empower colleagues to sell the Life‑Moments framework effectively.

  • Serve as a strategic liaison between sales, product, and marketing, gathering client feedback, identifying market patterns, and feeding insights back to sharpen go‑to‑market decisions.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of enterprise B2B sales or business development experience, with a proven track record of closing complex, high‑value deals.

  • Demonstrated success selling to HR, benefits, or wellness buyers, ideally with experience selling engagement‑based, subscription, or behaviour‑change‑driven solutions.

  • Experience in employer benefits, wellness, EAP, HR consulting, or related sectors, with a deep understanding of broker and consultant dynamics in the benefits industry.

  • Strong consultative selling and presentation skills, with the ability to build compelling, ROI‑based business cases for a preventative health solution to prospective clients.

  • Ability to manage the full sales cycle autonomously from prospecting through contract negotiation and closure.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong drive for growth, results orientation, and the ability to thrive in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and time‑management skills with strong organizational abilities and business acumen.

  • Willingness and ability to travel throughout your assigned U.S. territory, with flexibility to support strategic client engagements.

Great‑to‑Have

  • Existing broker network or established book of business in the benefits, wellness, or EAP space.

  • Experience selling digital health, SaaS, or engagement/behaviour‑change platforms.

  • Familiarity with corporate wellness program design, incentive structures, or population health concepts.

  • MBA or advanced business degree.

We’re a people-focused, customer-first, purpose-driven team who works together every day to innovate and do good. raw.excerpt: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.
raw.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as our next Executive Business Partner on Twilio’s Enterprise Technology team.

Who we are & why we’re hiring

Twilio powers real-time business communications and data solutions that help companies and developers worldwide build better applications and customer experiences.

Although we're headquartered in San Francisco, we have presence throughout South America, Europe, Asia and Australia. We're on a journey to becoming a global company that actively opposes racism and all forms of oppression and bias. At Twilio, we support diversity, equity & inclusion wherever we do business.

About the job

Twilio is seeking a highly proactive and business-minded Executive Business Partner to support executives within our Enterprise Technology organization. This role extends well beyond traditional administrative support. The successful candidate will develop a strong understanding of our business, technology strategy, organizational priorities, and key initiatives—using that context to anticipate needs, manage competing demands, and help leaders and their teams operate more effectively.

You will serve as a trusted partner to your executives, proactively managing their time and attention. You will be expected to exercise sound judgment, take ownership, and move work forward even when direction is not fully defined or all information is not yet available.

This role requires someone who is comfortable taking charge, solving problems, and navigating ambiguity. You will build strong relationships with executive leadership, their direct reports, and administrative partners across the organization, serving as a central point of coordination and a reliable source of insight and continuity.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Develop a deep understanding of the Enterprise Technology organization, including its strategy, priorities, key initiatives, stakeholders, and operating rhythms, and use that knowledge to anticipate needs and inform day-to-day decisions.
  • Serve as a trusted thought partner to executives, providing informed input, identifying potential risks or conflicts, and helping move priorities forward without waiting for detailed direction.
  • Strategically manage complex executive calendars by evaluating and prioritizing requests, resolving conflicts, protecting time for critical work, and redirecting or delegating meetings when appropriate.
  • Make sound, independent decisions on behalf of executives, including determining when their participation is needed and ensuring they are prepared with the right context, materials, and desired outcomes.
  • Manage complex domestic and international travel, prepare and reconcile expenses, and proactively address changes or issues that arise.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for executives’ direct reports and administrative partners, building trusted relationships and facilitating effective coordination across the organization.
  • Help translate executive priorities into action by tracking commitments, following up on decisions, and driving accountability for milestones, deliverables, and next steps.
  • Support key projects and initiatives by gathering information, synthesizing updates, identifying dependencies, and ensuring the right stakeholders remain aligned.
  • Draft and coordinate executive communications, presentations, program updates, meeting materials, and other written content with a high degree of clarity and professionalism.
  • Manage leadership meeting and operating cadences, including developing agendas, coordinating presenters, preparing materials, capturing decisions and action items, and ensuring effective follow-through.
  • Lead the end-to-end planning and execution of executive offsites, leadership summits, strategic planning sessions, and team gatherings, including budget management, venue sourcing, agenda development, material preparation, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Organize and support special events, team activities, and other high-visibility meetings through thoughtful research, participant coordination, and logistics management.
  • Analyze team surveys, operational information, or other inputs to identify themes and provide executives with useful insights.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve operating practices, and create a more efficient and positive experience for executives and their teams.
  • Handle sensitive information and complex situations with exceptional discretion, professionalism, and judgment.

Qualifications

Not all applicants will have skills that match a job description exactly. Twilio values diverse experiences in other industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. While having “desired” qualifications make for a strong candidate, we encourage applicants with alternative experiences to also apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience supporting senior executives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, preferably within the technology industry.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership, operate independently, and move work forward amid ambiguity, incomplete information, and changing priorities.
  • Strong business acumen and intellectual curiosity, with the ability to quickly understand organizational strategy, technology initiatives, and executive priorities.
  • Proven ability to anticipate needs, exercise sound judgment, solve problems proactively, and make thoughtful decisions on behalf of senior leaders.
  • Experience strategically managing complex executive calendars, including evaluating priorities, resolving conflicts, and making informed tradeoffs.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted cross-functional relationships, partner effectively with leaders, and coordinate work across multiple teams and initiatives.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple high-priority deliverables and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience drafting executive-ready communications and presentation materials.
  • High level of integrity and discretion when handling confidential, sensitive, or business-critical information.
  • Experience planning and facilitating virtual, in-person, and hybrid leadership meetings, summits, offsites, and team-building events.
  • Familiarity with contract management, procurement processes, budget tracking, and general business workflows.
  • Proficiency with common productivity and collaboration tools, including Google Workspace and Zoom.
  • Demonstrated interest in and experience using AI and automation tools to improve productivity, quality, or efficiency.

Desired

  • Experience supporting executives or leadership teams within Enterprise Technology, IT, Engineering, Operations, or a similarly complex organization.
  • Experience preparing for and coordinating business operating cadences such as Quarterly Business Reviews, annual or long-range planning, leadership team meetings, and organizational reviews.
  • Internal or executive communications experience, including drafting leadership emails, organizational announcements, presentations, and program updates.
  • Experience supporting c projects or programs and tracking deliverables, dependencies, risks, and decisions.
  • Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Business, Communications, Operations, or a related field; equivalent practical experience is also valued.

Location

This role will be remote, based in Columbia.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 5-10% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

There are many benefits to working at Twilio, including, in addition to competitive pay, things like generous time-off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

Be the first sales hire at a fast-growing AI company, with the founder beside you.

If you love starting conversations, understanding what a business needs, and winning the deal, this is a rare chance to build a sales function from the ground up.

About the Opportunity

Our client is an AI consultancy based on the Gold Coast, Australia. It helps businesses adopt AI in practical, safe ways, through team training, workflow automation, agentic AI, and custom AI solutions. The work is bespoke and high value, and the company is growing. This is its first dedicated sales hire, working one-to-one with the founder.

You will find the right prospects, start the conversations, understand each business's problem, and work with the founder and technical team to turn that into a proposal and a signed deal.

What You'll Do

  • Own cold outreach on the company's LinkedIn platform to businesses in Australia and overseas
  • Follow up the warm leads that arrive each week from Google Ads
  • Qualify leads until they are engaged and asking the right questions
  • Capture each prospect's problem and requirements
  • Help the founder and technical team shape the proposal, then own the follow-up
  • Carry deals most of the way to close, with the founder joining for the final stretch

A hands-on sales role with real ownership.

You own the pipeline from first outreach to a qualified, engaged lead, and keep it moving to close. The founder steps in on proposals and the final stretch, so you are never selling alone. Goals are clear and outcome based, with a reward for beating them.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of B2B sales, with strong cold outreach and prospecting skills
  • Some closing experience, and the drive to own the full sales cycle with founder support
  • Persuasive spoken and written English: you can convince a business owner that a service is worth their time
  • Experience selling to Australia, the US, UK, or another English-speaking market
  • A general understanding of AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude, and the confidence to talk about them
  • A self-driven, outcome-focused mindset, comfortable working to KPIs
  • An ethical approach that protects the company's reputation
  • Nice to have: experience selling technology or professional services

Why You'll Love This Role

  • Be the first sales hire and shape how the company sells
  • Work directly with the founder, with real access and fast decisions
  • No IT or AI background needed: you will be trained on the services each week
  • Build real knowledge of AI, one of the fastest-growing fields in business
  • Work from home, with a focus on results over micromanagement
  • Own your pipeline and see your results turn into revenue

The National & Strategic Accounts Leader will own relationships with large health systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs), academic medical centers, and other complex healthcare organizations. This individual will develop comprehensive account strategies, build executive-level relationships, identify opportunities for growth, and navigate sophisticated healthcare purchasing and decision-making environments.

Working closely with Sales, Marketing, Clinical, Service, and other internal partners, you will coordinate resources across the organization to develop long-term customer strategies and advance complex opportunities. This role is well suited for a strategic healthcare sales professional who understands enterprise accounts, enjoys building C-suite relationships, and can identify opportunities beyond individual products or transactional sales.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans for large health systems, IDNs, academic institutions, and other enterprise healthcare organizations.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior executives, clinical leaders, administrators, and other key decision-makers.
  • Identify opportunities to expand existing customer relationships and develop new enterprise-level business.
  • Develop a thorough understanding of customer priorities, organizational objectives, technology strategies, and future business needs.
  • Lead strategic customer discussions involving multiple stakeholders, departments, and decision-makers.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Marketing, Clinical, Service, and other internal teams to develop and execute comprehensive account strategies.
  • Navigate complex purchasing, contracting, capital budgeting, procurement, and approval processes.
  • Identify opportunities across the broader organization rather than focusing solely on individual products or transactional sales.
  • Manage long-term opportunities involving complex sales cycles and multiple internal and external stakeholders.
  • Support commercial negotiations and strategic business development initiatives within assigned accounts.

  • Experience selling complex solutions into hospitals, health systems, academic medical centers, or other large healthcare organizations.

  • Experience navigating long, complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Strong business development, commercial negotiation, presentation, and strategic account-planning skills.

Founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City, CertiK provides a wide range of services including smart contract audits, penetration testing, on-chain monitoring, incident response, and compliance solutions for some of the largest projects and institutions in the digital asset ecosystem.

Responsibilities

  • Build, deepen and manage relationships with banks, brokers, asset managers, payment institutions and fintechs entering digital assets in Brazil and LATAM
